articles.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
articles.content: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

articles.title_zh: 一张图,每张相机:通过代理管道可编辑的流程图中继器
articles.content_zh: ML报纸中的管道数字必须重新用于许多画布,包括纸柱,16:9幻灯片,肖像海报,1:1社交取笑者,9:16电话预览. 每种格式都在同一计算图上强制规定不同的侧面比,其中任何无声断开的连接都会歪曲方法. 我们设计了个个性适应的流程图,作为一个不同的任务: 给一个光栅流程图和目标比, 产生一个结构上忠实的,无幻觉的,可编辑的布局。 现有方法在特征上失败:图像对图像模型伸展阻力并拒绝极端比例,文本对图像代理系统产生幻觉内容,以及剖析当时的系统误向边缘. 我们提出一个代理管道 包含在Parse, Style, 和布局阶段, 每一个配对一个主要代理和一个评论家, 将确定性约束检查与VLM视觉反馈相结合, 输出为draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. 根据双子座3.1 Pro评估的、经人类判断验证的100个流程图的全方位基准,我们的方法在先前的工作上达到68.6%的内容Fidelity比11.2-41.4%。 项目网页:https://onegitphepercanvas.vercel.app/

articles.title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
articles.content: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.

articles.title_zh: IntermicGen:通过自演运动模拟增强人性化Loco-管理
articles.content_zh: 被捕获的人体-物体相互作用为人造机器人操纵提供了丰富的监督,但它们是稀少的,多样性的,不能由机器人直接执行. 我们引入了IntermicGen,这是一个自演运动模拟框架,其中机器人运动数据和跟踪政策可以互相改进. 首先,我们合并了动作捕获的人体-物体相互作用数据集,并将其重新定位为人体机器人参考文献,同时保留全身协调以及可破解的手-物体关系. 这产生了一个大型和多样的人体机器人参考集合,用于 dexterous whole-body-loco-manapulation. 第二,我们培训一个基于物理学的通用追踪器,在使用离心手的人体仿真中执行这些参考,涵盖范围与多样性,超出了之前的人体操纵跟踪系统。 第三,我们关闭一个数据飞轮:每回合对交互发生地点和机体如何执行进行小的,任务保存的修改,对上面的跟踪器进行微调,只保留模拟执行完成任务的变体,使下一轮成为种子. 随着更多的迭代,这些小编辑复合成更广泛的覆盖,围绕稀少的原始演示,同时保留任务语义和运动质量. 实验显示在机器人配置之间保持接触的重定向,以单一的通论政策进行广泛的跟踪,在增强回合后不断增长的可执行运动,以及转移到真正的机器人. InterMimicGen提供了一条统一的道路,从多样的人类演示到不断扩展的人类机器人学习运动资源.

articles.title: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
articles.content: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.

articles.title_zh: S2PD: 物理和逻辑一致性视频生成的序列化到帕拉列尔扩散
articles.content_zh: 双向视频传播模型同时对全视频进行denoise,然而在接受关于程序生成器有效无限制的分发数据的培训时,继续违反实体法和简单的象征性规则. 我们引入Serial-to-Parallel扩散(S2PD),在低噪声转换为平行扩散之前,在高噪声下进行自递扩散. 自动递归阶段提供了协调相互依存事件和产生有效状态过渡所需的序列计算,而平行阶段则联合完善了整个视频,并相对全序列生成减少了采样时间. 我们通过两个架构实施S2PD:一个从零开始训练的像素空间扩散变压器和一个通过LORA微调进行因果注意而改造的预先训练的视频模型. 在整个游戏,物理模拟,以及真实视频中,S2PD遵循的规则比匹配的双向基线更可靠,并生成比其他系列方法更具有时间稳定性和采样效率的视频.

articles.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.

articles.title_zh: 在传播变形器中学习读取上下文
articles.content_zh: 多式联运变形器(MM-DITs)在一代人中共同处理视觉和文字表达. 这些模型通过多模式的注意来反复更新文本符号,形成动态背景符号,其功能没有得到很好的理解. 在这项工作中,我们引入了一个通过自然语言审讯来读取这个背景空间的框架. 我们训练一个轻量级的瓶颈网络,将中间上下文符号映射到一个冷冻的大语言模型(LLM)的输入空间,使LLM能够直接从这些隐藏的表示中解答关于新出现的图像的问题. 我们的读者透露,背景符号编码了新兴场景的丰富、全球的体现:代特异性的语义学,包括未被及时描述的属性,在解密的早期是惊人的,同时越来越多的精细细节随着时间推移变得可以读取。 值得注意的是,即使MM-DIT收到空的提示,这种信息仍然可以解码,表明背景符号从不断发展的视觉表现本身积累了大量的图像特定信息. 我们还发现,具有更可读性背景描述的几代人往往得到更高的人偏好分数。 基于这些观察,我们采用了 " 背景调整 " ,这是一种培训技术,它明确加强了背景符号中编码的视觉语义信息,提高了生成质量和分布范围。 我们的成果共同建立了背景标志,既是对MM-DiTs内部动态的一种可解释的观点,也是改进基因模型的有效目标。

articles.title: Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report
articles.content: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG), yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.

articles.title_zh: 解剖学-认识精细的多式聚变Laryngopharyngeal Cance T-Staging Presidency 使用CT和放射学报告
articles.content_zh: 准确的T-Stage对于指导喉癌的个性化治疗战略至关重要。 然而,目前的临床实践依赖于入侵性活检程序,而基于CT的培养因肿瘤入侵的复杂模式而仍然具有挑战性。 最近的计算机辅助方法面临两大挑战: 1)结构关系模型化:现有方法在解剖学上代表了肿瘤入侵的结构化规律,因为它们要么处理整个CT卷而无肿瘤特定解剖约束,要么依赖劳动密集型肿瘤分化. 2)精细的跨模式对齐:虽然放射学报告包含了器官特异性入侵的细节,但目前应用全球特征聚变斗争的方法,以精确地将单个解剖结构与其相应的文字描述对齐. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出一个解剖学-认识多模式框架,将器官一级的CT背景和放射学报告纳入喉咙T- Stage的统一代表。 该框架首先构建了一个剖面-结构化的器官图(AOG),它捕捉主要地点和周围器官之间的入侵模式,然后进行器官-结构跨模式对齐(OCA),以便每个器官节点从放射学报告中汇总文字证据,最后通过通过报告-强化图(REG)从报告中提取的器官特定入侵提示来改进这个图表的表述,生成一个结合空间证据和文字证据的多模式器官图。 广泛的实验表明,拟议框架在肾上腺癌的T- station中取得了优异的性能.

articles.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
articles.content: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method's strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. This strength relates poorly to perceptual change. The image can partially revert as the slider moves, long stretches of the range produce no visible difference, and short intervals transform the image abruptly. Remapping the strength could fix this uneven pace, but only if the trajectory is monotone, which current methods do not enforce. We therefore distinguish the slider from the strength, and require perceptual distance from the input to grow linearly with the slider value. We introduce UniSlider, a lightweight LoRA trained on a few-step editing backbone so that its strength approximates this ideal slider. Few-step sampling lets us impose this objective in pixel space without intermediate ground truth, and the backbone's output is preserved at full strength. However, a low-rank adapter cannot make the strength fully uniform. Our slider is thus an inference-time remapping of the strength, obtained by adaptive sampling. Since training optmizes to make the trajectory monotone, this remapping closes the remaining gap without extra training or parameters. On a new benchmark of 300 continuous edits evaluating uniformity, monotonicity, edit fidelity, and identity preservation, UniSlider outperforms all prior methods and is preferred in a user study.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UniSlider: 感知到连续图像编辑的统一滑动器
articles.content_zh: 滑动器为连续图像编辑提供了直观界面. 然而,在目前的基因法中,滑动器只是方法强度参数的缩放,如适配系数,即时权重,或插值系数. 这种力量与观念变化关系不大。 图像可以随着滑动器的移动而部分回落,长的伸展范围不会产生明显的区别,短的间隔会突然改变图像. 重新绘制强度可以改变这种不均衡的速度,但只有轨迹是单调的,而目前的方法并不强制。 因此,我们将滑动器与强度区分开来,并且需要从输入的知觉距离与滑动器值线性增长. 我们介绍UniSlider, 一个轻量级的LORA, 训练了几步编辑主干线, 使其强度接近这个理想的滑轮。 少步采样让我们在像素空间中将这一目标强加于没有中间地面真理,骨干输出被全力保存. 然而,低级适配器不能使强度完全统一. 因此,我们的滑动器是对强度的推断-时间重新绘制,通过适应性取样获得。 由于训练选择了使轨迹单调,这种重新绘图在没有额外训练或参数的情况下缩小了剩余差距. 在300个连续编辑的新基准上,评价统一性、单调性、编辑忠诚性和身份保护,UniSlider比以往所有方法都好,在用户研究中更受青睐。

articles.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
articles.content: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.

articles.title_zh: PlotGround: 在真实科学数字及其来源数据中定位绘图
articles.content_zh: 科学人物往往将无法随时以机器可读形式获得的定量结果编码,使准确的图案数字化对于核实和重新使用已公布的调查结果十分重要。 然而,仍然不清楚目前的模型如何准确地从实际科学数字中恢复绘图值,因为现有基准主要依靠合成图表或只涵盖有限的图表类型。 我们引入了PlotGround, 一个自动管道 用于构建地块数字化基准 从真实的科学人物 及其作者发布的来源数据。 将 GropGround 映射到源表,识别可重建的面板,并生成带有源源参考值的定量问题. 我们用PlotGround来建造PlotGround-1k,这是由1 066个生物Rxiv预印的1 119个问题组成的经人验证的基准。 在16个多式联运模型中,最佳的精确度达到87.5%,每5美元左右的相对耐受性。 将耐受度限制到$\pm 2\%$将每个模型的精度降低11-24个百分点,揭示了近似视觉阅读和精确定量恢复之间的差距. PlotGround的配对数字-源结构让我们比较一下从数字和源表格中回收的相同值的准确性。 提供源表而不是数字将编码剂的精确度从90.0%提高到97.4%,同时将成本降低72%。

articles.title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
articles.content: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TAPDreamer:世界行动模式的可转让横向补丁
articles.content_zh: 世界模型学习预测其环境将如何演变,使其成为通用机器人控制的重要基础. 然而,世界行动模式依赖于摄像头投入,而摄像头的操纵会破坏各种任务和行动政策所使用的视觉表现。 对这些模型的现有攻击使受害者的行动或预测的未来受到最佳打击,因此需要获得目标模型产出。 在本文中,我们提出攻击TAPDreamer,针对的是世界行动模式,它只使用公共编码器来构建一个固定的局部扰动,跨越任务和行动架构. TAPDreamer不需要目标政策查询. 我们的关键见解是,补丁引起的注意力重量变化和价值矢量之间的相互作用,所显示的表示变化几乎完全相同,远远超出补丁足迹,这种变化在各任务观察中保持稳定。 TAPDreamer以这种洞察力为指导,从一个源任务中利用6帧,使清洁编码器和补丁编码器表示器之间的全球L1距离最大化. 在闭路评估中,每个基准一个冷冻补丁,覆盖约6.5%的输入,将FastWAM的成功率从40个LIBERO任务中的97.7%降至0.0%,将50个RoboTwin任务中的90.8%降至0.0%;匹配的随机补丁保留了81.5%和79.2%的成功率. 同样的补丁将两个DreamWAM配置上的成功率降低到2.1%和0.8%,并将Motus上的成功率降低到10.0%. 这些结果表明,仅仅保护下游行动生成是不够的:世界行动模型的防御还必须确保共享的视觉编码器防止持续的局部扰动.

articles.title: Less Context, Better Geometry: Masked Geometric Encoder for Robust 3D Foundation Models
articles.content: Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.

articles.title_zh: 减少背景, 更好的几何: 硬体 3D 基础模型的遮盖几何编码器
articles.content_zh: 最近3D基础模型的进展,通过利用从大量空间数据中学到的3D前身,使得3D重建和相机校准得以快速进行. 然而,全局性关注设计导致四极性的复杂性,并限制了长序推论;不受约束的交叉视图相互作用也可以传播来自闭合或视觉相似但几何远处的不可靠证据. 在本文中,我们介绍了一个遮盖几何编码器(MGE),该编码器促进在不完整的交叉视图背景下学习强健几何表示. 在培训期间,MGE从战略上从全球注意力中降下框架符号,并从预先训练的全文教师模型中提炼出来。 这使模型能够了解内在丰富的每帧代表,同时提供足够的中间监督以避免性能退化。 通过广泛的实验,我们显示,在隐蔽和二重身观点下,两性平等部能够提高业绩,同时保持标准基准的高业绩。 如此丰富的框架代表性也导致在推论期间更有效的象征性减少。 为此,我们开发了一个小说Anchor-Guided adaptive observation技术,它保留了具有代表性的锚定框,同时联合将剩余观点中的冗余符号合并. 与其他高效的推论方法相比,我们可以实现推论加速,同时始终保持更高的重建质量,特别是在有限视野环境下.

articles.title: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a $1.80\times$ denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a $2.32\times$ speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.

articles.title_zh: MC-Sparse:分解和缩小分散式变压器中的分解-分解注意力缺口
articles.content_zh: 散射注意力是减少散射变压器在视频和高分辨率3D资产生成等长序列生成任务中的耐久性的首要方法. 然而,现有方法可以在高伸缩水平上降低生成质量和忠诚度。 通过有控制的甲骨文比较,我们把这种退化追溯到三个来源:符号分组施加的限制,不准确的交互选择,以及符号丢弃时失去的注意力贡献. 在这项分析的指导下,我们提议Meta-Cached Sparse 注意(MC-Sparse),这是一个无培训框架,它可以选择单个的密钥值(KV)符号,同时组织类似的查询到瓷砖组合中,用于高效的GPU执行. MC-Sparse缓存元数据包括查询组,使用精确的注意概率选择的KV指数,以及密集的注意输出和稀疏的注意输出之间的剩余部分,并在随后的去诺步骤中重复使用. 通过视频和3D生成模型,MC-Sparse在不出现明显质量退化的情况下,比现有的稀疏基线更忠实于密度输出和更大的去诺加速。 相对于密集的注意,它在Minimax-H3-Base上提供1.8\times$去诺加速,在3D资产生成上提供2.32\times$加速,两者质量损失都微不足道.

articles.title: Extending Dynamic World Surface Water Mapping to Sentinel-1 with AlphaEarth Embeddings
articles.content: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google's AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 将动态世界地表水映射扩展到带有阿尔法地球嵌入物的哨兵1号
articles.content_zh: 动态世界(DW)在全球从哨兵2号(S2)图像10米处绘制土地利用和土地覆盖图,但只用于无云观测,这限制了地表水的测绘地点和时间. 我们使用DW水级作为Sentinel-1(S1)合成孔径雷达(SAR)模型的弱监督,这样每次获得S1时都可以制作DW类水图. Google的AlphaEarth基金会(AEF)每年嵌入式提供空间背景,而S1回散式则提供收购时间观测. 在53个全球分布的场景中,在S1过道48小时范围内获得的3m PlanetScope图像的独立说明中,仅S1的模型已经达到一个集合水的交叉点,超过结合(IoU)0.77,与运行中的OPERA DSWx-S1产品相当0.75,加起来AEF将其提升到0.85. 引信型号改进了53场景中44场的S1-Only型号,48场超过OPERA,在独立的S1S2水上基准则达到0.94,而OPERA则为0.87. 因此,光学土地覆盖产品可以为合成孔径雷达地表水绘图提供可扩展的培训标签。

articles.title: GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.

articles.title_zh: GS- Pool: 3D 高斯电镀中对象级变化检测
articles.content_zh: 工厂、博物馆和测量人员拍摄的空间相隔数月,需要知道哪些物体已经改变。 每次访问用3D高斯白板重建(3DGS)时,直接比较两个重建并不能回答这个问题. 训练很诡异,所以两次重建一个不变的空间永远不会重合,第二次访问往往是一次快速的重新扫描,照片少得多. 我们提出GS-Pool,它需要两个独立重建的相同空间的高斯场,并返回每个中改变的物体及其面具. 每次访问照片的SAM2口罩被抬到制作它们并合并成一个物体池的高斯人身上,所以每个物体在3D中都会做出一次决定. 我们介绍一个图片载体,3DGS训练损失 每一次输入重建 相对于另一个访问的照片, 背面传播给高斯人 使每个像素。 我们把它和GS-Diff的几何学和色彩术语 以及我们蒸馏的DINov3特征结合起来。 这些证据与两次访问中发现的物体相比,确定了每个场景的变化门槛。 在PASLCD上,GS-Pool达到mIoU/F1的分数为0.751/0.846,对比 GS-Diff的0.644/0.758,最强的前置方法,收益率为17%/12%. 它的mIoU也比O-SCD,PlenoCI和MV-3DCD高36%,40%和57%,在CL-Splate上达到0.855mIoU,比MV-3DCD高33%. 每个更改对象作为一组高斯人返回,并附有其决定背后的证据,一个检查员可以在3D中审查.

articles.title: ChronoWorld: Camera-Controlled Consistent 4D World Generation via Spatiotemporal Cues and Geometric Reflections
articles.content: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld, an "Observation--State--Reflection" framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Chrono World:通过Spatientoporal Cees和几何反射实现的相机控制一致四维世界代
articles.content_zh: 虽然现有的相机可控视频生成模型可以产生可视化的引人入胜的序列,但保持内在的4D瞬间一致性仍然具有挑战性. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议ChronoWorld,一个“观察-状态-参考”框架,利用瞬间因果提示和重建前期,产生全球一致的,自由视图的4D场景。 鉴于一个背景视频,我们引入了一个Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Reception机制,它在整个生成过程中强制实施多视角的前极限制和时间因果关系. 此外,我们开发了由重建驱动的几何反射管道,采用4D检索战略,以便能够对产生的产出进行动态的自我评估和校正,提高一致性和准确性。 广泛的实验表明,ChronoWorld在瞬间一致,电影质的4D场景生成中实现了最先进的性能,在各种情景中都有强烈的泛化和高真度几何.

articles.title: Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles
articles.content: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

articles.title_zh: 使用通用的Spatio-Timporest 机器倾斜组合框架从美国航天局黑大理石探测夜间异常
articles.content_zh: 美国国家航空航天局的"黑色大理石"产品套装的夜间灯光捕捉火灾、火山爆发和气体燃烧等异常事件的热和光发射信号。 现有的探测方法主要依靠热波段,将敏感度限制在较弱的信号上. 我们提出一个新的机器学习框架,联合模拟黑色大理石M波段和日/夜波段(DNB)信号,以得出一个普遍、斯皮提奥-时态强力的异常探测器组合。 该框架迭代地建立探测器,以跨越区域、季节、异常类别,并扩展到陆地和海洋。 根据有关的波段和探测器协议,测出不同水平的探测器。 这种方法提高了真实的探测率,同时减少了虚假的探测,结果表明,在自然灾害监测和能源提取方面的应用具有很强的通用性。

articles.title: VideoTapestry: Query-Adaptive Memory Refinement for Multi-Agent Long-Video Understanding
articles.content: Long-video understanding places substantial demands on memory, as answering questions often requires retrieving information distributed across extended temporal spans. Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms: query-driven exploration, which is sensitive to localization errors, and query-independent memory construction, which may omit question-specific details. We introduce VideoTapestry, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts a preconstructed hierarchical video memory through coarse-to-fine, query-driven refinement. The preconstructed memory organizes video content into three levels, capturing global narrative context, event-level temporal structure, and fine-grained relational evidence, respectively. To support coarse-to-fine localization and observation, we assign a specialized agent to each level, keeping retrieval and refinement within a scale-specific context. Guided by the query, these agents revisit relevant video regions and enrich layer-wise memories with targeted multimodal observations. Their refinements are assembled according to the original hierarchy into a composite query-adaptive memory, preserving global context in a compact form while retaining fine-grained evidence along query-relevant branches for final reasoning. Compared with direct GPT-5.5 inference, VideoTapestry achieves absolute accuracy gains of 17.2%, 14.9%, 9.8%, and 7.0% on LVBench, LongVideoBench (Long), Video-MME (Long), and EgoSchema, respectively, achieving the state-of-the-art results among all competitors.

articles.title_zh: VideoTapestry:多代理长视频解析的查询-辅助记忆
articles.content_zh: 长视频理解对内存提出了很大要求,因为回答问题往往需要检索在较长的时间段内分发的信息。 现有方法大致遵循两个范式:对本地化错误敏感的查询驱动探索和查询独立的内存构造,它们可能忽略特定问题的细节. 我们引入VideoTapestry,一个无培训的多代理框架,通过粗细对细,查询驱动的精细调整预构的分级视频内存. 预构的内存将视频内容组织为三个层面,分别捕捉全球叙事背景,事件层面的时间结构,以及精细的关联证据. 为了支持粗细的本地化和观察,我们为每个级别指派了一名专门代理人,将检索和精细化置于一个特定的规模范围内。 在询问的指导下,这些代理人重新审视了相关视频区域,并以有针对性的多式联运观测丰富了分层记忆。 它们的完善按照原始的等级分类整理成一个综合的查询适应记忆,以紧凑的形式保存全局背景,同时沿与查询相关的分支保留精细的证据进行最终推理. 与直接GPT-5.5推论相比,VideoTapestry在LV Bench,LongVideo Bench(Long),Video-MME(Long)和EgoSchema上分别实现了17.2%,14.9%,9.8%和7.0%的绝对精度增益,在所有竞争对手中实现了最先进的成绩.

articles.title: Cross-dataset harmonization for robust endoscopic image analysis
articles.content: A significant problem in endoscopic image analysis is that the machine learning (ML) models used for this purpose usually underperform when applied on images acquired from endoscopes that are different from those used to acquire the images of their training set. The main difference of the images originating from different endoscopes is their color distributions, which depend both on the image sensors and the light sources used. Although previous studies have highlighted this challenge, to the best of our knowledge it has not been previously explicitly tackled. This study focuses on this problem and proposes very simple but impactful method. It implements a reference-based image harmonization that reduces global appearance differences between endoscopic datasets. Specifically, it extracts global color statistics from a chosen reference dataset in the CIE-Lab color space and applies a statistical channel-wise transformation to map each target image toward the appearance of the images of the reference dataset. The method is evaluated in the context of polyp detection in both flexible colonoscopy and capsule endoscopy datasets using a dataset-level cross validation protocol. The results indicate that the proposed harmonization consistently improves cross-dataset performance up to 30.7%, outperforming relevant baseline and state-of-the-art methods. The results indicate that a substantial part of the generalization gap is driven by low-level appearance variation that can be mitigated without retraining.

articles.title_zh: 用于强力内视图像分析的跨数据集协调
articles.content_zh: 内视图像分析中的一个重大问题是,用于此目的的机器学习(ML)模型在应用于从内视镜获得的图像时通常表现不佳,这些图像不同于用于获取其训练集图像的图像。 源于不同内镜的图像的主要区别在于其颜色分布,这既取决于图像传感器,也取决于所使用的光源. 虽然以前的研究突出了这一挑战,但据我们所知,它以前没有明确地加以处理。 这项研究侧重于这一问题,并提出了非常简单但有影响的方法。 它实施基于参考的图像协调,以减少内景数据集之间的全球外观差异。 具体地说,它从CIE-Lab色彩空间中选定的参考数据集中提取全局色彩统计,并采用统计通道转换,将每个目标图像映射到参考数据集图像的外观. 在使用数据集层交叉验证协议的灵活结肠镜检查和胶囊内膜检查数据集中,该方法结合多p检测情况进行评估。 结果表明,拟议的统一不断提高跨数据集的绩效,达到30.7%,超过相关基线和最新方法。 结果显示,普遍化差距的很大一部分是由低水平的外观变化所驱动的,这种变化无需再培训即可缓解.

articles.title: Talk Like You: Imitating How You Speak in Real-Time Talking Head Generation
articles.content: In daily life, each person exhibits unique speaking habits, leading to subtle yet consistent lip-shape variations even when pronouncing the same word. Although recent talking head generation methods have achieved impressive visual fidelity and lip synchronization, they largely overlook user-specific customization, especially the motion patterns that characterize individual speaking habits. These habits are difficult to model and capture, as their motion patterns are highly fine-grained and often similar across individuals. As a result, many approaches produce overly uniform facial motions and fail to capture diverse, person-specific articulation patterns. To address this, we propose TalkLikeYou, an efficient framework that imitates how a target person speaks in talking head generation. Our method models habit in motion-space and achieves real-time performance through Flow Matching with only one sampling step during inference. We further adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy to capture subtle distinctions between habits, allowing users to specify a target habit through either a preset style from the dataset or a reference video. In addition, we introduce a new metric PLAD that projects mouth motions onto representative articulation axes to evaluate imitation accuracy and generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TalkLikeYou generates high-quality talking heads in real-time and significantly improves speaking habit imitation compared with prior methods. The code is available at: https://github.com/BQ-Wang0511/TalkLikeYou
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 像你一样说话:模仿你在实时说话的头代中说话的方式
articles.content_zh: 在日常生活中,每个人表现出独特的说话习惯,导致微妙而一致的唇形变异,即使在发音相同词时也是如此. 虽然最近说话的头部生成方法取得了令人印象深刻的视觉忠心和唇语同步,但它们在很大程度上忽略了用户特有的定制,特别是个人说话习惯特有的运动模式. 这些习惯很难建模和捕捉,因为其运动规律高度精细,并且往往在个体间相似. 因此,许多方法产生过于统一的面部运动,无法捕捉到多样的,针对个人的表达模式. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议Talk Like You, 一个能模仿目标人物在谈论头代时如何说话的有效框架。 我们的方法模型习惯于运动空间,通过在推论中仅用一个采样步骤的流程匹配来实现实时性能. 我们进一步采取两阶段模仿学习策略,以捕捉习惯之间的细微区别,让用户通过数据集的预设样式或参考视频来指定目标习惯. 此外,我们引入了一个新的指标PLAD,将口腔运动投射到具有代表性的表达轴上,以评价仿真准确性和生成多样性。 广泛的实验证明,Talk Like 你实时生成高质量的说话头,与之前的方法相比,显著改善了说话习惯模仿. 该代码可在https://github.com/BQ-Wang0511/Talk Like You上查阅.

articles.title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
articles.content: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.

articles.title_zh: AffordCraft: 任务可扩展构建- 从单一图像复制模拟资产
articles.content_zh: 机器人在模拟中学习取决于模拟器提供的对象. 许多任务需要具有单独部件的物体,允许所需运动的关节,以及在接触中仍然有效的物理属性. 现有方法为每个图像重新恢复这种结构:基因模型预测大部分在模拟中无法安顿或移动的部件和关节,而通用剂需要长时间的模型调用每个照片。 AffordCraft通过一个单一的RGB图像和一个任务指令来构建这样的资产,通过检索而不是生成:它定位对象和操作部分,从一个拼接资产库中选择匹配的条目,并适合图像,同时保持其部件和关节完整. AffordCraft没有任何标注该物体的盒子或面具,为31个类别的2 000张照片中的1 703张制作了实物有效资产。 5种基因方法在最多45%的相同照片上传递,在中位数,每个有效资产需要10至78倍的GPU时间. 在50张杂乱无章的图像上,237个注解对象中有162个在自动探测后通过同样的物理测试. 将图书库条目从141个增加到11,372个,无需修改方法,并将类别覆盖率从46%提高到100%,将所要求标签的挑选比例从18%提高到51%。 我们还利用已建资产,在单一物体和由编成的场景中执行操控任务;经过脚本示范培训的政策完成了在培训中未见的最初各州的两种任务。

articles.title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
articles.content: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, $<1\%$ drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, $\sim25\times$ on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this \href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{link}.

articles.title_zh: 实时WAM: 单步同步 世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式纳入了视频生成主干线的视觉表现,以指导行动预测。 最近高效的WAM采用Mixture-of-Transformers(MoT)架构,并计算视频演示一次,供动作专家重新使用. 然而,专家内部迭代(\ie,多步骤行动去诺)和专家间等待(\ie,相继执行视频和行动专家)仍然限制推论效率. 为此,我们提出了RealtimeWAM,这是一个非常高效的WAM变体,具有单步动作生成和同步推论,可以解决这两个瓶颈. 为了减少专家内部的迭代,我们提议教师-教师一致性阻滞(TACD)解决局部-全球误差:仅靠低局部一致性误差并不能保证准确的最终行动. TACD补充了当地的一致性,从被冻结的教师的多步推出终点得到明确的监督,从而能够精确地产生单步动作. 此外,我们提议跨专家波前管道(CEWP)消除不必要的专家级等待。 它通过对视频KV缓存的块式共享来重叠两位专家,仅在相应动作注意力消耗之前同步. 跨越不同基准(如:如:LIBERO,LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin)和模型变体(如:Fast-WAM和Secret-WAM)的广泛实验显示了实时WAM的优越性. 值得注意的是,实时WAM在这些基准之间保持几乎无损失的性能(\ie,$ < 1\%$ drop),同时提供重大的端到端加速(\e,$\sim25\times$ on H100). 我们的密码和检查站通过这个\href{ https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{link} (原始内容存档于2017-09-29).

articles.title: Video Encoders Built on Image Representations
articles.content: The design of a video encoder determines when frames begin to interact and which frame-specific visual evidence remains accessible to the language model. Native video pathways couple neighboring frames during visual encoding, whereas image pathways preserve independently computed frame representations but incur a much larger visual-token cost when all image tokens are forwarded. We ask a basic question: whether a compact video encoder can instead be built on image representations. To answer this question, we separate three operations that are often coupled: per-frame representation, cross-frame token allocation, and temporal interaction. A frozen image encoder first produces frame-specific candidates. A question-aware selector then allocates a fixed token budget across frames using relevance, diversity, and cross-frame correspondence, after which a lightweight learned refiner reads neighboring-frame context and writes residual updates only to the retained anchors. This preserves source positions and keeps the visual output at the fixed budget. Across 13 benchmarks and three vision-language backbones, the resulting pathway matches full-image aggregate performance while using only about 28%-35% of its visual tokens. Specifically, on Qwen3-VL-8B, it achieves a 13-benchmark macro-average of 62.75 with 1,535 visual tokens, compared with 62.58 for the full Image pathway at 4,424 tokens and 59.49 for native Conv3D at 2,212 tokens. On Qwen3-VL-32B, it reaches a 13-benchmark macro-average of 66.28, compared with 66.09 for Image, while providing a 2.16x end-to-end speedup. These results show that compact video encoding does not require early temporal mixing: frame-specific evidence can be preserved first, allocated jointly, and temporally contextualized after selection.

articles.title_zh: 在图像显示上创建的视频编码器
articles.content_zh: 视频编码器的设计决定了帧何时开始相互作用,以及哪些帧特定的视觉证据仍然可供语言模型使用. 原生视频路径在视觉编码过程中是夫妇相邻的帧,而图像路径则保存独立计算帧的表示,但当传送所有图像符号时,则要花费大得多的视觉键成本. 我们提出一个基本问题:一个紧凑的视频编码器是否可以建立在图像表示上。 为了回答这个问题,我们把三个经常是结合的作业分开:按框架表示、跨框架表示分配和时间互动。 一个冷冻的图像编码器首先产生框架特定候选人. 问觉选择器然后利用关联性,多样性和跨帧对应来分配一个固定的符号预算,之后一个轻量级的学习精炼器读取相邻的帧上下文,只将剩余更新写给保留锚. 这保留了源头位置,并将视觉输出保持在固定预算中. 在13个基准和3个视觉语言主干线上,所产生的路径匹配全图像的整体性能,而只使用约28%-35%的视觉信号。 具体来说,在Qune3-VL-8B上,它实现了13个基准的宏观平均值为62.75个,可视化符号为1,535个,而全图像路径为62.58个,为4,424个,本地Conv3D为59.49个,为2,212个。 在Qwen3-VL-32B上,它达到了13个基准的宏观平均66.28,而Image为66.09,同时提供2.16x端对端的加速. 这些结果显示,紧凑的视频编码不需要提前时间混合:帧特定证据可以先保存,联合分配,选择后时间背景化.

articles.title: Lens3D: Target-Conditioned Visual Foveation for Fine-Grained 3D Understanding
articles.content: Existing 3D large language models often overlook fine-grained attributes and less visually salient objects and parts, even when relevant evidence is present in scene videos. We introduce Lens3D to improve fine-grained object understanding through external visual assistance and knowledge transfer. Its LensUnd pipeline adopts 3D localization to select informative, complementary views for an external 2D vision-language model, supporting fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object question answering. LensDistill transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to 3D LLMs through detailed caption supervision, enabling captioning from native inputs without external VLM calls. We also construct LensBench, a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. Experiments with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS demonstrate that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. These results establish the feasibility of transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs.

articles.title_zh: Lens3D: 精致的视觉视窗 谅解
articles.content_zh: 现有的3D大语言模型往往忽略了精细的属性和视觉不太显眼的物体和部分,即使现场视频中存在相关证据. 我们引入了Lens3D,通过外部的视觉协助和知识转让来增强精细的纹理对象理解. 它的LensUnd管道采用3D本地化,为外部的2D视觉语言模型选择信息化,互补的视图,支持精细的物体标题,小对象的定位,以及精细的物体问题回答. LensDistill通过详细的字幕监管,将由此产生的精致知识转移到3D LLMs,从而可以在没有外部 VLM 调用的情况下从本地输入进行字幕. 我们还建造了Lens Bench, 一套由2,068个物体组成的被搁置的评价,每个物体有3个银标准参考说明. 与Video-3D LLM和3DRS的实验表明,LensDistill在保留现有地面和场景级QA性能的同时,大大改进了精细的物体字幕. 这些结果确定了将外部获得的精细知识转让给本地3D法学硕士的可行性。

articles.title: Multitask Conditional Generative Adversarial Network Enables Automatic Whole Knee Cartilage and Menisci Segmentation and Reliable T1\r{ho} and T2 Quantification Without High-Resolution Morphological Images
articles.content: Early osteoarthritis detection through quantitative MRI (qMRI) requires accurate cartilage and meniscus segmentation, traditionally necessitating time-consuming, costly 3D high-resolution Double Echo Steady-State (DESS) MRI scans. This study developed a multi-task conditional generative adversarial network (MT-cGAN) to simultaneously synthesize DESS-like images and segment tissues directly from qMRI echo images. This retrospective study evaluated 508 knee MRI volumes from 361 subjects (mean age: $40.4 \pm 12.2$ years; 179 female) across three cohorts. Ground truth segmentation masks were generated from DESS images using a pretrained model with manual correction, and $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ maps were computed from magnetization-prepared angle-modulated partitioned $k$-space spoiled gradient echo snapshots (MAPSS) echo images. MT-cGAN was trained to jointly synthesize DESS-like images and segment cartilage and meniscus directly from echo images. Model performance was evaluated using Dice score for segmentation accuracy and coefficient of variation (CV) for $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification. MT-cGAN achieved the highest segmentation performance, mean Dice score 0.84 (range: 0.80--0.86) across all cartilage and meniscus compartments and significantly outperformed the state-of-the-art conditional GAN model with transfer learning (mean Dice, 0.82; $p < 0.001$, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). For relaxometry quantification, MT-cGAN demonstrated the highest consistency with the reference DESS protocol, yielding the lowest CV ($T_{1ρ}$: 1.84%, $T_2$: 1.81%). The proposed MT-cGAN accurately segmented cartilage and menisci while providing reliable $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification directly from echo images. By eliminating the need for separate morphological DESS scans, this workflow reduces required scan times to facilitate the clinical translation of qMRI.

articles.title_zh: 多任务有条件的遗传性反常网络启用自动全膝盖卡通和 Menisci 分割并可靠 T1\r{ho} 和 T2 量化, 无高分辨率解析图像
articles.content_zh: 通过定量核磁共振(qMRI)及早检测骨髓炎需要精确的软骨和脑膜分裂,传统上需要花费时间、昂贵的3D高分辨率双声稳态核磁共振扫描。 本研究开发了一个多任务有条件的基因对抗网络(MT-cGAN),以同时从qMRI回波图像直接合成DESS类图像和片段组织. 这项回顾性研究从361个科目(平均年龄:40.4 mpm 12.2美元;179名女性)对3个组别中的508个膝盖核磁共振卷进行了评估。 地面真象分解口罩是使用经过手动校正的预先训练的模型从DSS图像中生成的,而$T_{1美元和$T_2美元地图则是通过磁化准备角度调制的分区,$k$-space变质的渐变回声图像(MAPSS)回声图像计算出来的。 管理-c GAN接受过直接从回声图像中联合合成DESS类图像以及片段软骨和脑膜癌的培训. 模型性能使用Dice分数的分数精度和变异系数(CV)进行评价,分数分别为1美元和2美元。 MT-cGAN实现了最高的分化性能,平均Dice分数为0.84(范围:0.80-0.86),跨越所有软骨和meniscus隔间,并显著超越了具有转录学习的先进条件GAN模型(平均Dice,0.82;$p < 0.001美元,Wilcoxon签名排名测试). 就放松测量量化而言,MT-cGAN与参考DES协议的一致性最高,得出了最低的CV(T_{1ρ}美元:1.84%,T_2美元:1.81%)。 拟议的MT-cGAN精确地分解软骨和元件,同时直接通过回声图像提供可靠的1美元和2美元量化。 通过消除单独形态DSS扫描的需要,这个工作流程减少了所需的扫描时间,以便于qMRI的临床翻译.

articles.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
articles.content: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}

articles.title_zh: 模拟世界模型
articles.content_zh: 具备行动条件的机器人世界模型必须准确应对机器人的轨迹,同时保持现实的视觉动态,但从多样的机器人视频中学习两者仍然具有挑战性。 模拟提供结构化运动监督,但外观差异阻碍直接转移,不准确的模拟预测可能误导真视频生成. 我们提出SimForcing,这是一个模拟制导框架,它既利用模拟作为可转移运动知识的来源,又作为可控预测参考。 首先,我们通过潜在运动蒸馏将运动知识从模拟老师身上转移,将潜在空间的时间变化调整为内化运动前兆,同时减轻外观差异的影响. 第二,我们采用多块模拟条件,附带条件退出,利用预测的模拟轨迹,而不过分依赖其准确性。 我们的模拟-空调无分级制导计划通过平衡基于内化运动知识的预测和以模拟潜伏物为补充引导的预测,统一了这两种想法。 联合训练的学生既生成模拟条件,又生成真域视频,在推论上不需要额外的世界模型. 在Bridge上,SimForcing在比较方法中实现了最好的PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS和FVD,没有外部包含的预训. 对InternData-A1的评价进一步支持其适用于机器人数据集. 此外,利用我们训练有素的世界模式启动一种视觉-语言-行动模式,提高了LIBERO的成功,表明它对下游政策学习的效用。 \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong 1899/SimForcing} (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: Analysis of SWIR Imaging Detection Performance Under Adverse Environmental Conditions for Autonomous Driving Systems
articles.content: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging has emerged as a promising modality for autonomous driving, yet its practical benefits over RGB remain poorly characterized across diverse conditions. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of paired RGB and SWIR object detection on the RASMD dataset, covering four weather conditions and two real-time detection architectures, with various fine-tunings evaluated against a unified ground truth. Overall, RGB demonstrates comparable or superior performance in most scenarios, while RF-DETR exhibits greater robustness across varying conditions. Beyond aggregate metrics, we propose a sensor-dominance mining framework that combines multi-model agreement with targeted manual inspection to identify scenarios where one sensing modality provides more reliable detections using largely unannotated paired data. This analysis reveals that SWIR offers clear advantages in four safety-critical situations, including windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, low-contrast object visibility, and long-range vehicle detection. The findings suggest that SWIR should be viewed as a complementary modality that enhances perception in rare but challenging conditions. The datasets will be available upon request, and all code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis.

articles.title_zh: 分析SWIR在有害环境条件下自动驾驶系统的成像检测性能
articles.content_zh: 短波红外成像作为一种有希望的自主驾驶方式已经出现,然而,它对红外光学的实际好处在各种条件下仍不尽如人意。 本文对RASMD数据集上的配对RGB和SWIR天体检测进行了系统比较研究,涵盖4个天气条件和2个实时检测架构,并参照统一的地面真理进行了各种微调评价. 总体而言,RGB在大多数情景中表现出可比或优越的性能,而RF-DETR则在不同条件下表现出更强的稳健性. 除了总的衡量标准外,我们提议一个传感器主控采矿框架,该框架将多模式协定与有针对性的人工检查结合起来,以确定一种传感器模式利用基本上未经说明的配对数据提供更可靠的检测的情景。 这一分析表明,SWIR在四种安全关键情况下提供了明显的优势,包括挡风玻璃、挡风玻璃上的水滴、低孔隙物体可见度和远程车辆探测。 调查结果表明,应把《世界投资报告》视为一种补充模式,在罕见但具有挑战性的条件下增强人们的认识。 数据集将应要求提供,所有代码和训练有素的模型权重将在https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis上公开发布。

articles.title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
articles.content: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VGGT- Bridge: 通过粗糙的脚步跳过边缘, 超越顺序的 Pose 图
articles.content_zh: VGGT等Feed-forward直观几何变压器从图像中从单个前传重建密集的3D结构,简化多视图3D重建. 然而,它们的四面体的注意力复杂性使得它们难以在千帧的长序上缩放. Chunk-and-ign框架通过将一个长的序列分割成重叠块并将其局部重建缝合成一个姿势图来解决这个问题. 然而,现有的方法只将相邻的块连接起来,因此每帧的小错误沿着链条累积成大规模的漂移. 为了超越顺序边缘,我们提出VGGT-Bridge,它增加了远程跳过边缘,直接限制非相邻块而不进行再培训. 通过运行VGGT在鲜有样本的粗块上,每个粗块桥的细块远处形成一个单一的直接约束. 我们进一步将VGGT的第一帧比例偏差转化为漂移修正,将选定的粗块喂入逆向,循环意识政策保持了这种反转与现有的循环关闭兼容. VGGT-Bridge在KITTI Odometry上将ATE减少28.3%,在Virtual KITTI上减少18.8%,在Waymo Open上将SwiftVGGT基线减少10.0%,实现所有块和对齐方法的最佳性能.

articles.title: Keepsake: Selective Spatial Memory for Long-Horizon Video Generation
articles.content: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation relies on persistent memory to maintain scene consistency. Existing systems follow two strategies to achieve this consistency. Full-history approaches retain all generated observations, causing unbounded storage and retrieval costs. Selective-construction approaches reduce redundancy, but make one-time retention decisions that are never revisited, even as an observation's value changes with the evolving memory bank. Both strategies leave a shared question unresolved: as the generated history evolves, which stored observations should still remain in memory? Our key insight is that the value of a stored observation is not fixed, but relational: it depends on the alternatives currently available in the memory bank. A view supported by many geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be relinquished with little loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should remain regardless of age. We introduce Keepsake, an online, training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory. At each update, Keepsake constructs a pose-appearance graph over retained and newly generated observations, combining camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. A retention priority jointly captures the number of strong substitutes and the similarity of the closest alternative, allowing Keepsake to continually reassess memory value, preserve observations with little alternative support, and evict highly replaceable ones under a fixed budget. The controller modifies only the persistent-memory update; the host generator, denoising schedule, and retrieval rule remain unchanged. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS under a fixed memory budget. On 180-second MemCam trajectories, it retains only 32 of 5,397 frames while reducing FVD by 35.1%.

articles.title_zh: Keepsake: 为长视视频生成选择空间内存
articles.content_zh: 长视距摄像机控制的视频生成依赖于持续的内存来保持场景的一致性. 现有的系统遵循两项战略来实现这种一致性。 完整的历史方法保留了所有产生的观测结果,造成了不受限制的存储和检索费用。 选择性建造方法减少冗余,但作出一次性保留决定,即使作为观察值随着不断演变的内存库而有所变化,也从未再考虑过. 两种策略都留下一个共同的问题没有解决:随着产生的历史演变,哪些存储的观测数据仍应留在记忆中? 我们的关键见解是,存储的观测值不是固定的,而是关系性的:它取决于存储库中目前可用的替代品. 许多几何和视觉上相似的替代物支持的观点可以放弃,但覆盖范围很少丧失,而不论年龄,只有很少可行的替代物的观察才应该保留。 我们介绍Keepsake, 一个在线的,免费的固定容量空间内存控制器。 在每次更新时,Keepsake都会在保留和新生成的观测数据之上构建一个外观图,将相机-相机的近距离与视觉相似性结合起来. 保留优先权可共同捕捉强替代物的数量和最接近替代物的相似性,使Keepsake能够不断重新评估内存值,在几乎没有替代支持的情况下保存观测结果,并在固定预算下驱逐高度可替代的替代品. 控制器只修改持久性的模版更新;主机生成器,去诺化调度,检索规则保持不变. 在MemCam和WorldMem上,Keepsake在固定的内存预算下改进了FVD和LPIPS. 在180秒的MemCam轨距上,它只保留了5,397帧中的32帧,同时将FVD减少了35.1%.

articles.title: FrontVeg V2: A Training-Free Software Framework for Foreground-Aware Zero-Shot Plant Trait Segmentation in High-Resolution Images of Trellised Crops
articles.content: FrontVeg V2 is an open-source, training-free software framework for foregroundaware zero-shot segmentation of plant traits in high-resolution images of trellised crops. The pipeline combines monocular depth estimation, automatic foreground extraction using Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding, tiled zero-shot segmentation, Graph-Based Mask Assembly, and geometry-aware fusion. This design enables plant organs and disease symptoms to be segmented while reducing detections arising from neighboring vegetation rows. The current implementation integrates Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) and SAM3 and can be used through both command-line batch processing and a Napari graphical interface. FrontVeg V2 provides a reusable framework for multi-crop, multi-trait digital phenotyping without task-specific model retraining.

articles.title_zh: FrontVeg V2:未来-Aware Zero-Shot Planet Trit 分解高分辨率图象中的无培训软件框架
articles.content_zh: FrontVeg V2是一个开源的,无培训的软件框架,用于在颤抖作物的高分辨率图像中将植物特征零发分解. 管道结合了单体深度估计,利用谷-智能深度牵引力的自动前地提取,瓦片零发分解,基于图形的面具组装,以及几何感知聚变. 这种设计使得植物器官和疾病症状能够分化,同时减少相邻的植被线产生的检测. 目前的执行集成了深度Anything V2(DAV2)和SAM3,可以通过命令行批处理和一个Napari图形界面使用. 前导 Veg V2为多作物,多轨数字回流提供了可重复使用的框架,而无需针对特定任务的模型再培训.

articles.title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
articles.content: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments. Existing medical VQA and 3D imaging benchmarks capture important parts of this workflow, but often evaluate brain MRI through isolated images, static volumes, or ungrounded report-style answers, thereby obscuring failures in the evidence chain that support clinical validity. We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation. BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes. The benchmark is organized by five levels of clinical reasoning, from acquisition recognition to case-level synthesis, and by evidence demands covering longitudinal comparison, report-grounded references, multi-sequence integration, and volumetric spatial evidence. BrainTRACE supports rendered inputs compatible with standard VLM interfaces, a 3D-evidence condition, and a decomposed case-reasoning track that audits six steps in a longitudinal evidence chain. Evaluation of 20 VLM configurations shows that current systems can identify isolated visual cues but rarely compose them into grounded longitudinal interpretations. We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.

articles.title_zh: BrainTRACE:追踪脑磁共振中纵向、多式联运和体积证据
articles.content_zh: 大脑核磁共振解析是一个纵向临床推理问题:放射学家比较序列研究,整合所有核磁共振序列的信息,在体积解剖学中将发现本地化,并将这些证据转化为基于报告的评估. 现有的医学VQA和3D成像基准捕捉到这个工作流程的重要部分,但经常通过孤立的图像,静态卷,或无根据的报告式答案来评价脑磁共振,从而掩盖了支持临床有效性的证据链中的故障. 我们引入了BrainTRACE,这是一个基于报告的基准,用于评价视觉语言模型能否追踪纵向脑磁共振解释所需的证据结构。 BrainTRACE包含7,273个得分的VQA病例,来自1,778个纵向病人,7,299个核磁共振研究,以及约29k个共同注册的3D核磁共振序列卷. 基准按从获取识别到案例一级综合的五个临床推理层次排列,并按证据要求,涵盖纵向比较,报告依据参考,多序列结合,体积空间证据. BrainTRACE支持提供与标准VLM接口兼容的投入,一个3D-证据条件,以及一个分解的个案推理轨道,在纵向证据链中审计六个步骤。 对20个VLM配置的评价表明,目前的系统能够识别孤立的视觉提示,但很少将其编成基于底线的纵向解释. 我们公布基准规格、评价清单、评分执行、评分标题和审计记录格式,以支持脑磁共振磁共振磁共振评价的可复制进展。

articles.title: A General Pipeline for Dense Illuminant Estimation via Physically Based Synthetic Data
articles.content: Illuminant estimation is a fundamental problem in computational photography, as it enables the correction of color shifts induced by varying lighting conditions. While learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance, their progress is hindered by the limited availability of large-scale datasets with accurate illuminant ground-truth. In this work, we propose a general and reusable pipeline to derive dense illuminant chromaticity maps from physically based 3D-rendered scenes. By repurposing an existing 3D scene collection, our approach enables the systematic generation of pixel-wise illuminant annotations under controlled lighting conditions, effectively lowering the barrier to data acquisition for learning-based illuminant estimation. Using this pipeline, we generate a large-scale synthetic set of 74,321 images, which we employ for pre-training both single- and multi-illuminant estimation models. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art architectures show that synthetic pre-training consistently improves performance, with gains of up to 28% for single-illuminant estimation and up to 57% for multi-illuminant estimation, particularly in data-scarce regimes. These findings demonstrate that synthetic data generation pipelines offer an effective and scalable solution for the pre-training of illuminant estimation methods.

articles.title_zh: 透過 Dense 光亮估计的一般管道 物理合成数据
articles.content_zh: 光线估计是计算摄影中的一个基本问题,因为它能够校正因不同照明条件而诱导的色调. 虽然以学习为基础的方法表现出了强有力的业绩,但由于获得的具有准确明晰的地面真实性的大规模数据集有限,其进展受到阻碍。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个通用和可再利用的管道,从基于物理的3D的场景中得出密集的光亮色谱图. 通过重新使用现有的三维场景收集,我们的方法能够在受控的照明条件下系统生成像素明智的照明说明,有效地降低基于学习的照明估计获得数据的障碍。 利用这一管道,我们生成了一套由74,321个图像组成的大规模合成图象,我们利用这些图象来预先培训单发和多发光体估计模型。 对最先进的建筑进行的广泛实验表明,合成预训不断提高性能,单发铝估计的增益高达28%,多发铝估计的增益高达57%,特别是在数据稀缺制度中. 这些调查结果表明,合成数据生成管道为照明性估计方法的预先培训提供了有效和可扩展的解决办法。

articles.title: Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding
articles.content: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs. However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/.

articles.title_zh: 改进对分级程序理解的主动援助
articles.content_zh: 主动的AI助手不断观察用户的活动,决定是提供新的指导还是保持沉默. 它们应为这项任务提供适当的指导,确定何时根据任务进展情况提供下一个指导,并根据用户的专门知识和需要调整指导级别。 支持这些能力需要培训和评价数据,反映程序结构并掌握指导应如何适应任务进展和用户需要。 然而,现有数据集要么侧重于基于检测的主动理解,要么在固定颗粒度时提供程序指导。 固定宽度指导提供的关于细度进展和更广泛的程序背景的信息有限,因此难以确定完成和调整指导颗粒性。 为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了 " 主动行动Coach " 套房,其中包括 " 主动行动Coach-Instructiont用于培训 " 套房、 " 主动行动Coach Bench用于评估 " 套房,以及具有适应性指导系统的微调VLM套房。 积极主动的Coach-Instruction在阶段、步骤和行动层面为学习任务的进展和程序背景提供分级结构的指导。 积极主动的Coach Bench评价模型是否在不同指导层次的正确时间提供适当的指导,并在要求的水平发生变化时进行调整. 我们精细地调整预先培训的关于主动Coach-Information的VLM,并展示其跨骨干部门的有效性. 与定格监督相比,分级监督可以提高整个骨干部门的整体表现,最高可达9.6%p. 我们进一步构建适应性引导体系,将微调模型与轻量级引导路由器相结合. 如果没有额外的微调,我们的系统在4个指导级过渡中比内衬适应基准运行率高出57.1%p. 我们的项目网页可在https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/上查阅。

articles.title: Harmful Content Generation in Text-to-Image Models: Capabilities and Moderation Limitations
articles.content: Text-to-image generative models can produce highly realistic imagery but also raise concerns about harmful misuse. While safety mechanisms exist, systematic evaluations of their effectiveness against realistic attacks remain limited. We present a systematic evaluation of harmful content generation across five open text-to-image models using an automated pipeline that transforms legitimate news captions into unsafe prompts targeting sexually explicit content, violence/gore, harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. We evaluate both standard models with built-in safety mechanisms and community fine-tuned variants that bypass content restrictions. A human evaluation of 1,500 generated images shows high harmful-content generation rates: 89.2% for gore-related prompts, 47.6% for sexually explicit content, 43.6% for harmful stereotypes, 46.0% for hate speech, and 34.5% for self-harm, predominantly through graphic violence. Models show substantial capability for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community fine-tuned variants are particularly vulnerable to sexually explicit prompts. Generation quality is largely preserved under harmful prompting, producing imagery of sufficient fidelity to pose risks for disinformation and abuse; FLUX.1-dev produces clearly realistic harmful images in 30.9% of cases. We further evaluate automated moderation systems and find substantial detection gaps that allow unsafe images to evade filtering. Finally, we assess synthetic image detectors and show that models trained only on benign datasets perform worse on explicit content, while more diverse training data improves detection, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current approaches. These findings expose limitations in current generation safeguards, moderation systems, and synthetic image detection, highlighting the need for stronger defenses against misuse at scale.

articles.title_zh: 文本到图像模型中的有害内容生成:能力和适度限制
articles.content_zh: 文字到图像基因模型可以产生非常现实的图像,但也引起对有害滥用的关切。 虽然存在安全机制,但系统评估其针对现实攻击的效力仍然有限。 我们利用自动管道, 将合法新闻字幕转化为针对性内容、暴力/亵渎、有害定型观念、自我伤害和仇恨言论的不安全诱因。 我们评价既有内置安全机制的标准模型,也有绕过内容限制的社区微调变体。 对1,500个生成的图像进行的人类评价显示,有害内容生成率很高:89.2%与腺有关,47.6%与性有关的明显内容,43.6%与有害的定型观念有关,46.0%与仇恨言论有关,34.5%与自我伤害有关,主要是通过图形暴力造成的。 模型显示出产生暴力和陈规定型内容的强大能力,而社区微调的变体则特别容易受到明显的性诱因的影响。 在有害的催化下,世代的质量基本上得到保存,产生足够忠实的图像,从而对造谣和滥用行为构成风险;FLUX.1-dev在30.9%的案例中产生明显现实的有害图像。 我们进一步评估自动节制系统,发现大量探测漏洞,使不安全的图像能够逃避过滤。 最后,我们评估合成图像探测器,并显示只接受良性数据集培训的模型在明确内容方面表现更差,而更加多样化的培训数据则改进了探测,突出了当前方法中的语义分布差距. 这些结论暴露了当前一代保障、温和系统和合成图像探测方面的局限性,突出表明有必要加强防范,防止大规模滥用。

articles.title: NeuroCBIR: A Fast and Accurate Image Retrieval System for Whole-Brain and Region-Specific MRI
articles.content:
Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) in neuroimaging enables the identification of structurally similar brain scans, supporting diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning; however, existing methods are often limited to small datasets, single brain regions, or coarse class labels, thereby restricting their clinical utility and generalizability.
  Here, we present NeuroCBIR, a framework for fast and flexible retrieval of both whole-brain and region-specific 3D T1w MRI scans. A total of 103 cortical and subcortical regions are extracted to enable both whole-brain and region-level queries.
  NeuroCBIR leverages latent representations learned by a variational autoencoder (VAE) combined with contrastive learning, producing scan-specific embeddings that capture anatomical patterns. These embeddings were evaluated for subject re-identification, zero-shot age prediction, and zero-shot multi-class pathology stratification. Re-identification performance was high across both whole-brain and brain-region levels (mean average precision across the top-5 retrieved images (mAP@5) >= 98.4%), with robust generalization across datasets and acquisition conditions. While NeuroCBIR is not trained for age prediction or pathology stratification, zero-shot evaluations for these two tasks demonstrate that the embeddings encode meaningful information for downstream tasks.
  Embedding extraction on a 4-core CPU required approximately 18.7 s per scan, whereas similarity search was effectively instantaneous (less than 0.01 s).
  NeuroCBIR is publicly available for brain MRI with more than 26,000 precomputed T1w MRI embeddings. It supports reproducible research, region-specific flexibility, and clinically meaningful personalized diagnostic support. The software is available at https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR.

articles.title_zh: NeuroCBIR:一个快速准确的图像检索系统,用于全脑和区域特定磁共振
articles.content_zh:
神经成像中基于内容的图像检索(CBIR)能够识别结构相似的脑扫描,支持诊断,预后,和治疗规划;然而,现有方法往往仅限于小数据集,单脑区域,或粗细的类标签,从而限制了其临床实用性和通俗性.
这里,我们介绍神经CBIR,这是快速和灵活检索全脑和区域特异性3D T1w磁共振扫描的框架. 共有103个皮层和亚层区域被提取出来,以便进行全脑和区域层面的查询。
NeuroCBIR利用了一种变异自编码器(VAE)与对比性学习相结合而获得的潜在表达,产生了能够捕捉解剖规律的扫描特异性嵌入. 这些嵌入被评价为主题重新识别,零射龄预测,零射多级病理分层. 整个大脑和大脑区域层面的重新识别性能都很高(平均精确度在最高5级检索到的图像(mAP@5)),98.4%,在数据集和获取条件之间进行了有力的概括。 虽然NeuroCBIR没有接受过年龄预测或病理分层培训,但这两项任务的零镜头评价表明,嵌入物为下游任务编码了有意义的信息.
在4个核心CPU上嵌入提取需要约18.7s的每次扫描,而相似性搜索实际上是瞬时的(少于0.01s).
神经CBIR可公开用于大脑核磁共振,有超过26,000个预计算T1w核磁共振嵌入. 它支持可复制的研究,针对特定区域的灵活性,以及临床上有意义的个性化诊断支持. 该软件可在https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR上查阅。

articles.title: Topology-Informed Prompt-Conditioned Universal Segmentation of Uterine Structures from Ultrasound and MRI
articles.content: Multi-structure segmentation of the uterus is important for computer-assisted screening, diagnosis, and treatment planning of uterine diseases, where ultrasound and MRI provide complementary clinical information. However, developing a unified model across these modalities is challenging due to their substantially different image appearances, anatomical contexts, spatial resolutions, and label spaces. Moreover, existing datasets often define different segmentation targets, making joint learning challenging and potentially leading to negative transfer across heterogeneous tasks. To this end, we propose a Topology-informed Prompt-conditioned Universal Segmentation (TPUS) framework for segmenting multiple uterine structures across ultrasound and MRI. TPUS introduces a graph-based multi-dataset backbone comprising modality-specific stems and a modality-shared graph-based encoder-decoder to support modality-sensitive input adaptation, structural feature reasoning, and joint representation learning across heterogeneous uterine segmentation tasks. In addition, TPUS uses task-aware class prompts to condition the segmentation process for different datasets and label spaces, a dynamic convolutional adaptation module to generate task-specific output responses, and a topology-informed loss to encourage anatomically consistent predictions. Experiments on a uterine ultrasound dataset and a T2-weighted uterine myoma MRI dataset demonstrate that TPUS achieves Dice scores of 0.898 and 0.693 on the two held-out test sets, respectively, outperforming several generic and universal segmentation baselines. Source code can be accessed at https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/TPUS.

articles.title_zh: 来自超声波和磁共振的Uterine结构的 地形-成形 快速-有条件的通用分解
articles.content_zh: 子宫的多结构分化对于计算机辅助的子宫疾病的筛选,诊断和治疗规划很重要,其中超声波和核磁共振提供了补充的临床信息. 然而,由于这些模式的图像外观、解剖背景、空间分辨率和标签空间差别很大,因此在所有这些模式中开发一个统一的模型具有挑战性。 此外,现有数据集往往界定不同的分化目标,使联合学习具有挑战性,并可能导致不同任务之间的负转移。 为此,我们提出一个地形学信息灵通的快速全域分解框架,用于跨超声波和磁共振的多个子宫结构分解。 TPUS引入了基于图表的多数据集主干线,包括模式特定根和一个模式共享的基于图形的编码器-解码器,以支持模式敏感输入的适应,结构特征推理,以及跨不同子宫分裂任务的联合代表学习. 此外,TPUS使用任务感知类提示来对不同数据集和标签空格的分割过程进行条件化,一个动态的演化适应模块来生成任务特定输出响应,以及一个地形学知情的损失来鼓励解剖一致的预测. 对子宫超声数据集和T2加权子宫肌瘤核磁共振数据集的实验表明,TPUS在两个停产测试组上分别达到0.898分和0.693分,超过了几个通用和通用分化基线。 资料来源:https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/TPUS。

articles.title: MaRO-GS: Mask-Robust Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting from Inconsistent Multi-view Masks
articles.content: We address the challenge of accurate 3D object reconstruction from multi-view images in Gaussian Splatting. Existing object-level 3DGS methods reconstruct the entire scene rather than directly optimizing the target object, even when only the target object is needed, which incurs substantial computational overhead. They also rely on 2D segmentation masks to associate Gaussians with objects, but these masks are often inconsistent across views. Such inconsistencies corrupt Gaussian optimization and produce incorrectly supervised Gaussians that degrade object reconstruction fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose MaRO-GS, a 3DGS framework that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images and remains robust to inconsistent supervision. For reliable supervision, mask-reliability view filtering excludes unreliable views. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and prevents background densification, while Silhouette-aligned Object Loss maintains object-focused optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency, with the largest PSNR gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset.

articles.title_zh: MaRO-GS:面具-罗布斯特对象-Centric Gaussian 镀层来自不一致的多视图面具
articles.content_zh: 我们从高斯白板上的多视图图像来应对精确3D对象重建的挑战. 现有的对象级3DGS方法重建了整个场景,而不是直接优化目标对象,即使只需要目标对象,这需要大量的计算间接费用. 他们还依靠2D分割口罩将高斯人与物体联系起来,但这些口罩往往在各种观点上不一致. 这种不一致现象腐蚀了高斯优化,并产生了被错误监督的高斯人,使对象重建忠贞性退化. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议MaRO-GS,一个3DGS框架,它直接从物体的多视图图像中优化目标对象高斯人,并保持强势,不连贯地进行监督. 对于可靠的监督,遮罩可靠性视图过滤排除了不可靠的视图. 支持对象的高斯密度控制压制与目标对象无关的高斯人,防止背景密度化,而Silhouette-accessed Object Loss则保持对焦对象的优化. 跨越各种数据集的广泛实验表明,MaRO-GS提高了PSNR,分区精度和计算效率,在LERF-Mask小对象数据集上PSNR的最大收益为2.05 dB.

articles.title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
articles.content: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.

articles.title_zh: 实现可靠的婴儿乳糖估计:对无声注释检测的培训动态方法
articles.content_zh: 早产婴儿的自发运动分析越来越依赖于无标记的姿势估计(PE),直接通过录像得出临床相关的运动生物标记。 训练准确的婴儿PE模型需要大量手动附加说明的键点,而人的注释本身容易出错. 噪音的关键点(即其真实解剖位置的错位关键点)在这种临床环境中尤其成问题,因为它们可以作为人工文物传播到重建的联合轨道。 根据在吵闹标签学习文献中确立的小损失假说和基于训练动力学的样本选择,我们提出了一个用于检测吵闹关键点说明的新框架。 培训了一个混合进化-注意模型,从其空间坐标和当地视觉特征来预测每个关键点的解剖类别;然后利用由此产生的交叉进化训练动态来得出每个关键点的描述符,这些描述符通过不受监督的集群被分割成干净而吵闹的子集. 我们验证了NeoPose(新收集的65名住院早产婴儿的数据集)的方法,这是在两种现实噪声情景下(随机位置扰动和左偏右交换),跨越多个噪声水平. 结果显示,拟议办法在高音键检测中达到高达91.9%的F1分数。 该框架进一步概括了各种COCO基准,从培训集中过滤出CE-探测到的吵闹关键点,在下游也会产生可衡量的改进(最多7.4个AP点),在中高噪音水平上形成估计准确性。

articles.title: SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs
articles.content: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.
