articles.title_zh: 空间 链条:VLMs空间理性信念审计基准
articles.content_zh: 思维驱动的视觉语言模型(VLMs)报告空间基准的精确度越来越高,然而最终的答案分数无法揭示一个正确的预测是反映了忠实的空间推理还是语言快捷键. 我们引入了SpaceChain,一个由28,350个培训和899个测试实例组成的数据集,将面向空间的GQA问题与场景绘图的推理链联系起来,仅在生成的答案与象征性的地面真相相符时才予以保留,并采用两轴评价,将客观的链条重叠度量度与场景绘图的LLM评分与最终答案分开进行。 适用于9种思维驱动的VLM, 协议表露出3种对标准准确性看不见的发现:(一) 9种模型中有4种实现$\geq$79%的VQA精度,同时显示的快捷率高于39%,即正确答案,其推理被判断者标为不忠;(二) 链质显著预测了9种模型中7种的正确性,但两种例外(Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B)揭示了质的截然不同的失败模式,terse输出对s. verbose-decorative exculation, 将精确性作为基准单曲面计算;(三) SpaceChain上的SFT通过+6.2pp的内行改进了Qwen3-VL-8B,并将其快捷率降低到22%,同时对外部基准的一种结构化专业化效应激励了将培训作为缓解。 忠诚法官根据198项人与人之间的协议与人与人之间的协议相符的附加说明进行鉴定,而另一个提供商的第二名法官则维持模式排名(美元=0.88美元)。 数据,生成脚本,评价代码在https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChain Benchmark发布.

articles.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Training-Free Human-Object Interaction Detection
articles.content: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize human-object pairs and recognize their interactions. Traditional supervised methods perform strongly but rely on task-specific training. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising route to training-free HOI detection through their broad visual-semantic knowledge and versatile perceptual and reasoning capabilities. However, existing approaches largely invoke these capabilities through loosely coordinated inference stages. This fragmented execution restricts the role of interaction hypotheses in guiding visual exploration, leaving key participants overlooked and local ambiguities unresolved. Furthermore, propagating early semantic assumptions through subsequent visual grounding and relation prediction induces self-reinforcing semantic circularity. To resolve these challenges, we propose HarnessHOI, a training-free framework that transforms passive MLLM inference into an active interaction-centric harness. Specifically, we introduce an interaction-guided perception mechanism that projects emerging interaction hypotheses back into the visual space to discover missing participants and refine ambiguous evidence through targeted observation. Furthermore, a relation-agnostic geometric adjudication module reconciles multi-source evidence to establish a unified spatial basis for grounded interaction reasoning across multiple actions and semantic roles. Extensive experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO demonstrate that HarnessHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed harness for complex interaction understanding. Code will be released upon publication.

articles.title_zh: 利用多式联运 培训-无人类-对象互动检测大语言模型
articles.content_zh: 人体-物体相互作用(HOI)检测旨在定位人体-物体对并识别其相互作用. 传统监督方法运作有力,但依靠具体任务的培训。 最近的多式联运大型语言模型通过其广泛的视觉语义知识和多功能的认知和推理能力,为无培训的HOI检测提供了一条很有希望的道路。 然而,现有办法主要通过松散协调的推论阶段来利用这些能力。 这种支离破碎的执行限制了互动假说在指导视觉探索中的作用,使关键参与者被忽视,地方模糊不清问题得不到解决. 此外,通过随后的视觉地基和关系预测来传播早期语义假设,会诱发自我增强的语义循环. 为了解决这些挑战,我们提议HarnessHOI,一个无培训框架,将被动的MLLM推论转变为积极的以互动为中心的工具。 具体地说,我们引入了一种互动指导感知机制,将新出现的互动假说投射回视觉空间,以发现缺失的参与者,并通过有针对性的观察来完善模棱两可的证据. 此外,一个关系不可知几何判断模块调和了多源证据,为跨多个行动和语义角色的基于互动推理建立统一的空间基础. 有关HICO-DET和V-COCO的广泛实验表明,HarnessHOI在无培训方法中实现了最先进的性能,证实了拟议利用以复杂互动理解的有效性. 守则将在出版后公布。

articles.title: Multi-Task Partially Supervised Learning for Super-Resolution and Semantic Segmentation on Earth Observation data
articles.content: Super-resolution and semantic segmentation are known to benefit one another, especially in the Earth observation context. However, learning both tasks in a joint model often requires both task annotations, which is impractical and expensive. In this paper, we study the multi-task partially supervised learning paradigm for both tasks, where each example is assumed to have only a single-task annotation. To that end, we examine two multi-task architectural variations, the sequential and shared variants, and then propose a hybrid variant and a re-projection loss to benefit from the shared representation and enforce image quality of super-resolution when training with semantic segmentation. Experiments show favorable results compared to the SOTA sequential variant. Source code will be published at https://github.com/lhoangan/munera.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 地球观测数据超分辨率和语义分解部分监督学习
articles.content_zh: 超分辨率和语义分解已知相互有利,特别是在地球观测方面。 然而,在联合模式中学习这两项任务往往需要两种任务说明,这既不切实际,又昂贵。 在本文中,我们研究了两个任务的多任务部分监督学习范式,其中每个例子都假定只有一个任务注释. 为此,我们研究了两个多任务建筑变体,即顺序变体和共享变体,然后提出混合变体和再投射损失,以便在进行语义分解培训时,从共享的表示和强制超分辨率的图像质量中获益. 与SOTA相继变体相比,实验显示出有利的结果. 来源代码将在https://github.com/lhoangan/munera上公布。

articles.title: MTOR: Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection with Multimodal Semantics and Temporal Over-Regularity
articles.content: The rapid evolution of video generation has narrowed the perceptual gap between authentic and synthetic videos, making generalizable AI-generated video detection increasingly challenging. Existing detectors predominantly rely on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics underexplored. Meanwhile, temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations has received limited attention. We find that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations. Our analysis further reveals that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and lower temporal variability, a pattern we term temporal over-regularity (TOR). Based on these findings, we propose MTOR with a multimodal branch and a TOR component. The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, while the TOR component models temporal over-regularity at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks covering 46 generator variants demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance against 16 representative baselines, while robustness experiments confirm strong resilience to twelve real-world video perturbations. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/hwang-cs-ime/MTOR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MTOR:通用AI-Generated视频侦测,多模式语义和时序超规范
articles.content_zh: 视频生成的快速演变缩小了真实视频和合成视频之间的认知差距,使得通用AI生成的视频检测越来越具有挑战性. 现有的探测器主要依靠视觉表现,使得字幕衍生的文字语义被低估. 同时,精致视觉表现中的时间规律性受到的关注有限. 我们认为,字幕衍生的文字表述为全球视觉表述提供了补充性的歧视性提示。 我们的分析进一步揭示出人工智能制作的视频表现出更强的时间持久性和较低的时间变异性,我们称之为时间超常(TOR)的模式. 根据这些调查结果,我们提议建立具有多式联运分支和职权范围组成部分的MTOR。 多式联运分支整合了全球视觉和字幕衍生的文字表述,而TOR组件则在三个层次上模拟了时间超常性:粗细的帧间连续性,细细的纹章对应,以及帧到视频的稳定性. 对涉及46个发电机变体的5个基准的广泛评价显示,相对于16个具有代表性的基准而言,最新的总体业绩,而强健性实验则证实,对12个真实世界的视频干扰具有强大的复原力。 代码和模型将在https://github.com/hwang-cs-ime/MTOR上发布.

articles.title: Environmental sensor readings in two crop disease image datasets identify the session in which each image was taken
articles.content: Integrating environmental sensor data with leaf imagery is widely reported to boost crop disease classification accuracy. In this work, we reveal that these reported gains are often artifacts of dataset construction: because a single sensor reading is shared across many images collected in a single session (one farm on one date), multimodal networks can predict disease simply by memorizing session identities. Analyzing two widely used Korean datasets, the Crop Disease Diagnosis (CDD) benchmark and an AI Hub pest/disease dataset, we demonstrate that nearly all images share sensor values, with 91.9% of CDD test images having exact sensor duplicates in the training set. Remarkably, an image-free classifier given only timestamps matches or exceeds sensor-driven predictions across all seven evaluated crops, and matches the published macro-F1 of a state-of-the-art CDD fusion model. These results indicate that performance gains on standard random splits cannot be disentangled from session leakage. We propose that multimodal crop studies must evaluate on session-held-out splits and report performance against sensor-free date-time baselines to ensure genuine generalization.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 两个作物病成像数据集的环境传感器读数确定每个图像拍摄的会话
articles.content_zh: 广泛报告称,将环境传感器数据与叶子图象相结合可提高作物疾病分类的准确性。 在这项工作中,我们透露,这些所报告的收益往往是数据集构建的文物:由于单个传感器读数在单个会议(一个农场在一个日期)收集的许多图像中共享,多式联运网络只能通过记忆会议身份来预测疾病。 我们分析了两个广泛使用的韩国数据集,即作物疾病诊断基准和一个AI Hub虫害/疾病数据集,我们表明几乎所有的图像都共享传感器值,91.9%的CDD测试图像在培训集中有精确的传感器重复. 值得注意的是,一个只给出时间戳的无图像分类器与所有7种评价作物的传感器驱动预测相匹配或超过,并匹配已公布的最先进的CDD聚变模型的宏-F1。 这些结果表明,标准随机分割的性能收益不能与会话渗漏分开. 我们建议,多式联运作物研究必须对分会场进行评估,并对照无传感器的日期-时间基线报告业绩,以确保真正的普遍性。

articles.title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
articles.content: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: KineWorld:促进健全世界模型建设的由行动带动的运输领域
articles.content_zh: 健全的世界模型预测执行前候选人行动的视觉后果. 然而,现有的有行动条件的世界模型往往采用统一加权的视觉生成目标,而这些目标可能与包含的预测需求不相符。 即使有明确的运动条件,这些目标也可能低估对互动至关重要的空间稀少变化。 我们提出KineWorld,一个具有交通意识的世界模型框架,将机器人动能从运动调节扩展到基因监督的空间分配. Kinematic Transport Lifting(KTL)从受命机器人运动中构造出由渲染器衍生的相机对接的运输场. Transport-Award World Difusion(TAWD)通过统一和交通集中分布的规范混合,校准其在视网格上的运动支持,并对未来-RGB的流量进行重新加权匹配. 我们使用来自RoboTwin 2.0的ALOHA-AgileX双人操纵数据来训练KineWorld. KineWorld在单景评价中实现了68.95的EWMScore-P,在多景评价中实现了54.82的TWB-Score. 这些结果支持从外观适合转向为体现的决策制定行动后果模式。

articles.title: MeSD: Multi-Evidence Self-Distillation for VideoLLM
articles.content: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides reliable outcome supervision for VideoLLMs, sequence-level rewards offer limited token-level guidance. On-policy self-distillation addresses this limitation by conditioning a self-teacher on privileged information to provide dense token-level supervision. However, aggregating heterogeneous evidence within a single teacher context obscures cross-evidence agreement and conflict. A further challenge lies in determining whether teacher guidance should refine reward-based updates or provide corrective supervision for failed trajectories. To address these issues, we propose MeSD, a multi-evidence self-distillation framework for VideoLLMs. MeSD constructs three evidence-conditioned teachers with shared parameters, using the ground-truth answer as a common semantic context while separately incorporating temporal and spatial evidence. Given the same student-generated prefixes, MeSD evaluates evidence-specific preferences relative to the Answer Teacher and fuses teacher-common preferences with gated teacher-specific residuals. Furthermore, MeSD introduces Verification-Guided Optimization to classify trajectories as Success, Failure, or Indeterminate. For Success and Indeterminate trajectories, MeSD refines token-level advantage magnitudes while preserving reward-derived signs. For verified failure trajectories that contain the required evidence, MeSD applies failure-conditioned distillation, using reverse-KL correction toward the fused distribution. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MeSD: VideoLLM 的多证据自控
articles.content_zh: 虽然有可核查奖励的强化学习为VideoLLMs提供了可靠的成果监督,但序列级奖励提供有限的象征性指导。 政策上的自我消化解决了这一限制,要求自学生掌握特殊信息,提供密集的象征性监督。 然而,将各种证据汇总到单一的教师环境中,掩盖了交叉证据协议和冲突。 另一个挑战在于确定教师指导应改进基于奖励的更新,还是对失败的轨迹进行纠正监督。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议MeSD,一个VideoLLMs的多证据自我消化框架。 MeSD用共同的参数构建了三个有证据条件的教师,将地面真实答案作为共同的语义背景,同时将时间和空间证据分开。 鉴于学生产生的前缀相同,MeSD评价了与回答教师相关的具体证据偏好,并将教师的共同偏好与门式教师特有的偏好结合。 此外,MeSD引入了核查导向优化,将轨迹归类为成功、失败或不确定。 对于成功和不确定的轨迹,MeSD在保留奖励产生的标志的同时,完善了象征级的优势级. 对于含有所需证据的经核实的故障轨迹,MeSD采用故障条件蒸馏法,对引信分布进行反向KL修正。 对多个视频基准的实验表明,在强化学习和自我消化基线方面,不断取得进展。

articles.title: BabelFake: A Multilingual Audio-Visual DeepFake Benchmark
articles.content: Reliable and practical audio-visual DeepFake detection requires benchmarks that reflect diverse linguistic contexts and modern data synthesis pipelines for visual as well as audio manipulations. However, existing datasets predominantly contain footage of English-speakers, often include outdated manipulation types, or overlook the audio modality. Further, many datasets feature individuals who did not consent to be used in DeepFake creation. We introduce BabelFake, a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants. BabelFake contains 399k clips (1,323 hours) from 496 individuals spanning five languages (English, German, Italian, French, Spanish). Our modular data generation pipeline pairs 11 modern video manipulation methods with 4 voice cloning engines, distinguishing visual-only (face swapping) and joint audio-visual manipulations (lip synchronization and portrait animation). By benchmarking state-of-the-art detectors, we show that detection difficulty depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance degradation when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-language/demographic evaluation reveals sensitivity varying across detector architectures and training data, while human evaluation reveals that perceived realism and machine-detection difficulty do not necessarily align.

articles.title_zh: Babel Fake: 多语言视听深层假基准
articles.content_zh: 可靠和实用的视听DeepFake探测需要反映不同语言背景的基准和用于视觉和音频操纵的现代数据合成管道。 然而,现有的数据集主要包含英语语言的镜头,往往包括过时的操控类型,或者忽略了音频模式. 此外,许多数据集的特征是不同意用于DeepFake创建的个人。 我们介绍Babel Fake,这是经同意的与会者记录的多语种视听DeepFake基准。 BabelFake包含399k剪辑(1,323小时),来自496个人,跨越5种语言(英语,德语,意大利语,法语,西班牙语). 我们的模块化数据生成管道配对了11个现代视频操纵方法,配有4个语音克隆引擎,区分了唯视(面值互换)和联合视听操纵(唇同步和肖像动画). 通过设定最先进的探测器的基准,我们显示探测难度取决于视听生成的配对,当真实的音频被保存时,其性能会大幅退化. 跨语言/人口评价显示,探测器结构和培训数据的敏感性各不相同,而人类评价则显示,所认为的现实主义和机器探测困难不一定一致。

articles.title: SPIN: Image Immunization Against Diffusion Editing via Single-Step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods
articles.content: Diffusion models have greatly advanced instruction-guided image editing, while also raising concerns about unauthorized image manipulation. Image immunization addresses this risk by adding imperceptible perturbations to an input image to disrupt subsequent edits. Since editing requests are unknown at image release, protection should remain effective beyond the instruction used to construct the perturbation. Existing immunization methods either require costly full-trajectory backpropagation or use intermediate objectives whose effects may be weakened by subsequent denoising. Meanwhile, a single inference path provides limited feedback about alternative denoising continuations. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{SPIN}, a framework for image immunization via one-step projection over local stochastic trajectory neighborhoods. Starting from an early denoising state, \textsc{SPIN} generates stochastic neighboring states under the same instruction and predicts their clean latents through one-step projection without full unrolling. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average deviation of these predictions from a clean-edit reference, encouraging the perturbation to disrupt multiple possible editing outcomes. Experiments on two image editors demonstrate substantial gains in protection performance, with \textsc{SPIN} outperforming compared methods across all six metrics under seen instructions and in the more challenging unseen instruction setting.

articles.title_zh: SPIN: 图像免疫 防止传播 通过 Stochastic Neignborhoods 的单步投影编辑
articles.content_zh: 扩散模型大大推进了指令制导图像编辑,同时也引起了对未经授权的图像操纵的关注. 图像免疫通过在输入图像中增加难以察觉的扰动来应对这一风险,以干扰随后的编辑. 由于在图像发布时编辑请求并不为人所知,因此保护工作应该继续有效,超出用于构建扰动的指令. 现有的免疫方法要么需要昂贵的全射线反射,要么使用中间目标,其影响可能因随后的去诺而削弱。 同时,一个单一的推论路径对替代的去名续作提供了有限的反馈. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出\textsc{SPIN},即一个通过单步投影对当地有条理的轨迹街区进行图像免疫的框架。 从早期的去诺状态开始,\ textsc{SPIN} 在同一指令下生成有条理的邻邦, 并且通过单步投影来预测其清洁的潜伏状态, 而不会完全不滚动 。 然后,我们优化了限制输入扰动,以尽量扩大这些预测与清洁编辑参考的平均偏差,鼓励扰动干扰多种可能的编辑结果。 对两个图像编辑器的实验表明,在保护性能方面,\textsc{SPIN}在根据可见指示和更具挑战性的无形指示设置下,所有六个度量的比较方法都比比较好。

articles.title: Dual Variational Autoencoders for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Low-Cost Robotic Navigation
articles.content: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model's efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.

articles.title_zh: 在低成本机器人导航中高效Sim至Real传输的双变量自动编码器
articles.content_zh: 低成本机器人基于愿景的自主导航仍然是一个根本性的挑战,主要原因是模拟培训环境和现实世界的运行条件之间存在巨大差距。 从模拟中直接转移政策往往没有效果,而仅就真实数据进行培训是不切实际的。 我们提出一个混合转移学习框架,通过将域随机化与特征级域适应性相结合,有效弥合模拟-现实差距. 我们的方法采用双旋变异自编码器结构,采用共用的解码器,训练有45225幅模拟图像的庞大集以及只有4556幅真实世界样本的最小集. 这一架构学习了一种紧凑、共同的潜在代表空间,使这两个领域的分布一致。 两种补充数据增强技术进一步加强了适应进程,这些技术旨在扩大有限的现实世界数据。 实验评估显示,我们的方法在真实世界室内导航图像分类任务上取得了近91%的平均成功率,大大超过模拟和真实世界的训练。 我们通过一种直接的、现实世界的部署来验证这些结果,在这种部署中,拟议的政策成功地指导了一个低成本的机器人从事被动的探索任务。 此外,我们通过严格的计算估算来验证该模型的效率,确认其是否适合Raspberry Pi 4和NVIDIA Jetson Nano等资源紧张的嵌入式平台。 这项工作为制定低成本机器人系统的有效和高效导航政策提供了一个切实可行的解决办法。

articles.title: Readout Blindness: VLM Scores Miss the Spatial Direction Their Frozen Encoders Retain
articles.content: CLIP-like vision-language models remain a cornerstone of multimodal systems, yet their scores stay near chance on directed spatial relations, such as whether one object is left of another. We call this failure readout blindness and analyze, theoretically and empirically, why deployed scores miss the direction: when scoring rules treat the subject and object symmetrically, direction cancels regardless of encoder training. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR), which aligns caption words with image patches in the frozen features and scores each relation by the signed displacement between matched object centroids. Notably, ADR succeeds without additional training or learned parameters, thereby demonstrating that directional information remains in the frozen encoder. However, text and world priors can inflate accuracy, so we further introduce prior deflation, which measures the benefit of the image-text pairing as the grounded gain over a null that pairs each item with an unrelated image. Extensive experiments across encoder families show that ADR substantially improves over deployed scores, which remain near chance on most direction-balanced sets even for fine-tuned encoders. Compared with more complex readouts, ADR outperforms the evaluated MLLM likelihood readouts and is competitive with their chat inference at a small fraction of the computation. These results support our claim that directional information can be recovered from frozen features by an appropriate readout. Our implementation and evaluation kit will be publicly available.

articles.title_zh: 读出盲: VLM 记分器错过空间方向 其冻结编码器保留
articles.content_zh: 类似CLIP的视觉语言模型仍然是多式联运系统的基石,但其得分在定向空间关系上仍然几乎是偶然的,例如一个物体是否属于另一个物体。 我们称这种失败读出失明,并在理论上和经验上分析为什么部署的分数错失方向:当评分规则对准对象和对象时,不管编码器训练如何,方向都会取消. 在这项分析的指导下,我们引入了“反对称异位读取法”(ADR),它将标题词与冷冻特性中的图像补丁对齐,并将每个关系通过匹配对象百分数之间的签名异位来评分。 值得注意的是,ADR在没有额外培训或学习到的参数的情况下取得成功,从而表明方向信息仍留在冻结编码器中。 然而,文本和世界前传可以提高准确性,因此我们进一步引入了先前的通货紧缩,它衡量图像文本对等的好处,作为对每个项目进行无关联图像配对的无效项目的固定收益。 对编码器家庭的广泛实验表明,ADR比部署的分数大有改进,在大多数方向平衡的套件上,即使对编码器进行微调,这些分数也几乎是可能的。 与更加复杂的读出相比,ADR比被评价的MLLM概率读出要好,并且在一小部分的计算中与他们的聊天推论具有竞争力. 这些结果证实了我们的主张,即方向信息可以通过适当的读取从冻结的特性中恢复. 我们的执行和评价工具包将公开提供。

articles.title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
articles.content: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 线条事项:在远景规划-语言-行动政策中注入地形学和首字母化
articles.content_zh: 支付能力监督是视觉语言行动(VLA)政策的一个吸引人的辅助信号,然而天真地共同训练支付能力头头会严重损害后续的教学。 我们提出了关于如何在LIBERO基准上将这种头钉成现代VLA的受控研究. 我们的食谱读取骨干 通过一个停止升级 并重新注入中间头的功能 通过一个学习的桥梁 进入动作专家。 停止升级是一个先决条件:让负担梯度达到骨干将政策降低到无头基底以下(85.5%对93.1%)。 在骨干保护下,同一预算的2*2在注射地形(结合与剩余)和桥面初始化(零与随机)显示初始化是主导杠杆. 最佳线路是一座积极初始化的残余桥梁,达到96.2%,与更加精心的三位专家AffonanceVLA(95.8%)匹配,不足1%的额外参数。 有两个探测器解释了这一机制:地面-真实承受能力作为输入伤害提供,推论时间零化显示懒惰的桥梁仅起到训练时间调节器的作用,而活动桥则具有负载性。

articles.title: VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in video understanding, yet their reliance on retrospective summarization and text-centric priors often limits their ability to bridge unobserved causal transitions when applied to Video Event Prediction (VEP). To address this, we propose VepAgent, an agentic framework that integrates causal-transition reasoning with tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) for robust VEP. Unlike prior methods that passively project future trajectories from historical dependencies, our approach explicitly models the logical progression from terminal observed states to future events. Specifically, we first construct futurebench-4K, a high-quality chain-of-thought dataset for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) that effectively bridges the causal-logic gap by structuring the deduction of unobserved intermediate states. Subsequently, we develop a diagnostic tool library integrating state tracking, frame retrieval, and region magnification, enabling the agent to dynamically augment reasoning with external tools to recover missing spatio-temporal evidence and resolve visual ambiguities during inference. Moreover, we propose a composite reward mechanism that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy, causal coherence, and reliable prior, compelling the agent to rely on genuine visual grounding rather than superficial textual similarities. Extensive evaluations on FutureBench and NEPBench datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming larger MLLMs and validating the empirical effectiveness of our agentic, future-oriented reasoning paradigm.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VepAgent:通过视频事件预测工具强化学习来弥补因果过渡
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视频理解方面表现出了显著的潜力,然而,它们依赖追溯性总结和以文字为中心的前传往往限制了它们在适用于视频事件预测(VEP)时连接无法观察到的因果过渡的能力。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议VepAgent,这是一个将因果过渡推理与工具强化学习相结合的代理框架,用于强大的VEP. 与以往被动预测未来轨迹的方法不同,我们的方法明确模拟了从终端观测状态到未来事件的逻辑进展。 具体地说,我们首先构建了Futurebench-4K,这是用于有监督的微调(SFT)的高质量的思维链数据集,它通过对未观测到的中间状态的扣减结构,有效地弥合了因果关系差距。 随后,我们开发了一个诊断工具库,将状态跟踪、帧检索和区域放大结合起来,使代理能够用外部工具动态增强推理,以恢复缺失的时空证据,并在推论中解决视觉模糊问题。 此外,我们建议建立一个综合奖励机制,共同优化预测的准确性、因果一致性和可靠的先验性,迫使代理人依赖真正的视觉定位而不是表面的文字相似性。 对 " 未来奔驰 " 和 " NEPBench " 数据集的广泛评价表明,我们的方法取得了最先进的性能,大大超越了较大的 " 多边信贷额度 " ,验证了我们面向未来的代理推理范式的经验效力。

articles.title: CentriQ: Calibration-Free Quantization of Diffusion Transformers via Exact Mean Centering
articles.content: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation, but their sampling cost limits deployment. Quantizing both weights and activations to 4 bits reduces this cost, yet existing methods fall short in one of two ways. Calibration-based methods are tied to a specific checkpoint and prompt distribution, whereas data-free Hadamard rotation, effective for LLMs, loses quality on DiTs. We show that this loss has a structural cause. Adaptive layer-norm conditioning adds a per-token mean to the activations, and at the widths of the evaluated DiTs, the Hadamard rotations used by data-free methods cannot spread this mean uniformly across coordinates. A single dominant direction therefore survives the rotation and sets the quantization range. We introduce CentriQ, a calibration-free quantizer that centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 full-precision branch, so that per-token scales follow in closed form without data. Weights are fitted under a robust $\ell_p$ objective that tracks the dense mode of each group and discounts heavy tails. Across three DiTs, CentriQ matches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant at 4 bits, whereas calibration-free weight quantizers with plain per-token activation quantization collapse or degrade substantially. CentriQ outperforms the strongest calibration-free method reported to date at 2-bit weights. It is also the first calibration-free method to retain usable image quality at 2-bit activations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CentriQ:通过精确平均值中心对扩散变压器进行校准-无量量化
articles.content_zh: 扩散变压器(DiTs)实现了最先进的图像生成,但其采样成本限制部署. 将重量和激活量都量化到4位可以降低这一成本,然而现有方法在两种方式中的一种都不足. 基于校准的方法与特定的检查站和迅速分发挂钩,而对LLMs有效的无数据的Hadamard旋转则在DiTs上失去质量. 我们显示这种损失是有结构性原因的。 适应性地层规范在激活时增加了一个按键的平均值,在被评价的DiTs的宽度上,无数据方法使用的哈达马德旋转不能将这个平均值统一分布在坐标之间. 因此,一个单一的主要方向在旋转中存活下来,并设定了量化范围。 我们引入了CentriQ, 一种无校准的量子, 它在旋转前将每个符号居中,并通过一个一级全精度分支完全恢复平均值, 这样,每台天平就以封闭的形式遵循,没有数据。 重量装在一个坚固的$\ell_p$目标下,跟踪每个组的密集模式,并折扣重尾巴. 通过三个DiT,CentriQ以4比特匹配校准的SVDQuant的质量,而无校准重量的四分位器则具有平坦的每趾激活四分位衰减或大幅度降解. CentriQ在2位重量上超过了迄今为止所报告的最强的无校准方法. 它也是第一个在2位激活时保留可用图像质量的无校准方法.

articles.title: Joint Class-Time Learning for Video Classification with Multi-Instance Partial-Label Learning
articles.content: Multi-instance partial-label learning (MIPL) addresses inexact supervision in both the instance and label spaces, which can be applied to video classification. However, bag-level labels do not explicitly supervise the correspondence between candidate classes and temporal evidence. We propose {\ours}, which couples label disambiguation with temporal evidence allocation through a joint class--time assignment. Occupancy-regularized spherical matching associates contextualized video features while learning nonuniform temporal mass and discouraging excessive concentration. During training, candidate-restricted inference recomputes the assignment within the candidate label set. A dual-marginal KL projection then constructs a structured teacher that incorporates momentum-refined class beliefs while preserving the proposal's temporal occupancy. A single plan-level KL objective aligns the full-space predictor with this teacher. Our analysis characterizes when candidate re-solving differs from masking and shows that, under the stated construction, the joint objective decomposes into class-marginal and class-conditional temporal supervision. We construct VCMIPL benchmarks from Breakfast, DoTA, and FineAction using model-generated candidate labels and evaluate the method across four feature representations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PIVOTMIPL outperforms existing MIPL algorithms in both effectiveness and efficiency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视频分类联合课时学习与多功能部分标签学习
articles.content_zh: 多层部分标签学习(MIPL)在实例和标签空间中都处理不准确的监管,可以应用于视频分类. 然而,袋级标签没有明确监督候选类别与时间证据之间的对应关系. 我们建议夫妻通过联合课时分配时间 将时间证据分配的矛盾称为矛盾 在学习非统一时间质量和抑制过度集中的同时,使用规范的球形匹配结合了背景化的视频功能. 在培训期间,受限制的候选人推论在候选人的标签套内重新计算任务。 双边KL预测然后构建一个结构化的教师,在保留提案时间占用性的同时,纳入动力完善的阶级信仰. 一个单一的计划级KL目标将全空间预测器与这位老师对齐. 我们的分析认为,候选人的再溶解与伪装不同,并表明,在所述结构下,共同目标分解为阶级边缘和阶级有条件的时段监督。 我们利用模型生成的候选标签,从早餐、DOTA和精细行动中构建了VCMIPL基准,并在四个特色表述中评价这一方法。 广泛的实验结果表明,PIVOTMIPL在效力和效率上都超过了现有的MIPL算法.

articles.title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
articles.content: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LeAVJEPA:视听自我监督学习的最低限度结构
articles.content_zh: 之前的视听自导自导的学习方法依赖于EMA目标编码器,预测头,重建解码器,以及对比性损失等机制. 我们介绍LeAVJEPA,这是在LeJEPA无崩溃目标下培训的第一台视听编码器. 一个单一的早期聚变视觉变形器处理音频,视频,和联合音频-视频输入. 模式退出将缺失模式视为同一事件的另一种观点,使交叉模式一致隐含在目标中。 该模型将全球嵌入与特定模式的本地嵌入相配合,SIGREG防止代表崩溃. 受控退赛确定退出模式是视听协调的关键机制。 尽管建筑简洁,LeAVJEPA在AudioSet-20K上达到36.0mAP,在冷冻评价下ESC-50上达到91.3%的精度. 经过微调后,它在VGGSound上达到61.1%的精度,其嵌入支持零镜头的视听检索.

articles.title: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring
articles.content: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction. However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization. Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 频率- 减低扩散指导
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的传播模型为图像恢复过程中的无训练后取样提供了强大的图像前兆. 为了指导这一取样过程,对频率的认识方法逐步纳入跨频段的测量信息,促进粗细重建。 然而,现有方法通常没有明确地将频率激活与降解引起的衰减分开,因此未充分模拟非活动频率之间的衰减差异。 在这项工作中,我们提出频率脱钩后导线,将频率激活与衰减感光谱规范区分开来. 具体来说,递进的低高频表决定了主动测量波段,而内核衍生的衰减图则定义了选择性的光谱先于不活动组件. 为了稳定采样过程,我们还引入了局部轨迹调节器,抑制空间不规则的状态到清洁的偏差. 对于固定的终点能量,我们提供一个KL规范化的路径空间解释. 在实践中,我们通过使用Tweedie插件近似值的局部能量校正,构建有时间依赖的指导. 关于自然图像基准的实验表明,在非盲度破碎环境中,即使在更高的测量噪音水平上,PSNR和SSIM的性能也很强。

articles.title: MoCAR: Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression for Continuous Trajectory Forecasting
articles.content: Autoregressive generation is natural for language, where predicted tokens can be directly reused as the next prediction state, but trajectory forecasting lacks such a clean token: motion is continuous, multimodal, and expressed in local coordinate frames that evolve with the predicted trajectory. We present MoCAR (Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression), a decoder-only framework that casts trajectory forecasting as next-code prediction in a coordinate-aware continuous latent space. MoCAR learns a continuous motion-code space from endpoint-normalized trajectory segments, where each code jointly captures local trajectory geometry and the reference-frame transition induced by that segment. Historical motion codes are used as a teacher-forced prefix, future codes are generated autoregressively under temporal, map, agent, and mode interactions, and predicted codes persist in latent memory while decoded endpoints update the local scene context. This enables rollout without trajectory-space re-tokenization, trajectory queries, goal candidates, or proposal-and-refinement pipelines. On Argoverse (AV) benchmarks, MoCAR achieves top-tier performance with a simple single-stage architecture, transfers strongly from AV2 to AV1 in zero-shot evaluation, and improves on turn-heavy scenarios. Ablations confirm that the learned continuous motion-code space, latent alignment, weak KL regularization, and joint tokenizer-predictor optimization are essential for stable latent autoregression.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MoCAR:用于连续轨迹预测的移动-代码坐标-意识自动回转
articles.content_zh: 自动递归生成对语言来说是自然的,其中预测的符号可以作为下一个预测状态直接重复使用,但轨迹预测缺乏这样一个干净的符号:运动是连续的,多模式的,并在随预测轨迹演化的局部坐标框中表达. 我们提出MOCAR(Motion-code Coord-aware Auto Regression),这是一个只有解码器的框架,将轨迹预测作为下一个编码预测投放到一个坐标-aware连续潜伏空间. MOCAR从端点常态化的轨迹片段学习一个连续的运动码空间,每个码共同捕捉局部轨迹几何和该片段引发的参照框架过渡. 历史运动代码被用作教师强制的前缀,未来代码在时间,地图,代理和模式互动下自动生成,预言代码在潜在内存中持续存在,同时解码端点更新本地场景背景. 这样,就可以在没有轨迹空间重新开通、轨迹查询、目标候选者或建议和改良管道的情况下推出。 在Argoverse(AV)基准上,MOCAR以简单的单级架构实现顶级性能,在零镜头评价中从AV2强力转移至AV1,并在转速重的情景上有所改进. 偏差证实,所学的连续运动码空间、潜在的对齐、薄弱的KL规范化以及联合的先导器-先导器优化对于稳定的潜在自旋至关重要。

articles.title: EORestore-Agent: Fidelity-Guided Agentic Restoration of Remote Sensing Images with Composite Degradations
articles.content: Remote sensing images often carry composite degradations, in which haze, cloud, noise, blur, low light, and low resolution coexist. Restoring them requires deciding which tool to apply, in what order, and when to stop, yet no clean reference is available at inference time to verify these decisions. All-in-one models trained on single degradations converge to a narrow PSNR band as degradations accumulate. To formulate real-world remote sensing restoration as a traceable trajectory, we present EORestore-Agent, which replaces this unmeasurable objective with reference-free, verifiable per-step decisions. A fine-tuned vision-language model reports all residual degradation types, whose tool pools are scored together, so the restoration order emerges from step-wise selection. A relative quality scorer, trained with full-reference supervision on synthetic degradation chains, predicts the changes in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS from the current image to each candidate. A step is accepted only when no predicted change is negative and the predicted PSNR gain is positive. Otherwise, the agent keeps the current image. On a synthetic Landsat-8 benchmark with six degradation types, EORestore-Agent improves PSNR by 2.3 to 3.2 dB over the strongest retrained all-in-one baseline on composites of two to six degradations, whereas zero-shot natural-image agents fall below the degraded input in PSNR in 17 of 18 settings. Replacing the learned scorer with no-reference quality differences costs 1.1 to 4.6 dB. The remaining harmful steps are small and cluster near the acceptance threshold. Sentinel-2 examples illustrate transfer to real atmospheric degradation without retraining.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Eorestore-Agent:具有复合降解作用的遥感图像的Fidelity-Guided代理修复
articles.content_zh: 遥感图像往往带有复合降解,其中雾霾,云雾,噪声,模糊,低光,低分辨率共存. 恢复这些决定要求决定适用何种工具、以何种顺序和何时停止,但在推断时却无法提供核实这些决定的干净参考。 随着降解的积累,接受过单一降解培训的全能模型会汇合到一个狭窄的PSNR波段. 为了将现实世界的遥感恢复作为可追踪的轨道,我们提出EORESTORE-Agent,用无参考、可核查的逐步决定取代这一不可衡量的目标。 一个精细的视觉语言模型报告所有残留的降解类型,其工具池被打分在一起,因此恢复顺序从逐步选择中出现. 相对质量的计分员在合成降解链的全参考监督下接受培训,预测PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS从当前图像到每个候选人的变化. 只有当没有预测的变化为负数,预测的PSNR增益为正数时,才接受一步. 否则,代理保存当前图像. 在合成Landsat-8的基准中,EORestore-Agent将PSNR改进2.3至3.2分贝,以超过2至6个降解的复合材料上最强的再训练全一基线,而零射的自然成像剂则低于18个环境中17个PSNR的退化输入。 取代无参考质量差异的学习计分器,成本为1.1至4.6 dB. 剩余的有害步骤是小的,集群接近接受阈值. 哨兵-2的例子说明了不进行再培训而转入真正的大气退化。

articles.title: Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations
articles.content: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 损失 -- -- 所得代表的被动预测
articles.content_zh: 神经网络中学习到的特征表述往往包含的结构超出了最终任务产出直接使用的结构. 我们使用$\textit{被动探针}$来研究这个结构,在培训期间对表述应用固定的、未经训练的、独立的财产预测。 我们通过预测等效矢量和赫尔米特参数化显示额外损失-变量跟踪坐标的S^2美元来推动这一方法。 这激发了一种总的构造,在这种构造中,固定的随机预测是学习特征的观察者。 由于观察者是损失-变化无常的,并且独立于正在研究的财产,因此无障碍性的变化反映了相对于固定观察者相对于表现的变化,而不是观察者本身的适应. 我们显示,被动探测器的组合可以直接反映目标对齐等与任务有关的信息. 在我们的构造下,最终困难的可获取性在任务之间变化不同。 在进行关于表面正常估计和图像油漆的回归任务的培训时,它有所增加,但在图像分类方面仍然接近初始水平。 与所学线性探测器的比较进一步表明,可回收性和被动可获取性在训练期间可能会有不同的演变. 这些结果共同表明,被动探测器如何能分别描述代表几何学的变化和最终任务难度的可获取性.

articles.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
articles.content: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过从培训数据中取出一个选手,可以确定基准模型的理由
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们研究训练数据如何在基模型反应开始时的符号和随后的推理行为之间产生关联. 首先,我们证明 固定特定的开始提示 使得一个基础模型的性能 与它的强化学习(RL) 训练的对应者在数学和编码上的竞争。 例如,提示".\\\n\n好"将Olmo-3-7B的MATH-500通过@1的精度从42%提高到78%,而"Alright"则将Qune3-14B的精度从72%提高到87%. 第二,RL使这些提示更可能发生,同时固定这些提示可以恢复其相对于基模型的大部分性能收益. 第三,我们追踪符号提示的推理效果 到训练数据。 我们进行因果数据干预,将任意的单词如"chicken"变成有效的推理提示,或者去除现有的提示效果. 类似的编辑使得即时指示"想鸭鸭鹅"在引申推理时与"一步步思考"一样有效. 我们还发现,由不同提示引发的隐蔽状态表述与培训组的不同文件类型相关。 最后,我们用语言模型安全案例研究来扩展我们对符号提示的研究,发现不同的提示会引起与不同类型的培训数据相对应的不同拒绝和遵守行为。

articles.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
articles.content: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理机器人的递归视频内文学习
articles.content_zh: LLM代理商协调冻结的视觉语言行动(VLA)政策,通过文本内存改进,文本内存记录代理商做了什么,但没有记录任务是如何完成的. 一个演示视频显示它, 但不适合一个代理的背景。 完整的视频会减缓每个转弯,固定的键框会失去决定一个抓住是否控住的接触细节,以及代理机需要从任务结构在计划时转向每个接触周围的帧. 我们引入了递归视频内线学习(RV-ICL),这是一种无训练的方法,将演示转化为代理导航的层次,而不是它收到的一个提示. 分级由演示的子事件构建,如抓取和释放. 其水平越来越精细,从整个任务的关键框架到阶段、瞬间和短片,并通过只读工具曝光。 代理人在规划前会读到粗体级. 在执行期间,当一个步骤需要更多细节时,它重新进入等级体系,只装入当前次级目标的片段。 每个任务一个示范就够了。 在RPent上建造的RV-ICL将LIBERO-PRO上的成功率从92.6%提高到96.5%,在LIBERO-Plus上的成功率从86.7%提高到95.8%.

articles.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
articles.content: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MemPilot: LLM 代理的多模式内存校验
articles.content_zh: 记忆已成为LLM剂生态系统的组成部分,支持信息保存和跨相互作用的再利用。 然而,大多数现有的代理内存系统都以查询-不可知的方式构建内存,这可能会产生不必要的预处理成本和丢弃细节,而这些细节后来证明是必不可少的. 最近的研究开始将内存处理转向运行时间适应,但通常专门从事特定的操作或固定的处理方案,使得对性能、成本和耐久性的灵活控制在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出\textbf{MemPilot},这是一个灵活的框架,它根据不同的性能-成本-相关性偏好,按需安排内存管理。 具体地说,我们通过强化学习,优化了多步骤的LLM政策,在从查询-不可知存储器检索到将原始多式联运历史的特定查询处理委托给多样化的LLMs和VLMs之间进行迭代选择。 该政策共同控制证据量、校准指示、模型选择和视觉访问,从而能够精细分配运行时间计算。 为了在相互竞争的目标下优化这一政策,我们通过在汇总之前分别估计每个目标的优势,使客观优势脱钩。 此外,我们采用基于前缀的边际效用估计,用于跨多步骤的信贷分配。 关于五个多式联运代理-模型基准的实验表明,在优化优惠之间,优异的业绩-成本-相关性的权衡是可取的,而优惠的扫荡比现有的权衡基准更广阔。

articles.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
articles.content: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CLIFT:网络代理培训和测试时间扩展的认证
articles.content_zh: 开源网络代理现在已经足够强大,可以执行现实的浏览器任务,但是通过强化学习来培训他们仍然依赖于薄弱的监督:二进制任务的成功对于信用分配来说太少,而前沿语言模型法官花费太高,无法在每一个步骤上调用,在部署时无法假定可用. 我们引入了CLIFT,一种围绕自核查的培训和测试时间缩放方法。 在培训期间,代理人回答关于其自身推出的自然语言核查问题; 组成式正式认证员只保留那些URL条件证据与培训时间法官一致的质疑信号,通过极性意识升降来分配签名的信任权重,并将由此产生的核查员得分并入每步奖励中,永不从法官基线中扣除。 在测试时,同一认证库被冻结,并作为结构化的证据重复用于Conresult Tracetory Cetrol(CTS):代理机对贪婪的推出和一种或多种复刻进行取样,自我验证器对每个URL痕量进行总结,保守的多数投票规则选择是否与现任者互换,而不调用任何外部法官. 这个单一机制支持三个设置. 在WebArena Infinity上,CLIFT在开源网络代理中实现了最先进的性能. 在VisualWebArena上,一家银行在测试时间接受过开放式型号转移至GPT-5.5的训练,并在舟子机下达到最先进的性能. 在Online Mind2Web上,没有培训基准上的代理,翻译认证的问题银行在零镜头评价中改进了网络代理. 这些结果使自我核查一致,从而将昂贵的法官反馈转化为可重复使用的培训信号和无法官测试时间的缩放信号。

articles.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
articles.content: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.

articles.title_zh: PlotGround: 在真实科学数字及其来源数据中定位绘图
articles.content_zh: 科学人物往往将无法随时以机器可读形式获得的定量结果编码,使准确的图案数字化对于核实和重新使用已公布的调查结果十分重要。 然而,仍然不清楚目前的模型如何准确地从实际科学数字中恢复绘图值,因为现有基准主要依靠合成图表或只涵盖有限的图表类型。 我们引入了PlotGround, 一个自动管道 用于构建地块数字化基准 从真实的科学人物 及其作者发布的来源数据。 将 GropGround 映射到源表,识别可重建的面板,并生成带有源源参考值的定量问题. 我们用PlotGround来建造PlotGround-1k,这是由1 066个生物Rxiv预印的1 119个问题组成的经人验证的基准。 在16个多式联运模型中,最佳的精确度达到87.5%,每5美元左右的相对耐受性。 将耐受度限制到$\pm 2\%$将每个模型的精度降低11-24个百分点,揭示了近似视觉阅读和精确定量恢复之间的差距. PlotGround的配对数字-源结构让我们比较一下从数字和源表格中回收的相同值的准确性。 提供源表而不是数字将编码剂的精确度从90.0%提高到97.4%,同时将成本降低72%。

articles.title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model
articles.content: We distill Kokoro-82M, a widely used open text-to-speech model with 54 voices, into Paradee, an 8.07M-parameter model that speaks one of them. Paradee keeps Kokoro's architecture with much narrower layers, and each of its two halves is trained separately against the frozen teacher. It has 10x fewer parameters and needs 15x less compute. We first synthesize a corpus with the teacher and keep its durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features. We then train a small text side to predict these values, and a small decoder to turn the teacher's saved values into the teacher's audio, first with spectral losses and then adversarially. Finally, we connect the two halves and quantize the weights to int8. It needs no alignment learning and no joint training, and it runs on one laptop. Stored in int8, Paradee is 8.5 MB, runs 25x faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS against the teacher's 4.52. The student initially kept a slight buzz, which we trace to the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz. A phase-locking filter applied after synthesis removes most of it, with no training and no extra parameters. Code, model files and audio samples are at https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee

articles.title_zh: 游行:将Kokoro-82M分解成8M-Paremeter 单声道文字对语音模型
articles.content_zh: 我们把Kokoro-82M这个广泛使用的有54个声音的开放文本对语音模型,蒸馏成Paradee,一个能说其中之一的8.07M参数模型. Paradee将Kokoro的建筑保存在更窄的地层上,其两半的建筑都单独训练与冷冻的老师相对. 它的参数减少10x,需要15x的计算减少. 我们首先与老师合成一个体格 并保持其持续时间,投球,能量和电话功能。 然后我们训练一个小的文字方面来预测这些值,一个小的解码器把老师的保存值变成老师的音频,先是光谱损失,然后是对抗. 最后,我们把两半线连接起来,把重量量化到英寸8。 它不需要校对学习和联合培训,它使用一台笔记本电脑。 存储于int8,Paradee为8.5 MB,运行速度比实时快25x在一个CPU线条上,在UTMOS上对老师的4.52分4.41分. 这名学生起初保持了微弱的呼声, 合成后应用的相位锁定滤波器移除了大部分,没有训练,也没有附加参数. 代码、模型文件和音频样本见https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee。

articles.title: T-Search: An Open Agentic Retriever and Playground for Hard Multi-Step Search
articles.content: We present T-Search, an open-weight agentic retriever for hard multi-step search. Given a question and a search tool over a fixed corpus, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks with short justifications, leaving answer generation to a downstream model, so backend and generator can be swapped without retraining. T-Search is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and trained on adversarially filtered synthetic search tasks with round-sliced supervised fine-tuning followed by GSPO on a recall reward. Averaged over seven English and Russian benchmarks with gold evidence annotations, it reaches 56.0 Recall@10 with one rollout, 14.4 points above its base, and 61.3 with three fused rollouts, outperforming larger open models. We release the model, harness, live demo, and three benchmarks, including TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark.

articles.title_zh: T- Search: 硬多步搜索的开放代理检索和游戏场
articles.content_zh: 我们提出T -Search, 一个开放量级的代理检索器 用于硬多步搜索。 鉴于一个问题和一个搜索工具在固定程序表之上,它运行一个有界限的多轮搜索,并将一个有短理由的证据块的排列列表返回,让答案生成到下游模式,因此后端和生成器可以互换而无需再培训. T-Search以Qune3.6-35B-A3B为基础,并接受过关于对抗性过滤合成搜索任务的培训,经过圆片监督微调,然后普惠制O进行召回奖励。 平均有7个以上附有黄金证据说明的英文和俄文基准,达到56.0Recall@10,推出一次,高出基准点14.4点,61.3,推出三次引信,超过较大的开放型号。 我们发布了模型,使用,现场演示,以及三个基准,包括TRuST,这是第一个本土-俄罗斯的硬搜索基准.

articles.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
articles.content: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens, a detector that identifies whether a document's ideas came from a human or AI (idea provenance), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas. In a controlled study, IdeaLens's AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages. Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.

articles.title_zh: IdeaLens:在长式写作中检测AI的想法
articles.content_zh: 虽然现代AI探测器识别出谁写了这些词,但新兴的AI使用政策越来越依赖于另一个问题:是谁提出这些想法的? 我们引入了IdeaLens,这个探测器可以识别一个文件的想法是来自人类还是AI(理想来源),无论谁写了它的话. 将IdeaLens的焦点放在思想而不是旁白上,我们把文件作为纲要:将每个内容与内容的简短的,解译的描述组合成一个讨论角色的项目清单,尽量减少与原始文本的字层重叠. 我们训练IdeaLens在1M FineWeb文档上使用来自Pangram的银色标签,一种传言来源探测器. 由于提纲大部分是剥离表面层信息,所以标签必须主要通过各种想法来适应. 在一项受控研究中,IdeaLens的AI旗率从95%下降到7%,因为模型写自越来越详细的人类计划,而Pangram 4仍然标有92%的旗帜;根据AI衍生的计划,IdeaLens保持96%以上. 反之,在人类作者从AI生成的计划中写出50个故事的新数据集上,IdeaLens将68%的故事标为AI,而Pagram 4则标为8%. 在一套包含19个现有检测基准的综合性测试中,我们显示,IdeaLens以低假正率保持了强大的检测率,这表明思想本身提供了强大的歧视信号,其性能在各个领域、格式和语言中占有优势。 最后,我们研究了来自IdeaLens的90K预测,以描述人类和AI思想之间的系统性差异. 我们发布我们的模型和标注的数据集,以促进未来对想法来源检测的研究.

articles.title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
articles.content: Recurrent-attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers. Prior work suggests that attention and recurrent layers offer complementary pathways to use past information: attention supports precise memory recall from earlier tokens, while recurrent layers support consolidation of disparate information over long contexts. However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them. We find that they rely substantially more on attention than on the recurrent state. Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited. To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention's access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence. This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention. It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis. Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory. Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them.

articles.title_zh: 平衡记忆路径:分析和改进混合LMs的记忆利用
articles.content_zh: 经常留念混合语言模型(LMs),该模型互留注意力和经常层,越来越多地用于将经常层的效率与注意层的强性能相结合. 先前的工作表明,关注层和经常层为使用过去的信息提供了补充途径:注意支持从先前的符号中准确召回内存,而经常层则支持将不同的信息合并到长期内。 然而,我们观察到,只要能进入这两个途径,并不意味着混合LMs正在有效地使用它们。 我们发现,他们更多地依赖关注,而不是反复出现的状况。 标准监督的微调提高了整体性能,但并没有改进两个内存路径的协调方式:该模型更加依赖关注层所传播的信息,而其对经常层所传播的信息的使用仍然有限。 为了鼓励两个内存路径之间更好的协调,我们增加了一个辅助损失,限制注意力进入早期上下文,而经常性状态则通过整个序列传播. 这一目标鼓励该模式在关注的同时通过经常性途径保留和使用信息。 该系统提高了总体业绩,在涉及较长背景或需要信息汇总的任务方面,根据分析中观察到的经常层的优点,取得了特别显著的进展。 关键的是,这种不平衡和我们附带损失的好处概括了:它们适用于问答和代理任务中的多重重复性 LMs,以及结合不同记忆形式的基于注意力的 LMs. 我们的调查结果表明,仅仅提供多种记忆途径并不能确保有效使用这些途径,需要有针对性地进行监督,以便更好地协调这些途径。

articles.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
articles.content: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.

articles.title_zh: (原始内容存档于2018-03-31). ufakzeka-karar: 带有顺序- 不定式选项的开放式土耳其输入决定模型
articles.content_zh: ufakzeka-karar是土耳其的开放式决定模型,有182,494,466个参数. 考虑到土耳其文本和一个固定答案类型的问题(一个选择,一个按顺序大小的级别,或者是或否),它返回每个选项的温度级概率和作为"不确定"信号的预期错误,而不产生文本,在一个CPU前传最多可达十个选项. 建造在实验室的ufakzeka-1-base上,其头部在共享位置上对其它人视而不见,因此答案并不取决于选项顺序. 一个经过洗涤选项训练的顺序头大约准确,但当只有选项命令改变时,其答案的2.3%改为2.8%;REINFORCE损失了10.2分(0.102分)的宏F1到交叉交替. 在Hakem Bench v1.0(4,275个问题,7个音轨)的开放集上,发行的模型排名第7位的16行,复合体为0.660(95%的间隔0.642到0.677). 温度缩放会降低开发集的校准误差(smooth ECE),但在被搁置的支援问题上却将其提升,第一次得分的运行从0.027升至0.045,而后者从未对其进行过训练;释放的模型后来对其进行过训练,因此其0.036升至0.064并不是一个隐蔽的质疑测试. 发布型号是哈克姆本奇的三跑得分中的最后一场,其数字并非盲目. 第二跑的新训练数据针对的是第一跑在护栏,节制和客户支持的全测试集上的错误,在第二跑的全测试集的护栏结果被读取后,根据在任何数据,代码或运行之前固定的书面协议,释放的运行被培训. 它的所有数字都是在这些读数之后出现的;它的护栏,节制和客户支持数字都带有"通过读取测试结果而成的"旗帜. 由于其他四条赛道上每条车型都只得分,其综合成绩为0.678分,为16分第6位. 重量和代码在Apache-2.0下.

articles.title: Improving Diversity in LLM Short Story Generation
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) can generate accurate responses, but these are void of diversity. We attempt to address this for the task of creative short story generation. Drawing on established writing conventions and known LLM limitations, we target variation in genre, tone, style, and named entities. To promote diversity across these dimensions, we introduce DivLM, an LLM post-training framework consisting of two phases. First, we perform continued pre-training on a creative writing corpus and restore instruction-following capabilities using weight residuals. We then apply reinforcement learning with a custom, composite reward function that jointly maximizes diversity across the targeted narrative dimensions while maintaining response quality. Our empirical results on two LLM families show that DivLM increases diversity metrics by more than 9% on average compared to alternative approaches, while preserving instruction following, overall response quality, and similarity to human outputs.

articles.title_zh: 改进LLM短篇故事中的多样性
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)可以产生准确的响应,但这些都不存在多样性. 我们试图为了创造短篇故事而解决这个问题。 根据既定的书写惯例和已知的LLM限制,我们的目标是在流派、语气、风格和命名实体方面的变化。 为了促进这些层面的多样性,我们引入了DivLM,这是一个由两个阶段组成的LLM培训后框架。 首先,我们持续进行关于创造性写作工具的预训,并利用剩余重量恢复学习能力。 然后,我们用一种习惯的、综合的奖励功能来应用强化学习,这种功能在保持反应质量的同时,共同使目标叙述层面的多样性最大化。 我们两个LLM家族的经验结果显示,与替代方法相比,DivLM将多样性衡量标准平均增加9%以上,同时保留了后续教学、总体反应质量和与人类产出的相似性。

articles.title: Domain adaptation of Russian ModernBERT for long legal documents
articles.content: We investigate whether continued pretraining on Russian legislative documents improves a Russian ModernBERT encoder on legal text. The adapted model, RuModernBERT-ruLaw, was trained on a corpus reported to contain 304,382 legislative documents and 194,425,905 corpus tokens. Corpus token counts are distinguished from positions produced by the model tokenizer. We compare the original and adapted encoders on a fixed external collection of 1,031 court-decision segments. Both models receive the same hidden positions in each of five masking realizations. At maximum input lengths of 512, 2,048, and 8,192 tokens, mean masked-token cross-entropy decreases by 0.10942, 0.07052, and 0.06604 natural-log units, respectively. The reported 95% intervals summarize sensitivity to masking on this fixed collection; they do not quantify uncertainty across document collections. A second evaluation addresses legal-entity extraction. The original and adapted models achieve entity-level F1 scores of 0.99852 and 0.99820. However, 99.95% of test spans have the same normalized surface form and class in the training split. This evaluation therefore provides limited evidence about transfer to previously unseen forms. The paper explains the masking objective, overlapping windows, averaging rules, and exact entity-boundary scoring using editable diagrams and clearly marked illustrative examples. The comparison supports lower masked-token prediction loss for the studied pair of models and collection. It does not isolate the contribution of distant context or establish practical legal utility.

articles.title_zh: 俄罗斯现代的域改造 BERT 长期法律文件
articles.content_zh: 我们调查继续就俄罗斯立法文件进行预先培训是否改进了俄罗斯现代BERT法律文本编码器。 经修改的模型RuModernBERT-ruLaw接受了关于一项文书的培训,据报告载有304 382份立法文件和194 425 905份文书。 公司代号计数与模型代号器生成的方位有区别. 我们比较了1 031个法庭裁决部分的固定外部收藏的原始和经调整的编码器。 两种模型在五个遮掩实现中每个都得到相同的隐藏位置. 在最大输入长度为512,2,048和8,192个令牌时,意指蒙面托盘交叉连接分别减少0.10942,0.07052和0.06604自然log单位. 所报告的95%的间隔总结了掩盖这一固定收藏的敏感性;它们没有量化文件收藏的不确定性。 第二项评价涉及法律实体的提取。 最初和改造过的模型实现了实体级F1分数0.99852和0.99820. 然而,99.95%的试验周期在训练中具有相同的正常表面形式和班级。 因此,这一评价就向先前未见表格转移提供了有限的证据。 本文用可编辑的图表和明显标记的示例来解释遮掩的目标、重叠的窗口、平均规则和准确的实体边界评分。 比较支持了被研究的对模型和收集的较低遮掩式的预测损失. 它并不孤立遥远背景的贡献,也不确立实际的法律效用。

articles.title: SAFE-MR: Evidence Sufficiency Learning for Selective Multimodal Rumor Detection
articles.content: Multimodal rumor detectors increasingly rely on retrieved evidence, yet relevant evidence is not necessarily sufficient for verification. Missing provenance, duplicated reports, and unresolved contradictions can produce confident predictions without adequate support. We introduce SAFE-MR, a framework that separates claim veracity from evidence sufficiency. The method decomposes image-text posts into verifiable claims, constructs a relation-aware claim-evidence graph, and aggregates evidence using provenance and contextual compatibility. Separate veracity and sufficiency heads support selective prediction, while evidence interventions encourage stability under irrelevant additions and sensitivity to evidence removal. On NewsCLIPpings, VERITE, and XFacta, SAFE-MR achieves macro-F1 scores of 91.2%, 75.8%, and 85.2%, respectively. Against the matched backbone with evidence, its macro-F1 gains are 2.2, 4.9, and 4.8 percentage points. On the diagnostic selection set, SAFE-MR reduces AURC from 0.105 for maximum-probability rejection to 0.075 and lowers error at 80% coverage from 13.8% to 8.5%. Evidence-perturbation and ablation results support the role of sufficiency learning and intervention training in improving selective verification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAFE-MR: 选择性多式传闻检测的证据充分性学习
articles.content_zh: 多式联运谣言探测器越来越依赖所收集的证据,但相关证据不一定足以进行核查。 缺少出处,重复的报告,以及未解决的矛盾,在没有充分支持的情况下,可以产生自信的预测. 我们采用了SFE-MR,这个框架将声称真实性与证据的充分性区分开来。 该方法将图像文本帖子分解为可核实的索赔,构建一个了解关系的索赔证据图表,并利用来源和背景兼容性汇总证据。 单独的真实性和充分性头支持有选择的预测,而证据干预则鼓励在不相关的添加和对证据清除的敏感性下保持稳定。 在NewsCLIPpings,VERITE,和XFacta上,SAFE-MR分别实现了91.2%,75.8%和85.2%的宏F1分数. 与证据匹配的骨干相比,其宏观F1收益为2.2、4.9和4.8个百分点。 在诊断选择中,SAFE-MR将最大概率拒绝的AURC从0.105降低到0.075,并将80%的覆盖率误差从13.8%降低到8.5%. 证据干扰和破坏结果支持充分学习和干预培训在改进选择性核查方面的作用。

articles.title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs
articles.content: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
