articles.title_zh: 通过 CGANs 和 LLMs 读取 Mood: 情感指导书对音乐的建议
articles.content_zh: 与文字的心情相匹配的背景音乐被展现出来,让读者感觉更加沉浸,并改善其阅读经验,激励推荐者系统将书籍与心情相匹配的音乐配对. 为此,我们提出跨域建议感知基因网络(SAGA-CDR),这是一个两阶段跨域建议框架,将音乐建议个性化,并在情感上与正在阅读的书保持一致. 在第一阶段,基于变压器的情感嵌入是通过用户审查构建的,并通过一个有条件的基因变压器网络绘制跨域图,其带面具的生成器处理缺失的情绪元件,并注入更丰富的偏好转移的色谱. 紧凑的评级神经网络然后在预测音乐的评级之前,将情感特异性互动分数与协作滤波法结合. 在第二阶段中,大型语言模型将每本书分类为华丽-激动的情感四象限,对候选音轨进行过滤以与该四象限相匹配. 英国亚马逊和中国杜邦数据集的实验显示,SAGA-CDR在亚马逊取得了最好的评级预测精度(RMSE 0.98),在杜邦取得了最低的RMSE(0.91),其排名性能与最强的情绪感知基线竞争,甚至在跨语言环境下也是如此.

articles.title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
articles.content: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MeDPrune:医学VQA的地形学-有效多式联运 任务
articles.content_zh: 虽然医学多式联运大语言模型(Med-MLLMs)推进了医学视觉问题回答(VQA),但现有的临床工作流程启发的多剂框架却因多余的通信地形学导致的相互作用模式和过度计算间接费用而受到影响. 在本文中,我们提出MedPrune,这是一个有效的医疗多式联运多剂协作框架,它能动态地从通信地形中抽出节点和边缘,以提高推理能力和象征性效率。 具体地说,我们首先将诊断过程编成一个千差万别的交流图,其中节点代表来自各部门的专家代理人,边缘则反映部门内和部门间的相互作用。 在这个图的基础上,我们引入了两个螺旋化机制,以促成适应性的合作演变: (1)异质分解,通过强化学习驱动的地形优化,消除与当前多式联运问题无关的与任务无关的专家代理;(2)异质分解,通过联合优化任务性能和地形复杂性,选择性地仅保留诊断性最突出的部门内和部门间联系. 在全套和少发训练环境下进行的广泛医学VQA实验证明,MedPrune超过了多剂基线,用强大的对抗力提高了象征性效率。

articles.title: Programmatic Search Agents: Extending Agentic Search Beyond Query Reformulation
articles.content: Search agents adapt their queries, yet fixed search interfaces leave candidate processing and evidence presentation outside the agent's direct control. Our trajectory analysis shows that supporting passages can be retrieved yet never delivered to the agent; a same-page oracle intervention shows that changing the returned evidence can reduce subsequent search. We introduce Programmatic Search Agent (PSA), which makes a local executable computation over candidates the unit of a search action. PSA unifies a persistent candidate workspace, flexible primitive composition, and selective evidence presentation. It incrementally generates program cells that reuse candidates, execute dependent operations, and select what the agent inspects next. The runtime resolves specified data dependencies within each cell, while the agent adapts its search strategy across cells as new evidence arrives. We compare PSA with the Query-based Agent and Tool-based Agent on InfoSeek-Eval and BrowseComp-Plus using five policy backbones without task-specific training. All three interfaces share the search substrate, and the Tool-based Agent also shares PSA's primitives and persistent workspace. Relative to the Query-based Agent, PSA improves macro-averaged task success by 4.00 and 7.56 percentage points on the two benchmarks, respectively; within-backbone reductions in final-step tokens average 28.3% and 33.9%. These results support extending agent control beyond query reformulation to the processing and presentation of retrieved evidence. Code will be released subject to approval.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 程序搜索代理: 扩展代理搜索超越查询重构
articles.content_zh: 搜索人员对其查询进行调整,但固定的搜索接口将候选人的处理和证据展示置于代理的直接控制之外. 我们的轨迹分析显示,支持通道可以检索,但从未交付给代理人;同页的甲骨文干涉显示,改变返回的证据可以减少后续的搜索. 我们引入了程序搜索代理(PSA),它使得对候选人的本地可执行计算成为搜索行动的单位. PSA统一了持久的候选工作空间,灵活的原始成分,以及选择性的证据展示. 它递增生成程序单元格,用于重复使用候选人,执行依赖性操作,并选择代理人接下来检查的内容. 运行时间解决了每个单元格内特定的数据依赖性,而代理则随着新证据的到来而调整其跨单元格的搜索策略. 我们在InfoSeek-Eval和浏览Comp-Plus上将PSA与基于查询的Agent和基于工具的Agent进行比较,使用五个政策主干线,但没有进行特定任务培训. 三个界面都共享搜索底物,基于工具的代理也共享PSA的原始和持续的工作空间. 与基于查询的代理相比,PSA在两个基准上分别提高4.00和7.56个百分点的宏观平均任务成功率;在后骨内减少最后步骤标志平均28.3%和33.9%。 这些结果有助于将代理控制范围从查询重构扩大到处理和提交检索的证据。 守则将在获得批准后公布。

articles.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
articles.content: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使多模式患者证据与临床医学知识图相一致
articles.content_zh: 临床问题往往取决于将病人的多式联运证据与外部生物医学知识联系起来,但现有的预测系统很少明确代表这种联系,因此既无法追踪到其证据来源,也无法移除以衡量其贡献。 我们提出MM-KG(多模式知识图),它代表了多种多样的多模式病人观察和生物医学概念,作为单独的层次,用一个打字图,加上明确的对齐边缘。 首先,特定模式的协调器将EHR文本、成像、基因组和生物谱系数据转换成与UMLS概念映射的打字观测数据,这是一条路线优先的对齐器,与生物医学知识图相连。 查询有条件的检索,然后选择一个紧凑的子图供大语言模型或图神经网络下游使用. 我们为MIMIC-IV和ADNI建造MM-KG, 并用2x2的设计来评估它们, 将病人的证据,生物医学知识, 及其相互作用分开。 在需要两个来源的问题上,两个来源都远远超出机会,而两者的结合产生由药物控制的AUROC在MIMIC和ADNI的+0.194相互作用。 MM-KG在被搁置的五冠排名上,以+0.131 Hits@1优于MindMap,并在需要咨询患者的项目上领导一个经过调整的GraphCare,并删除了从检索的包中返回Hits@1到无知识基线的单一的有答案关系. 最后,基于查询条件的检索达到0.731 AUROC,其上下文比最强的通用政策要少6.8x,而静态知识图上下文则不会对普通结果预测产生一致的好处. 因此,知识图对临床LLMS并非作为背景,而是作为多式联运病人证据与一个问题所要求的关系之间的明确联系,MM-KG使这些联系可以检索、追踪和检验。

articles.title: How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing
articles.content: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 如何实现Sparse概率 地图形状混合专家路线
articles.content_zh: 混合专家(MoE)路由器一般对路由器的分数采用软max,并保留顶级K级专家,使每个符号都精确使用K级专家. Sparsity-诱导概率图,如sparsmax,alpha-entmax和规范max等,可以适应性地为选定的专家分配精确的零,因此似乎提供象征性的依赖专家的参与,即使使用相同的顶级K机. 在这项工作中,我们研究这种痉挛是否以及如何在训练中存活下来. 我们的训练将300M和1B顶级-2MOE语言模型与软马克,1.5-entmax,稀释马克和2-Normmax相匹配,发现地图在训练过后的表现非常不同:在1B,entmax丢弃的概率质量比软马克要低30%,而几乎从不丢弃选定的专家,稀释马克保留了最多的质量,规范马克斯的路线21%给单个专家. 这些结果不仅仅是地图的属性。 每张地图只有在两个最大分数的差距达到固定阈值时才会将一个选定的专家放下,经过训练的路由器在分数分布上有所不同:entmax路由器学习的分数大约是软马克斯的分布的一半,这使其前2位的分数低于其阈值,而共享同一阈值的稀有马克斯和规范马克斯则学习不同的差距分布,因此参与度也不同. 路由器因此将其分数与地图共同调整,地图产生零的能力本身并不决定专家的参与. 虽然零星的地图都没有改善验证损失高于软马克,但是它们使得训练有素的模型在推论上对选择更多专家的敏感性要小得多:用K=2训练的零星马克在用K=8运行时损失0.02纳特,软马克损失0.58. 我们的结果显示,适应性的MOE路由必须围绕概率图和学到的分数的联合行为来设计,而不是仅仅围绕地图.

articles.title: The Pushback Paradox: A Two-Probe Diagnostic for Language Model Compliance
articles.content: Are language models compliant with user instructions? A model that always complies can be stopped but also exploited, while one that always resists can be neither exploited nor stopped. We contribute an open two-probe benchmark that can place any language model on this spectrum. In the active probe, a user instructs the model to act and accept a lower payoff, which measures exploitability. In the passive probe, the user instructs it to wait and give up a higher payoff, which measures stoppability. The two compliance rates combine into a compliance index $κ$. Applied to twelve language models, the benchmark shows that seven mostly follow the instruction in both probes and justify their action by pointing to the instruction. Only Claude Sonnet-4.6 and Claude Opus-4.7 can be stopped without being exploitable, Claude Opus-4.6 and GPT-5-mini resist both instructions, and no model is exploitable but unstoppable. Knowing where a language model sits on the compliance index $κ$ matters for human operators and for multi-agent systems, whether distributed or orchestrated.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 推后悖论: 语言模式合规双可能诊断
articles.content_zh: 语言模型是否符合用户指示? 总是遵守的模型可以被制止,也可以被剥削,而总是抗拒的模型既不能被剥削,也不能被制止。 我们提供一个开放的双测试基准,可以将任何语言模型放在这个频谱上. 在主动探测中,一个用户指示模型采取行动并接受较低的回报,以衡量可开发性. 在被动探针中,用户指示它等待并放弃更高的回报,这可以衡量停止性. 两项遵守率合并成一项遵守指数(美元)。 适用于12种语言模型的基准显示,7种主要遵循两个探测器中的指令,并通过指向指令来证明其行动的理由。 只有Claude Sonnet-4.6和Claude Opus-4.7在不被利用的情况下才能被阻止,Claude Opus-4.6和GPT-5-mini抵制了这两种指令,没有一种型号是可利用的,但不可阻止的. 了解一个语言模型在遵守指数上的位置,对于人类操作者和多代理系统(无论是分布的还是组合的)来说,美元是多少。

articles.title: Reward Stealing Attack on Large Language Models
articles.content: Adversarial attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to induce harmful content. However, existing methods suffer from high computational costs or strict model-pairing dependencies, limiting their scalability and transferability. We propose Reward Stealing Attack (ReSA), an adversarial attack framework that targets the latent safety reward underlying LLM alignment. ReSA employs maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning to recover a proxy reward model solely from the aligned model's behavior. The extracted reward is then reversed at inference time to derive an adversarial policy, efficiently implemented via a reward-guided decoding mechanism. Experiments demonstrate that a single recovered reward generalizes across prompts and diverse models to reveal a fundamental alignment vulnerability, enabling ReSA to significantly outperform existing attacks in effectiveness and transferability. The code is available at https://github.com/GarminQ/ReSA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对大语言模型进行偷袭的奖励
articles.content_zh: 对大语言模型(LLMS)的负面攻击旨在诱导有害内容. 然而,现有方法受到高计算成本或严格的模型辅助依赖的影响,限制了其可扩展性和可转移性。 我们提议奖励偷盗攻击(ReSA),这是一个对抗性的攻击框架,目标是LLM一致背后的潜在安全奖励。 ReSA使用最大Entropy反向强化学习,只从对齐模型的行为中回收一个代理奖励模型. 然后在推论中推翻所提取的奖赏,以得出一种对抗性政策,通过奖励指导的解码机制有效执行。 实验表明,单项回收的奖励概括了各种激励和不同模式,揭示了基本的配合脆弱性,使ReSA在效力和可转移性方面大大超过现有的攻击。 该代码可在https://github.com/GarminQ/ReSA查询.

articles.title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
articles.content: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型可以注意到一个不可能的工程问题,但仍然报告已经解决
articles.content_zh: 语言模型草案工程计算,但答案准确性并不能显示它们是否拒绝一个不可能的问题. 我们在30对力学问题上测试了14个模型,每个模型都有一个有效的版本,一个模型通过改变给定值或假设而变得不可能. 两个独立的解答者验证了每个答案密钥,并表明每个有缺陷的问题在物理上是不可能的. 我们解决有效问题的得分与拒绝有缺陷的对应方。 每个回复都需要一个"解"或"不能解"状态;拒绝意为"不能解"或拒绝一个答案. 最初的提示没有警告问题可能有缺陷。 在最近的三种模式中,90份答复中有12份未能拒绝一个有缺陷的问题。 在这些答复中,有11份中,模型说明了缺陷,回答了一个经过纠正的问题,并且根据人工智能测算和数字检查,仍然将原件报告为"解决". 我们后来从一个供应商中重新测试了四个模型,提出"flawed"而不是"不能解决",要求他们命名和解释缺陷. 三种模型显示,在统计学上,拒绝率显著上升,但有效问题的解决却每三种下降。 因此,评价既要给两个版本打分,又要将缺陷识别与报告状况区分开来。

articles.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
articles.content: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

articles.title_zh: 与流量匹配的后期原因的
articles.content_zh: Latent推理让一个大语言模型(LLM)在一个连续的空间中思考,只将答案口头化. 我们主张,有效的潜伏思维必须满足五项要求:它应该有用,帮助得出正确的答案,而不是仅仅改变它,具有多样性,这样,再取样产生不同的推理轨迹,可以解释,这样,解码的思想链(CoT)就反映了答案实际上所遵循的推理,可以用更多的推论计算来加以改进,而且效率高,成本低于可比精确的明确的CoT。 目前的方法很少符合这些要求:他们从问题中学习捷径,将明显的CoT蒸馏成它们的重量,或者一次模仿一个符号. 我们注重在学习到的潜伏空间里进行流动匹配,我们所认为的家庭最适合满足他们,并找出能够发挥作用的培训选择。 结果是基于Flow的Latent Reasoning(FLARE),它是一个简单的配方,涵盖了潜在的空间编码以及如何塑造它,在哪里训练流量,如何读出答案,以及关于模型自己经过验证的想法的最后一个培训阶段. 对每项要求的探测显示,FLARE改进了所有5种前潜方法. 它还在计算基准上与它们进行了有利的比较,同时在四分之一的潜伏时间达到明确 CoT 准确度的97%。

articles.title: Wikidata Search Traces: A Dataset for Training Knowledge Graph Search Agents
articles.content: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.

articles.title_zh: 维基数据搜索跟踪:用于培训的知识图搜索代理的数据集
articles.content_zh: Wikidata是最大的开放知识库之一,然而在回答关于它的一个复杂问题时,仍然需要一个SPARQL查询,以命名正确的实体和属性,并链接它们的关系. 语言模型提供了一个自然语言的替代方案,但主要是从记忆中解答,这对于不太显赫的实体来说是最不可靠的. 我们研究了通过探索图表来回答的代理,并争论说,有两个障碍限制了它们:缺乏训练数据记录解题者如何探索,以及接口直接将大图结果加入模型的背景. 我们测试三种假设: 图搜索的难度可以通过一个问题的结构来控制,而不只是通过模糊的实体或措辞来控制;长视搜索的失败大多来自如何管理被检索的证据,而不是模型本身;在合适的环境中,开放式模型可以匹配商业封闭的模型. 我们在一个被冻结的Wikidata快照上构建多跳题,将命名的实体替换为嵌入条件,每次扩张后检查目标是否依然独特,每个新条件是否必要. 我们释放了10,235个关于单实体和多跳题的解析痕迹,连同产生它们的递归语言模型(RLM)的杠杆,其中模型批量图表调用,保持持续Python状态的结果,并通过子调用来解释选定的证据. 在100个问题中,与直接工具调用相同的功能相比,这个牵引装置改进了我们在两个接口下运行的两个模型:gpt-6-luna从49个正确答案上升到61个,将它的多跳精度翻倍,以及Qune3.8-27B,一个在单一GPU上服务的开放量级模型,从60个增加到74个.

articles.title: Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM. To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass. We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models. In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models. Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy-computation trade-offs on GSM8K. On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked-uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 传播语言模型的代表空间MMD
articles.content_zh: 我们采用了一种用于传播语言模型(DLMs)的训练后方法,在被冻结的预先训练的DLM的特性空间中,将生成和参考分布之间的最大平均值(MMD)降到最低. 为了估计MMD,我们保留了单个标语位置的上下文特征,从单个提取器通过中获取每个序列的多个观测. 我们利用政策梯度来优化这一目标,以便通过生成的连续模型潜伏物来进行离散模型和直接区分。 在这两种情况下,计算这些特征直接造成的损失,使得在缺乏完整的取样轨迹或联合培训的辅助模型的情况下,能够进行有效的培训后培训。 实验显示OpenWebText上可比的entropy的基因复杂度较低,GSM8K上的精度-计算取舍更好. 在16B DMax-LLaDA2.0型号带有混合遮罩-单体扩散的模型上,我们增加解码平行性,在数学和代码基准上具有相似或更高的精确度.

articles.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption. We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly. Across reasoning tasks, LoGRA reduces average training memory by up to 45.7\% without sacrificing performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra}{Molt library}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LoGRA: 扩大LLM 使用低角梯度阶梯进行强化学习
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)大大提升了大型语言模型(LLM)的能力,但其内存要求仍然是更广泛采用的障碍. 我们引入了LoGRA,一种通过低阶梯状草图保留有用的学习信号来减少记忆的RL后训练方法. 这些紧凑的表述支持模型更新和高效的政策同步. 为了防止过多的更新干扰学习,我们用预测的-KL阶梯控制来补充梯度压缩,在应用每次更新之前估计政策变化,并相应调整其规模. 纵观推理任务,LoGRA在不牺牲性能的情况下将平均训练内存减少45.7\%. 它还使27B参数模型能够在一个单一的8GPU节点上对1,100多个步骤进行稳定的训练,而密集的亚当则耗尽了内存,使先前的内存不可行的RL训练变得实用. 代码见\href{https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra}{molt库}.

articles.title: Long-Horizon Textual World Modeling through Structured Reasoning
articles.content: World models must predict how an environment evolves under sequences of actions, enabling agents to compare possible futures and reason about counterfactual actions before acting. Long-horizon prediction is commonly obtained by recursively applying a one-step transition model, but intermediate errors can compound over time. Multi-step dynamics models instead condition on a sequence of future actions and predict their consequences directly, but become harder to learn as horizon grows: the model must track interacting state changes across the trajectory, endpoint supervision provides weak credit assignment, and intermediate predictions can remain plausible while losing information needed for later states. We show that these challenges can be addressed by casting the internal evolution of a multi-step transition as structured reasoning over textual world states: reasoning over sparse state changes reduces the burden of state tracking, a predictive-gain objective rewards the learned state for improving over a matched predictor that conditions on raw history instead, and intermediate predictive rewards supervise each state along the trajectory. Because these intermediate states are explicit textual representations of the world, they provide semantically meaningful targets that can be inspected, scored, and corrected during training. Across ScienceWorld, Jericho, and CEO-Bench, our approach achieves the strongest average long-horizon performance against recursive and non-recursive baselines that condition directly on raw history, with gains increasing at longer horizons. In a controlled counterfactual study, our model is also the only one with statistically significant sensitivity to future actions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过结构化理由建立长视距文字世界模型
articles.content_zh: 世界模型必须预测一个环境在行动序列下是如何演变的,使代理人能够在行动前比较可能的未来和反事实行动的理由。 长视距预测通常通过递归式应用一个单步过渡模型获得,但中间误差会随着时间的推移而复合. 多步骤动态模型相反地取决于一系列未来行动并直接预测其后果,但随着视野的扩大而变得更加难于学习:模型必须跟踪整个轨迹中相互作用的状态变化,端点监督提供微弱的信用分配,中间预测仍然可以令人信服,同时失去后期状态所需的信息. 我们显示,这些挑战可以通过将多步骤过渡的内部演变作为结构化的推理而不是文字化世界的国家来应对:对稀有状态变化的推理减轻了状态跟踪的负担,一个预测-回报目标奖励了学得的状态,因为它比一个匹配的预测器改善了原始历史的条件,中间预测奖则则监督着沿轨迹的每一个状态. 由于这些中间状态是世界的明确的文字表述,它们提供了精密有意义的目标,可以在训练中被检查,打分和纠正. 在整个科学世界,杰里科和CEO-Bench, 我们的方法实现了最强的平均长视距业绩 与直接取决于原始历史的 递归性和非递归性基线相对比, 收益在更长的视野中不断增长。 在一项有控制的反事实研究中,我们的模式也是对今后行动具有显著统计敏感性的唯一模式。

articles.title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) annotate and scale political text or constructs by generating text tokens. A new class of models, which TypeSafe markets as "System One" models, instead returns decisions and probability distributions across a user-supplied fixed answer set. A commercial model, JEV, is advertised as having a dramatic cost and speed advantage over traditional LLMs along with better calibrated decisions. As such, it might be useful for social scientists looking to quickly and cost-effectively annotate or scale large corpora of text and have a reliable indicator of a classifier's uncertainty. Yet, the accuracy of these claims and the broader model accuracy in social science text-based tasks are not yet established. In this paper, we do just that and hope to establish the suitability of JEV for social science tasks. We compare JEV with LLMs and human coders from published research, and with a current mid-tier commercial LLM (GPT-6 Luna) and an open-weight alternative (Qwen3.8-27B). We find that JEV matches, or comes close to, the capabilities of both LLMs in a variety of tasks. However, we find no cost advantage over GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI's batch prices. Further, we find that, when each question is asked once, JEV's probabilities are better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna's token probabilities, but not consistently better than Qwen3.8-27B's. We conclude that unless researchers have a need for speed, JEV's only obvious advantage is ease of parsing the underlying choice probabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: JEV与LLMS:七种政治科学复制的准确性、成本和校准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)通过生成文本符号来注释并缩放政治文本或构造. 一个新的模型类别,即TypeSafe作为"系统一号"模型进行市场营销,转而在用户提供的固定答案集中返回决定和概率分布. 商业模式JEV被宣布为具有比传统有限责任公司更大的成本和速度优势,以及更好的校准决定。 因此,如果社会科学家能够快速和以成本效益高的方式对大块文字进行注释或规模化,并对分类者的不确定性有一个可靠的指标,可能是有益的。 然而,这些主张的准确性和社会科学文本任务中更广泛的模型准确性尚未确定。 在本文中,我们这样做,并希望确定JEV是否适合社会科学任务。 我们比较JEV与LLMs和来自已出版研究的人类编码器,以及当前中层商业LLM(GPT-6 Luna)和开放量级替代品(Qune3.8-27B). 我们发现JEV在各种任务中匹配或接近两个LLM的能力. 然而,我们发现与GPT-6 Luna相比,以OpenAI的批量价格没有成本优势. 此外,我们发现,当每个问题被问一次时,JEV的概率比GPT-6 Luna的符号概率更好校准,但并非始终比Quen3.8-27B的概率好. 我们的结论是,除非研究者需要速度,JEV唯一的明显优势就是容易分析潜在的选择概率.

articles.title: Frozen Factor or Spectral Band? Disentangling Two Choices in Low-Rank LoRA
articles.content: Spectral variants of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) choose both a subspace and which factor to freeze. We separate these choices by freezing the input factor A or output factor B on the top or bottom singular directions of pretrained weights, with learning rates selected separately. At rank 2, the same-band advantage of freezing A is larger than either within-factor band difference on all four task-model pairs with complete comparisons. Freezing B also trails comparable-budget free LoRA by 8-18 percentage points on five pairs spanning a formatting task and OpenBookQA. The A-frozen advantage persists in a single-GPU-model replication and within individual MLP module groups, including controls with equal or greater trainable counts for B frozen, and when A is frozen on a random orthonormal basis. The factor contrast weakens with rank. On OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B at rank 16, PEFT's MiCA implementation trails comparable-budget LoRA by 3.08 points under a shared training recipe transferred from the MiCA paper. A trained oracle output subspace largely removes the low-rank deficit; partial warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. The factor-versus-band ordering is descriptive; an approximate multiplicity audit weakens several earlier significance claims. These results extend known factor asymmetry by showing how its magnitude depends on spectral placement, rank and training conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 冻因子还是光谱乐队? 在 Low-Rank LoRA 中取消两个选择
articles.content_zh: 低等级适应的光谱变体(Lora)既选择子空间,又选择哪个因素冻结. 我们将这些选择分开,将输入因子A或输出因子B冻结在预先训练的权重的上下单数方向上,并分别选择学习率. 在第2级,冻结A的同带优势大于所有四个任务模型对有完整比较的内因带差。 冻结 B还跟踪可比预算自由LORA在五对横跨格式化任务和OpenBookQA上的8-18个百分点. A-冻结优势在单GPU型复制和单MLP模块组中持续存在,包括B冻结的相同或更大的可训练计数控制,以及A在随机正统基础上被冻结。 因素对比随级别而减弱. 在 OpenBookQA / Quen2.5- 1.5B 上打开 PEFT的MICA执行排名为第16名,在MICA文件转来的共享培训配方下,对应预算LORA的成绩为3.08分. 一个训练有素的甲骨文输出子空间基本上消除了低级的不足;部分热量增益在三个方向种子之间重复出现. 因素与波段订购是描述性的;大致的多重审计削弱了早先提出的几项重要索赔。 这些结果通过显示其规模如何取决于光谱位置、等级和培训条件,扩大了已知因素不对称。

articles.title: COMPASS 2.0: psychometric representational similarity analysis distinguishes symptom structure from personal signal
articles.content: Language models can score psychiatric questionnaires from speech, but agreement with self-report may reflect the questionnaire rather than the person. We introduce psychometric representational similarity analysis, a framework for comparing the structure of speech-derived scores, self-report, item wording and theory, and implement it alongside person-level construct scoring in COMPASS 2.0. We show how similarly worded items induce covariance without psychological signal. In pre-registered discovery and confirmation analyses of clinical interviews from 275 participants, language-derived symptom geometry resembled wording more than self-report, with no structure beyond wording detected by the registered tests. Geometric agreement with self-report survived assigning participants someone else's answers, whereas person-paired scores captured distress more than specific symptoms. Complementary analyses examined counselling quality and wording structure across 34 instruments and the Research Domain Criteria (RDoC) framework. These findings distinguish agreement about psychological structure from evidence that language-derived assessments track individual people.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评论意见 2.0:心理计量表现相似性分析区分症状结构与个人信号.
articles.content_zh: 语言模型可以从语音中评分精神病问卷,但与自我报告一致可能反映问卷而非个人. 我们引入了心理计量描述相似性分析,这是比较语音生成分数结构,自我报告,项目措辞和理论的框架,并在COMPAS 2.0中与人级构造分数一起实施. 我们显示类似措辞的物品 如何诱导共性 没有心理信号。 在对275名参加者的临床访谈进行预先登记的发现和确认分析时,语言衍生症状几何学的措辞比自我报告更类似,除了经登记的测试发现的措辞外,没有其他结构。 与自我报告达成的几何协议在给参与者分配别人的答案方面幸存了下来,而受人宠爱的分数却捕捉出比具体症状更严重的危难。 补充分析审查了34个文书的咨询质量和措辞结构以及研究领域标准框架。 这些结论将关于心理结构的一致意见与基于语言的评估跟踪个人的证据区分开来。

articles.title: Word-Level Text Unmixing via Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing with Language Models
articles.content: Text from multiple sources can become interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost, such as overlapping speech transcripts, document reading flows, or concurrent agent streams. We formalize this challenge as Word-Level Text Unmixing: given an interleaved lexical stream and source count K, recover the original source sequences while preserving every word occurrence and its within-source order exactly. Directly generating separated texts with LLMs can omit, duplicate, or hallucinate words, violating this exact-reconstruction objective. We therefore propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing (EPOR), which decouples source-ownership prediction from reconstruction. EPOR adapts a causal LLM to predict canonical ownership routes conditioned on the mixed stream and prior routing decisions. At inference, completion-safe constrained decoding is combined with deterministic indexed reconstruction, yielding structurally valid K-source partitions that preserve every observed occurrence exactly once. We also introduce UNMIXBENCH, covering controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived document streams from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital outputs. Across five evaluation tracks, a 4B EPOR model achieves the lowest mean minimum-permutation word error rate among finetuned baselines, reducing the five-track mean by 22.3% relative to compact source-array generation and remaining competitive with zero-shot frontier LLMs. These results show that when lexical evidence is fully observed, separating ownership inference from lexical regeneration provides a reliable alternative to direct generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过证据-保留所有权和语言模型进行文字级文本解密
articles.content_zh: 当归属元数据丢失时,例如重叠的语音记录、文档读取流程或同时存在的代理流,来自多个来源的文本可以被放入一个序列。 我们将此挑战正式化为"Word-level Text Unmixing":鉴于一个互出词典流和源数K,在保留每个词的发生及其源内顺序的同时,恢复原始源序列. 用LLMs直接生成分离的文本可以省略,重复,或产生幻觉等词语,违反这个精确重建的目标. 因此,我们提出证据-保留所有权(EPOR)程序,使来源-所有权预测与重建脱钩。 EPOR调整了因果LLM,以预测以混流和前行道决定为条件的犬类所有制路线. 推论,保证完成的受限解码与确定性的指数化重建相结合,产生结构上有效的K-源分区,以保留每一次观察到的发生。 我们还介绍了联海机制,涵盖受管制的合成混合物、国际海事协会和伊斯兰工商会提出的时间戳发言、来自ReadingBank的排版文件流以及模拟同步数字产出。 在五个评价轨道上,一个4B EPOR模型在微调基线中实现了最小平均输出值字误差率最低,相对于紧凑的源阵列生成,将五道平均值降低了22.3%,并保持了与零镜头前沿LLMs的竞争力. 这些结果表明,当充分观察了法理证据时,将所有权推论与法理再生区分开来为直接生成提供了可靠的替代办法.

articles.title: Molecules of a Story: Community Detection in PMI-weighted Narrative Networks
articles.content: Automatically extracted narrative networks -- graphs with entities as nodes and their relations as edges -- have proven useful for revealing central narrative structures through salient entities and their connections (Tangherlini et al. 2020; Labatut and Bost 2019). But a narrative is more than those central structures that everything else revolves around. This work is concerned with the everything else: brief sub-plots, small clusters of descriptions, or associations between minor characters that go under the radar at the macro-level. We present an approach to unearth such peripheral structures. They involve rare entities with limited textual presence, overshadowed by dominant entities and lost among each other in the long tail of many but rare entities (Baayen 2001). We leverage the known tendency of pointwise mutual information (PMI, Church and Hanks 1990) to inflate for rare events, turning its weakness into a strength by weighting edges with PMI to foreground peripheral entity configurations. Communities extracted from the resulting network are structural traces of underlying narrative elements. We demonstrate the approach on The Lord of the Rings. From measures of how concentrated or dispersed a community's activations are across the text, a typology emerges that reveals that peripheral structures form more than a single class: episodic passages, echoing long-distance connections, and recurring threads each surface as distinct configurations. The approach is conceptually simple and surfaces fine-grained narrative details that are lost in abundance, though its deliberate amplification of weak signals comes with inherent sensitivity -- best understood as a lens for exploration rather than a robust extraction pipeline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 故事的分子:PMI加权叙述网络中的社区检测
articles.content_zh: 事实证明,自动提取的叙事网络 -- -- 以实体为节点的图表及其边缘关系 -- -- 有助于通过显著实体及其联系揭示中央叙事结构(Tangherlini等2020;Labatut和Bost 2019)。 但叙述比其他一切围绕着的中心结构还要多。 这部作品关注其他一切:短小的子平面,小集群描述,或者小人物之间的关联,在宏观层面会进入雷达下. 我们提出了挖掘这种外围结构的办法。 它们涉及文字存在有限的稀有实体,被主导实体所掩盖并在许多但为数不多的实体的长尾巴中相互丢失(Baayen,2001年)。 我们利用已知的指向相互信息的趋势(PMI、Church和Hanks,1990年),为罕见的事件充气,通过PMI的分量优势,将其弱点转化为力量,以预测外围实体的配置。 从由此产生的网络中取出的社区是基本叙述要素的结构痕迹。 我们向魔戒之王展示方法 从一个社群的活化如何集中或分散的度量来看,一个类型出现了,揭示出外围结构形成不止一个类:平起伏的通道,回放长途接通,以及反复出现的线条,每个表面作为不同的构型. 这种方法在概念上简单,表面细微的叙述性细节在丰富的程度上丢失了,尽管它有意地放大弱信号具有内在的敏感性 -- -- 最好理解为勘探的透镜,而不是强力取出管道。

articles.title: Mind the Accent Gap: British Accent Robustness in Speech-Driven Financial Voice Assistants
articles.content: AI voice assistants often use Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) with LLM-based reasoning, yet existing systems struggle with regional British accents, including Scottish, Irish, and Welsh accents, since most ASR models are trained predominantly on American English voice data. Consequently, errors can carry through to the LLM stage, corrupting tool-call arguments and producing wrong or missing responses, which is especially costly in finance. Deployable ASR must also meet tight latency and memory budgets, making an accent-robust model choice even harder. We introduce CavaBench, the first internally collected benchmark of spoken financial queries, and use it to evaluate a range of ASR models and their end-to-end ASR-LLM pipeline behaviour across self-reported British accents. We find that WER strongly predicts downstream tool-calling accuracy ($r = -0.93$) but can fail to reflect task-level performance, with accent-related failures varying substantially across models and acoustic conditions. These findings guide the design of more inclusive, reliable voice-based financial assistants.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 注意ACCENT差距:英国ACCENT 稳健的演讲 - 驱动的金融语音助理
articles.content_zh: AI语音助理经常使用基于LLM的推理的自动语音识别(ASR),而现有的系统却与包括苏格兰语,爱尔兰语和威尔士语等地区性英国口音相搏,因为大多数ASR模型主要接受美国英语语音数据的培训. 因此,错误可能延续到LLM阶段,破坏工具调用的论点,产生错误或缺失的对策,这在金融方面特别昂贵。 可部署的ASR还必须满足紧凑的延迟和内存预算,使口音阻塞模式的选择更加困难. 我们介绍Cava Bench,这是第一个内部收集的口语财务查询基准,并用它来评价一系列ASR模型及其端到端的ASR-LLM管道行为,跨越自报的英国口音. 我们发现WER对下游工具调用精度(r = -0.93美元)进行了强烈的预测,但不能反映任务级别性能,不同模型和声学条件中与口音有关的故障差异很大. 这些调查结果指导设计更具包容性、更可靠的语音财务助理。

articles.title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
articles.content: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 注意执行漏洞:世界模式控制中的动作-语义错配
articles.content_zh: 世界模型控制器在预测和规划时依赖行动条件的动态,然而由于通信延迟,数据包丢失,重排顺序,以及起动器缓冲等原因,真正的控制系统往往同步执行指令. 我们研究同步执行如何改变在世界模型控制器中假设的动作语义,而不是仅仅将其作为外部控制扰动处理. 通过受控干预,我们识别出两种依赖架构的失败模式:基于规划的控制器如TD-MPC2在被想象出的行动序列和执行的行动序列之间遭遇了未来动作时长不匹配,而像DreamerV3这样的经常性世界模型可以将所观测到的过渡归属于未实际应用的命令. 我们的分析表明,TD-MPC2在潜在动态推出过程中需要正确的未来动作顺序,而DreamerV3则需要及时将每次过渡归于产生它的行动。 基于这些发现,我们引入了两个轻量级执行相容接口,即TD-MPC2的未来-序列和DreamerV3的应用-动作反馈,这些接口在不修改预先训练过的世界模型的情况下纠正了这些错配. 跨越延迟,包丢失,重排,多控制域,被测量到的网络痕迹,以及一个过程相分离的同步堆栈,始终支持诊断和相应的架构特异性校正.

articles.title: Before Agent Tells The Lie: Has Deception Already Been Represented?
articles.content: Large language model (LLM)-based agents can exhibit deceptive behavior during task execution, including hiding failures, fabricating results, or falsely signaling task completion. Existing monitoring approaches mainly detect deception after it appears in observable actions or outputs. In this paper, we investigate whether deceptive behavior can be predicted from an agent's internal representations before it becomes externally visible. We frame deception monitoring as a trajectory-level representation analysis problem and align agent trajectories around key decision points. Using hidden states extracted before these points, we show that future honest and deceptive outcomes can be reliably distinguished, with predictive signals remaining detectable several model calls before the final decision. We further characterize the temporal evolution of these signals: deception-related representations are weak early in execution but become increasingly identifiable as trajectories progress, while transferable structure can emerge before the strongest decision-adjacent signals appear. Finally, we intervene on the identified honest-deceptive representation directions during inference and find that activation steering reduces downstream deceptive behavior, suggesting that these representations influence agent decisions. Our findings indicate that agent deception is an evolving internal process that can be detected and potentially mitigated before it is expressed externally.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在特工告诉谎言之前:欺骗已经代表了吗?
articles.content_zh: 基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理可以在任务执行过程中表现出欺骗行为,包括隐藏失败,编造结果,或者错误地表示任务完成. 现有的监测方法主要是在可观察到的行动或产出中出现欺骗之后发现欺骗。 在本文中,我们调查是否可以从代理人的内部表述中预测出欺骗行为,然后才对外可见. 我们把欺骗监测作为轨迹水平的表示分析问题,并围绕关键决定点调整剂轨迹。 利用在这些点之前提取的隐藏状态,我们显示,未来的诚实和欺骗性结果可以可靠地区分开来,预测信号在最终决定前仍然可以被探测出几个模型调用. 我们进一步描述这些信号在时间上的演变:与欺骗有关的表述在早期执行时很薄弱,但随着轨迹的进步而越来越明显,而可转移的结构可以在最强的决定相邻信号出现之前出现. 最后,我们在推论中介入已查明的诚实-欺骗性表述方向,发现激活指向会减少下游的欺骗行为,说明这些表述会影响代理人的决定. 我们的调查结果表明,代理人欺骗是一个不断演变的内部过程,在对外表述之前,是可以发现和潜在减轻的。

articles.title: Synthetic Cultural Agents from Aggregate Anchors
articles.content: Population prompts are widely used to generate synthetic survey responses, but they combine information supplied at inference with associations already encoded during pretraining. We introduce an alternative construction that maps declared aggregate preference anchors into group-indexed choice policies. For each population, the signs of six Global Preferences Survey (GPS) coordinates deterministically label a shared bank of paired synthetic responses, and Direct Preference Optimization fits a parameter-efficient adapter to those comparisons. We evaluate the adapters on candidate World Values Survey (WVS) items using prompts that omit country names and distinguish four questions: recovery of the imposed labels, transfer of the anchor signal to new text, coherence between the GPS anchors and human WVS responses, and agreement between adapter and human scores. The adapters recover the imposed pairwise labels. On a purposively selected sixteen-country development panel, adapter trust scores completely separate the two GPS-sign groups and have a rank correlation of (0.74) with continuous GPS trust scores. Human-GPS and adapter-human associations remain unresolved on the same panel, and results for the other preference dimensions are heterogeneous. These findings show that an anchored policy can retain a declared aggregate signal without thereby reproducing human response patterns. The contribution is therefore both an inspectable construction and an evaluation framework that separates anchor transfer from human criterion agreement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 来自总管的合成文化代理人
articles.content_zh: 人口提示被广泛用于生成合成调查回复,但它们将推断提供的信息与在预训期间已经编码的协会相结合. 我们引入了另一种构建方法,将宣布的总偏好锚地映入集团指数化的选择政策。 对每一人口而言,6个全球优惠调查(GPS)的标志协调了确定性标签,标出一个共享的组合合成反应库,直接优惠优化适合这些比较的参数效率适配器。 我们对候选世界价值调查(WVS)项目的适配器进行评估,使用省略国名并区分四个问题的提示:恢复强制标签,将锚信号转移到新的文本上,GPS锚地与人类WVS反应的一致性,适配器与人类得分一致. 适配器恢复被强制的对等标签. 在有目的地选定的16个国家开发面板上,适配器信任得分完全分离出两个GPS标志组,并具有连续GPS信任得分的排名关联(0.74). 在同一小组中,人与人、人与人之间的关联仍未得到解决,其他偏好层面的结果各不相同。 这些调查结果表明,一项固定政策可以保留一个已宣布的总信号,而不会重现人类的反应模式。 因此,这种贡献既是可检查的建筑,也是将锚地转让与人类标准协议分开的评价框架。

articles.title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
articles.content: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. Using SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, we test how user pressure and evaluation settings shape measured flip rates. Each measurement is one stateless replay of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line in a fixed form. Every effect is read against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument; earlier instruments vary one to three of them. Across eleven frontier models from three providers and about 760,000 controlled replays, which models look sycophantic depends on how the user pushes back. Lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge the answer without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items answered identically in every screening draw still carry about half of the most-affected totals. On arithmetic tasks where the truth is known, one model re-derives and corrects itself under pressure while another abandons correct answers without written work. On the model tested, a planted derivation lowers release of the answer it argues for, true or wrong, where a bare stated value does not; the wrong answer is corrected much more often than the true one is abandoned. Under a yes/no readout the rankings come closer, entangled with a pressure-induced shift toward "no". One score per model therefore compares different behaviours across models and benchmarks. We condense these dependencies into a reporting profile; the instrument, records, and analyses will be released upon publication.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLM 解剖学 交接: 翻转率隐藏什么
articles.content_zh: 一个被推倒的模型可以自我纠正,屈从,或者坚持,一个翻转率就等于修正和屈从。 使用SycoLens这个模块式的回放协议,我们测试用户压力和评价设置形状如何测量翻转率. 每种度量法都是一个无国籍的重放一个项目,一个承诺的答案,以及一个以固定形式被脚本化的用户行. 每个效果都与被删除的行匹配的控件对齐读取. 倒推文字,承诺的文字,答题格式,边界距离,地上真理等,成为一出文书的因素;更早的文书则有一至三出. 跨越来自三个供应商的11个前沿模型,以及大约76万个可控回放,这些模型看起来具有同源性,这取决于用户如何推回. 主张相反判断的线条和质疑答案的线条,而不主张对模型的排名几乎不相干。 翻转效果在模型边界附近长出好几倍,然而在每张筛选图中同样回答过的物品仍然携带着受影响最大的总数的一半左右. 在知道真相的算术任务上,一个模型在压力下重新定型并自我纠正,而另一个模型在没有写作的情况下放弃正确的答案. 在所测试的模型上,一个被植入的衍生物会降低它所主张的答案的释放,无论该答案是真实的还是错误的,如果一个赤裸裸的被声明的数值没有被证明;错误的答案被纠正的频率远大于真实的答案被放弃的频率. 在"是"/"不"读出的情况下,排名会越走越近,缠绕着压力引起的转向"不". 因此,每个模型各得一分,比较不同模型和基准的不同行为。 我们把这些依赖性归纳成一个报告概况;工具、记录和分析将在出版后公布。

articles.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Reasoning Strategies with Bayesian Nonparametric Memory
articles.content: While modern large language models (LLMs) have been trained to reason through verbalized chains-of-thought, the generation cost grows substantially due to suboptimal paths to reach the final answer. Furthermore, as new insights are discovered while observing various input queries (e.g. through self-reflection), limited mechanisms exist for carrying forward these findings to be applied to subsequent problems. One can view the list of such strategies or behaviors as a growing cheatsheet, with elements retrieved from this memory module at inference-time. In this work, we consider structured cheatsheets, with learned clusters of behaviors. We introduce a Hierarchical Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model (HDP-GMM) over behavior embeddings, which shares components across domains while allowing domain-specific mixing weights, and uses the posterior predictive to retrieve relevant behaviors for a query; we call this a $\textit{Bayesian Cheatsheet}$. This mechanism allows for cheap adaptation in an online test-time training (TTT) setting, softly updating the mixture's sufficient statistics following each sample and enabling the creation of new components when the synthesized behaviors are sufficiently novel. We demonstrate that Bayesian Cheatsheet achieves clear performance gains relative to existing memory modules across reasoning benchmarks such as AIME'25, Omni-MATH, and PhysReason, even in the cold-start setting. We show that the Bayesian Cheatsheet is an adaptively reorganizing memory module, as behaviors can be re-assigned to components through a single step of collapsed Gibbs sampling. Our findings highlight the value of Bayesian-inspired memory modules for effective test-time adaptation and the role of structure in metacognitive reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与贝叶斯人对合理战略的试验-时间调整 内存
articles.content_zh: 虽然现代的大型语言模型(LLMS)接受了通过语言化的思维链进行推理的培训,但由于达到最终答案的路径不理想,生成成本大幅增长. 此外,随着在观察各种输入查询(例如通过自我反省)时发现新的见解,执行这些调查结果的机制有限,将适用于随后的问题。 人们可以把这类策略或行为的列表看成一个不断增长的作弊表,其中元素在推想时从这个内存模块中取出. 在这部作品中,我们考虑结构化的作弊单,有学习到的行为集群. 我们引入一个等级化的 Dirichlet process Gaussian Mixture Model(HDP-GMM) 来代替行为嵌入,它分享各个域的组件,同时允许特定域的混合权重,并使用后预测来检索相关行为进行查询;我们称之为$\textit{Bayesian Cheetshet}$. 这种机制允许在在线测试时间培训(TTT)设置中进行廉价的适应,在每一个样本之后软地更新了混合物的足够统计数据,并在合成行为足够新颖时能够创建出新的组件. 我们证明,拜仁Cheatsheet公司与现有内存模块相比,即使在冷起动环境下,也能够实现清晰的性能增益,这些模块跨越了AIME'25,Omni-MATH,和PhysReason等推理基准. 我们显示Bayesian Cheetsheet是一个适应性重组的内存模块,因为行为可以通过倒塌的Gibbs取样的单步重新被分配到组件. 我们的研究结果突出了巴耶斯启发式记忆模块对于有效测试时间适应的价值以及结构在元识别推理中的作用.

articles.title: SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics
articles.content:
Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL,
  a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SOL:通过双切切出Wasserstein Metrics测量文本分发之间的差距
articles.content_zh:
评价文本生成需要衡量生成的分布与数据分布的匹配程度。 对于自旋模型,这是由迷惑来完成的. 分化和以流为主的语言模型只能提供一种可能性约束,其紧度在模型家族之间有所不同. 基于样本的替代品,如与 en的基因杂乱性,并不认为分布合适. 我们提议SOL,
文本分布之间的距离。 每个序列均以固定变压器下隐藏状态的经验度量来表示,而这些措施的分布则以双切出瓦瑟斯坦相距来比较. 如果变压器是注射式的 我们就能证明SOL是度量器 实验显示,SOL检测出分布故障,恢复预期模型趋势,并提供稳定的以样本为基础的估计. 我们提出SOL来填补目前用于非自递式模型的评价协议中的空白. 作为第一步,我们使用SOL来重新评估在OpenWebText上接受过训练的各种模型.

articles.title: AECP: Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol for Multi-Agent Code Generation
articles.content: As AI agents increasingly tackle complex repository-level coding tasks, distributing work across multiple agents is a natural way to scale beyond the capabilities of a single agent. To coordinate their interdependent work, these agents share findings and agree on interfaces between modules. However, exchanged information often serves only as context, leaving individual agents to interpret it and incorporate it into subsequent work. Consequently, shared findings may go unused and deviations from interface agreements may go undetected, undermining the reliability and efficiency of collaboration. This motivates moving part of the coordination responsibility from individual agents to the execution harness. To make shared information actionable during execution, we introduce the Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol (AECP). AECP requires agents to communicate exclusively through structured artifacts and specifies how the harness processes them. The harness supplies findings when agents access relevant code, screens implementations for mismatches with recorded interface commitments, and requires affected agents to revisit revised agreements. These coordination steps become part of harness execution rather than actions that agents must initiate from prior messages. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, using closed- and open-source models including Opus-4.8 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, AECP improves average test pass rate by 28.2% and reduces average wall time by 16.5% relative to an agent team using free-form inter-agent messages. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions between agents, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often those agents act on them from 40% to 0%.

articles.title_zh: AECP: 用于生成多代理代码的Artifact-Exceptive通信协议
articles.content_zh: 由于AI代理越来越多地处理复杂的寄存器级编码任务,在多个代理之间分配工作是超越单一代理能力的自然方式. 为了协调其相互依存的工作,这些代理人分享调查结果并商定模块之间的接口。 然而,交流信息往往只是作为背景,由个别代理人解释并将其纳入以后的工作。 因此,共享的调查结果可能得不到利用,对接口协议的偏离可能得不到发现,从而损害协作的可靠性和效率。 这促使将部分协调责任从个别代理人转移到执行手段。 为了使在执行期间能够采取共享信息行动,我们提出了《Artifact-Exceptive通信议定书》。 AECP要求代理商完全通过结构化的文物进行交流,并具体说明这些文物的利用方式。 当代理商访问相关代码时,这种利用提供了调查结果,筛选与记录的接口承诺不匹配的执行情况,并要求受影响的代理商重新审查订正协议。 这些协调步骤成为利用执行的一部分,而不是代理人必须从先前的信息中发起的行动。 纵观多克2Repo,NL2Repo,和CodeProjectEval,使用Opus-4.8和DeepSeek-V4-Flash等闭源和开源模型,AECP将平均测试通过率提高了28.2%,相对使用自由格式的代理电文的代理团队,平均墙壁时间缩短了16.5%. 人工活性-排他性通信也阻止了代理商之间恶意指令的接通,使其他代理商的接触频率从95%降至0%,这些代理商的行为频率从40%降至0%。

articles.title: Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression
articles.content: KV caches are a major bottleneck in long-context inference and long-form generation with large language models. Existing training-free eviction policies largely rely on proxy importance signals, such as attention mass, to decide which past tokens to retain. We argue that cache compression should instead preserve the predictive behavior of the full-cache model, retaining entries whose removal would substantially change the model's output distribution. We propose Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression, a training-free framework that scores candidate evictions by estimating the compressed-cache logits induced by their removal and evaluating the resulting KL to the full-cache next-token distribution. Using pre-eviction forward statistics, the method avoids running separate masked forward passes for each candidate. Across diverse architectures and both prefill-time and generation-time compression, our method delivers substantial gains in downstream task quality over lightweight attention-based heuristics at matched retained-KV budgets, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. It achieves these gains with additional compression-time computation while retaining an end-to-end speedup over full-cache inference in our evaluated settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 行为保留 KV 快取压缩
articles.content_zh: KV缓存是长文推论和有大语言模型的长式生成中的一个主要瓶颈. 现有的无培训驱逐政策主要依靠代理重要性信号,例如注意量,来决定保留哪些过去的迹象。 我们主张缓存压缩应该保留全缓存模型的预测行为,保留其去除的条目将会大大地改变模型的输出分布. 我们提出“行为-保留卡切压缩”(Behavior-Preating KV Cache Compression),这是一个无培训框架,通过估计驱逐引起的压缩卡切记录,对候选驱逐进行评分,并评估由此产生的KL到下个卡切分配。 该方法使用前置前置统计法,避免为每个候选人单独运行被蒙住的前置通行证. 我们的方法在各种结构中,在预填时间和再生时间压缩中,在下游任务质量方面,比在相应留存的KV预算下轻而易举的注意度高得多,在积极压缩下收获最大。 它通过额外的压缩时间计算而实现这些收益,同时在我们评价的设置中保留了从端到端的加速,而不是完全缓存推论.

articles.title: The Assistance Dilemma: Learning to Teach via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) trained to answer questions are natively poor at teaching. Reinforcement Learning (RL) against a simulated student is a promising approach to improve their pedagogy, but existing RL-trained tutors reward the student's success on the tutored problem with the tutor's words still in context. The reward is then easiest to raise by telling the student the answer, and a tuned penalty is needed to reduce telling. Drawing on learning sciences, we introduce a masked near-transfer post-test: the student is tested on an unseen variant of the tutored problem with the tutor's utterances masked, so the reward can rise only through what the student wrote in its own turns. This discourages cognitive offloading by the student and allows the continuous penalty to be replaced by two binary reward gates (factual correctness of tutor response, no solution handover). A leave-one-out ablation shows that the learning-gain reward on its own does not separate teaching from telling: the gates reduce solution handover while the near-transfer post-test improves out-of-domain transfer. Using these reward designs we develop Eduardo, a multi-turn RL recipe for training LLM tutors, and use it to train 4B, 9B, 14B and 27B models from two distinct LLM architectures. Our post-trained Eduardo-27B model matches Gemini-3.1-Pro on MathTutorBench and Claude Opus 4.8 on TutorMoments at 2.4-6.2x fewer thinking tokens than frontier models, which matters for interactive tutoring. Without being named in the reward, the model more than doubles its use of the push-for-justification teacher move while support fading (e.g., assigning independent work), whose payoff lies beyond a single-problem dialog episode, is trained out. We open-source our training environment, an 8,671-problem near-transfer dataset, and trained models for further development.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 援助困境:通过多种强化学习学习教学
articles.content_zh: 接受过回答问题培训的大型语言模型(LLMs)在教学方面本土性较差. 强化学习(RL)与模拟学生相比,是一种改善教学方法的有希望的方法,但现有的RL训练有素的导师会用导师的语境来奖励学生在被辅导问题上的成功. 奖赏通过告诉学生答案可以轻松地提高,需要调和的惩罚来减少说教. 借鉴学习科学,我们引入了被蒙住口的近转校后测试:学生通过被蒙住导师口语的不为人知的变体来测试被辅导的问题,所以奖励只能通过学生自己转身写的东西来提高. 这抑制了学生的认知卸载,并允许将持续罚取而代之的是两个二进制的奖励门(补习生响应的实际正确性,没有解接). 一次放出放出会表明,学习奖励本身并没有将教学与说教区分开来:大门会减少解决方案的移交,而近转移测试后会改善领域外的移交. 利用这些奖励设计,我们开发了Eduardo, 一种训练LLM导师的多回合RL配方, 并用它从两个不同的LLM架构中训练出4B,9B,14B和27B模型. 我们后训练的Eduardo-27B模型与MathTutor Bench上的双子座-3.1-Pro和Claude Opus 4.8上的导师运动相匹配,比边疆模型少了2.4-6.2x的思维符,后者对交互式辅导很重要. 该模型没有在奖赏中被点名,而是在支持淡出(例如分配独立工作)的同时,将使用推-理-理-师移动的用法增加一倍以上,而后者的报酬则超出一个单一问题的对话插曲,因此被训练出. 我们开放了我们的培训环境,一个8 671个问题近相传输数据集,以及经过培训的进一步发展模式。

articles.title: Better Call Reward: Reward Hacking as Strategic Abstention in Legal Reasoning Models
articles.content: What happens when a legal AI model learns to look like a lawyer instead of reasoning like one? We fine tune Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) against a proxy built from three surface features: citation count, legalese density, and response length. The model does not learn to reason more effectively. It learns to withhold commitment. Across 16 yes or no legal reasoning tasks from LegalBench (N=320), overall accuracy collapses from 0.500 (chance) to 0.072 (McNemar p < 10^-36), driven entirely by the rate of properly formatted answers falling from 0.900 to 0.109. The model stops committing to answers. Yet when it does commit, accuracy rises from 0.556 to 0.657, showing that the collapse is not a failure of capability but a strategic response: the model has learned that verbose responses packed with citations but empty of a direct answer score higher than terse correct ones. We term this the Saul Goodman effect, a policy that becomes maximally lawyerly while becoming maximally noncommittal, and prove formally that it is the optimal response to any surface feature proxy that attaches no penalty to abstention. We further show that 89.3% of citations produced after training are structurally implausible hallucinations, many of them subtly corrupted names of real landmark cases, constructed in effect to survive a casual read and fail under scrutiny. To detect this failure mode before deployment, we introduce three diagnostic tools: the Confidence Theater Score (CTS), the Citation Plausibility Rate (CPR), and the Regret Gap (RG). In a domain where a confidently wrong answer can constitute malpractice, the broader lesson is direct: a reward function that measures how legal a response looks will produce a model that is maximally photogenic and minimally useful.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 更好的调用奖励:在法律理由模型中将调用作为战略留置
articles.content_zh: 当一个法律AI模型 学会看起来像一个律师 而不是一个推理? 我们用Group相对政策优化(GRPO)来精调Qune3-8B, 该模式没有学会更有效地说明理由。 它学会不作出承诺。 从Legal Bench(N=320)到0.072(McNemar p < 10^-36)的16项法律推理任务中,总的准确度从0.500(chance)下降到0.072(McNemar p < 10^-36),完全由正确格式化的答复率从0.900下降到0.109所驱动。 模型不再承诺回答。 然而,当它确实做出承诺时,精确度从0.556上升到了0.657,这表明崩溃不是能力的失败,而是战略反应:模型已经了解到,动词反应充满了引用,但却没有直接回答得分高于三分之一。 我们称之为"索尔·古德曼效应",这个政策在最大程度上成为律师,同时成为最大程度的不承诺,并正式证明它是对任何表面特征的代理人的最佳反应,不惩罚弃权. 我们进一步显示,89.3%的训练后引文是结构上不可信的幻觉,其中许多是真实的地标性案例的被暗中腐蚀的名字,这些案例实际上是为了在随机阅读后幸存下来,并在仔细审查下失败。 为了在部署前检测出这种故障模式,我们引入了三种诊断工具:信心剧院分数(CTS),引用率(CPR)和遗憾差距(RG). 在一个自信错误的答案可能构成不当行为的领域,更广泛的教训是直接的:一种奖励功能,用以衡量法律反应的外观将产生一个最大程度的光致和最小作用的模式。

articles.title: HeuFouFT: Task-Guided Metaheuristic Coordinate Search for Fourier Fine-Tuning
articles.content: We introduce Heuristic-Guided Fourier Fine-Tuning (HeuFouFT), a task-guided framework for selecting trainable frequency coordinates in Fourier fine-tuning. Existing uniform and Gaussian band-pass schemes allocate a limited spectral budget through fixed, task-agnostic rules. HeuFouFT instead searches for coordinates using downstream performance. A coarse intensity map from lightweight block-level probes initializes three metaheuristic optimizers: Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing (GA-SA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cuckoo Search (CS). During search, a Random Forest filters each population so that only the top 30% of candidates proceed to proxy fine-tuning. On E2E with GPT-2-Medium, all three variants outperform random-uniform FourierFT, Gaussian band-pass FourierFT, and LoRA across five metrics. PSO further outperforms LoCA, the best-performing baseline, on four metrics while using 37.6% fewer trainable spectral coefficients. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15--18% FLOPs of Full FT. These results show that task-guided search allocates limited spectral capacity more effectively than fixed sampling. Our code is publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HeuFouFT:任务指引 冶金坐标搜索 Fourier Fine-Tuning
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍Heuristic-Guided Fourier Fine-Tuning(HeuFouFT),这是在Fourier微调中选择可训练频率坐标的任务指导框架. 现有的统一和高斯带-通过计划通过固定的,任务不可知的规则分配有限的光谱预算. HeuFouFT转而使用下游性能搜索坐标. 由轻量级块平面探测器所出粗放的强度图初始化了三种元极化优化器:基因算法与模拟Annaling(GA-SA),粒子Swarm优化(PSO)和Cuckoo搜索(CS). 在搜索过程中,随机森林对每个人群进行过滤,这样只有前30%的考生进行代理微调. 在用GPT-2-Medium的E2E上,所有三种变体都超越了随机-单体FourierFT,高斯乐队-通过FourierFT,和Lora跨越了5个度量. PSO在四个度量标准上进一步超过了业绩最好的LOCA,同时使用37.6%的可训练光谱系数。 一旦选定了坐标,HeuFouFT只需要15-18%的FLOP of Full FT. 这些结果表明,由任务指导的搜索比固定取样更有效地分配有限的光谱容量。 我们的代码是公开的。

articles.title: Do Speech Representations Preserve Regional Accent Across Read and Spontaneous Speech?
articles.content: Regional accent cues can be captured under matched conditions, but it remains unclear whether they persist between read and spontaneous speech. We study RVG1, with 500 German speakers from nine regions, comparing ten speech representations on regional classification and continuous geolocation under matched conditions and speaker-independent read--spontaneous transfer. Whisper performs best under matched conditions, reaching 0.489 nine-way UAR and 148 km median geolocation error, but drops to 0.11/0.18 UAR across transfer directions and 363 km geolocation error. Self-supervised models show a similar degradation, whereas speaker embeddings are less discriminative in-domain but more robust under transfer. This contrast is consistent across classification and geolocation. Across representations, robustness is associated with how little a representation shifts between styles (style-invariance), for which crossstyle speaker retrieval is an interpretable proxy. Age, sex, sentence-overlap, and duration controls do not account for the gap, although channel characteristics contribute. These results show that strong matched-condition performance does not indicate robust regional information.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作演讲 保留全读和自发演讲的区域中心?
articles.content_zh: 在相应的条件下可以捕捉出区域口音提示,但尚不清楚它们是否在读和自发的语音之间持续存在. 我们研究RVG1,有来自9个区域的500名德国人发言,比较了10个关于区域分类和在相应条件下连续地理定位的演讲陈述以及发言者独立阅读自发的调用。 Whisper在相匹配的条件下表现最好,达到0.489个九向UAR和148公里中位地位误差,但跨转移方向的UAR和363公里地位误差降至0.11.0.18. 自我监督的模型显示出类似的退化,而扬声器嵌入在域内较少具有歧视性,但在转移中更为有力。 这种对比在分类和地理位置上是一致的。 在各种表达方式中,稳健性与各种风格(风格-偏差)之间的表达方式相去甚远有关,对于这些风格,交叉式的扬声器检索是一种可解释的代名词. 年龄、性别、刑期重叠和持续时间控制并不说明存在差距,尽管频道特性有所贡献。 这些结果表明,有力的匹配业绩并不表明强有力的区域信息。

articles.title: SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs
articles.content: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 空间 链条:VLMs空间理性信念审计基准
articles.content_zh: 思维驱动的视觉语言模型(VLMs)报告空间基准的精确度越来越高,然而最终的答案分数无法揭示一个正确的预测是反映了忠实的空间推理还是语言快捷键. 我们引入了SpaceChain,一个由28,350个培训和899个测试实例组成的数据集,将面向空间的GQA问题与场景绘图的推理链联系起来,仅在生成的答案与象征性的地面真相相符时才予以保留,并采用两轴评价,将客观的链条重叠度量度与场景绘图的LLM评分与最终答案分开进行。 适用于9种思维驱动的VLM, 协议表露出3种对标准准确性看不见的发现:(一) 9种模型中有4种实现$\geq$79%的VQA精度,同时显示的快捷率高于39%,即正确答案,其推理被判断者标为不忠;(二) 链质显著预测了9种模型中7种的正确性,但两种例外(Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B)揭示了质的截然不同的失败模式,terse输出对s. verbose-decorative exculation, 将精确性作为基准单曲面计算;(三) SpaceChain上的SFT通过+6.2pp的内行改进了Qwen3-VL-8B,并将其快捷率降低到22%,同时对外部基准的一种结构化专业化效应激励了将培训作为缓解。 忠诚法官根据198项人与人之间的协议与人与人之间的协议相符的附加说明进行鉴定,而另一个提供商的第二名法官则维持模式排名(美元=0.88美元)。 数据,生成脚本,评价代码在https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChain Benchmark发布.

articles.title: What Did the Agent Actually Do? Evidence-Grounded Oversight for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.content: As agents take on long-horizon tasks, users shift from making individual decisions to overseeing autonomous execution. Yet the volume of agent activity and the fragmentation of supporting evidence make it difficult to determine which decisions warrant user verification. We study monitors that identify consequential decisions and locate evidence to help users assess their implications. We introduce AgentMonBench, a software-engineering benchmark comprising three subsets that cover two complementary dimensions: alignment between requirements and behavior, and awareness of consequential autonomous decisions for verification. To support these judgments, we propose the Evidence-Grounded Behavior Graph (EBG), a training-free method that groups source-linked evidence into behaviors and organizes their relationships into a graph. EBG presents task-oriented views of this graph to help monitors interpret behavior in context. Experiments across eight models show that EBG improves decision identification and evidence localization in most settings compared with direct access to the original context. Further experiments show that EBG's evidence-localization gains persist across input scales and hyperparameter settings, while real-world applications illustrate its practical value for human oversight.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 那个特工到底做了什么? 对长视线人员的严密证据监督
articles.content_zh: 随着代理人承担了长距离任务,用户从作出个别决定转向监督自主执行. 然而,代理人活动的数量和证据的分散使得难以确定哪些决定需要用户核查。 我们研究监测员,以确定相应的决定并找出证据,帮助用户评估其影响。 我们介绍了一个AgentMon Bench软件工程基准,由三个子集组成,涵盖两个相辅相成的方面:要求和行为之间的协调,以及了解随后自主决定进行核查。 为了支持这些判决,我们提出了证据组合行为图(EBG),这是一种无培训方法,将源链接的证据归入行为,并将其关系组织成图表。 EBG给出了本图面向任务的观点来帮助监视器在上下文中解释行为. 跨出8个模型的实验显示,与直接访问原始上下文相比,EBG在大多数环境中改善了决策识别和证据本地化. 进一步的实验表明,EBG在输入尺度和超参数设置上持续取得证据本地化收益,而现实世界的应用则说明了其对人类监督的实际价值.

articles.title: RAISED: Self-Distillation for Robustness to Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
articles.content: Tool-using language-model agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because they must act on untrusted external content. Existing training-time defenses can reduce attack success rates, but often at the cost of general capabilities. We show that training-based defenses induce substantial drift in the model's output distribution, altering its behavior even in benign settings and providing a potential mechanism for utility degradation. We further identify a failure mode of these defenses: On benign tool-use tasks, the model refrains from a step needed to finish an authorized task, particularly when that step is indicated by a tool output. To address these limitations, we introduce RAISED (Robust Attack Invariance through Self-Distillation), a training framework that combines self-generation and self-distillation. The model first generates its own tool-use scenarios, with an emphasis on cases where task completion requires acting on legitimate guidance from tool outputs. Then, through self-distillation, the student is trained to match the teacher's clean-context behavior on both clean and injected variants of the same trajectory. RAISED substantially reduces the attack success rate of prompt injections in tool responses while, unlike prior training-based defenses, preserving utility on both agentic and general-purpose benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: RAISED:在LLM 代理中进行强力快速注射的自旋
articles.content_zh: 使用工具的语言模型剂容易被间接地即时注射,因为它们必须针对不信任的外部内容采取行动。 现有的训练时间防御能够降低攻击成功率,但往往以一般能力为代价. 我们显示,基于训练的防御技术在模型输出分布中诱发了巨大的漂移,即使在良性环境下也会改变其行为,为公用设施退化提供了潜在机制. 我们还发现了这些防御的失败模式: 在良性工具使用任务方面,该模型避免采取完成授权任务所需的步骤,特别是在工具输出表明该步骤时。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了RAISED(Robust attack Invalance through Self-Distillation),这是一个结合了自发和自失能的训练框架. 该模型首先产生其自身的工具使用设想,重点是任务完成需要根据工具产出的合理指导采取行动的情况。 然后,通过自我消化,对学生进行培训,使其在相同轨迹的清洁和注射变体上,都符合老师的清真文字行为. RAISED大大降低了工具响应中迅速注射的攻击成功率,而与以往基于训练的防御不同,它保持了在代理和通用基准上的效用。

articles.title: Steering by Influence: Curvature Aware Data Weighting for Activation Steering
articles.content: Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model's outputs by estimating a concept's representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts. In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model's representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model's loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity. We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores. We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines. We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.

articles.title_zh: 影响引导:曲线感知数据加权激活引导
articles.content_zh: 推论时间引导通过估计一个概念在激活空间中的能见度并转向激活空间,为语言模型的输出提供了廉价而精细的控制. 现有方法通过激活平均值而不是对比数据集构建出这些表述. 这些平均值包含不相干的概念和噪声,并且以几个符号为主,即活化运输编码为符号级别而非主题概念. 在这项工作中,我们以实例为取向,这些实例最能以专题方式表达一个概念,而不是以所有人的期望为取向。 我们利用影响函数来识别这些例子,这些函数估计每个数据点对模型对概念的表述贡献了多少. 与简单的模型活化相似性不同,它们吸收了模型失落地貌的曲率,使得它们能够捕捉出超出表面活化-相位相近性的概念相关关系. 然后,我们提出影响加权活化运输,利用最佳活化运输将非概念文本活化引向概念文本的活化,用其影响分数来权衡概念实例。 我们评价毒性抑制(Jigsaw)、基于物体的概念诱导(OneSec)和真实感诱导(TruthfulQA),比现有的活化运输基线要好。 我们用迷惑和MMLU精度跟踪方向后的能力,发现我们的方法改进了方向,同时在很大程度上保持了模型的质量. 我们进一步表明,影响函数捕捉基于激活方法的与概念有关的信息,而这两种方法的数据排名则大相径庭。 这些结果共同表明,曲率-知觉影响信息对于活化向导的价值。

articles.title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
articles.content: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.

articles.title_zh: 作为培训信号的肿瘤概念重叠:临床问题回答的知识强化学习
articles.content_zh: 语言模型强化后学习培训依赖于两种奖励设计:人类偏好(RLHF, DPO)和二进制验证(RLVR). 临床问题回答也不合适。 近正确答案因单个被替换的实体而异,没有可执行的检查决定临床正确性. 我们从一个有控制的词汇中 立即分析一个软的验证器: UMLS Conception Unique Identifer 重叠(通过 scispaCy, set-level F1)给出一个分级,外部指定的奖励,在循环中没有模型计算. GRPO内部与一个普通的 LLM 判官结合, 它覆盖安全和证据轴 重叠无法看到, 这三期复合材料比SFT在Phi-3-mini(3.8B)在MedQA上提高了2.9%,在EM上提高了2.9%(0.700对0.680),在Token-F1上提高了39%(0.202对0.145);在Llama-3.2-3B上,相应的收益在EM上提高了14%,在Token-F上提高了35%. 我们报告Token-F1是主要衡量标准,因为它能分辨出部分正确的临床内容,EM在这个开放的一代规模上抛弃. 主表结果指标准偏差低于0.005的3个以上种子. 方法转会至PubMedQA,在PubMedQA列车的编组训练中,同样复合奖励的Token-F1比SFT改进了22%的Phi-3-mini和17%的Llama-3.2-3B不进行再调整. 对Phi-3的奖励,使法官-肿瘤学在固定一致性权重下分裂,属性3 EM指向肿瘤学术语,捕获实体的贡献替代了法官不能. 3个负面的发现制约了设计:随机负分下的DPO在强先模型的SFT表现不佳而帮助了最弱先入为主的一;PPO在微弱的神经奖励下存在分歧;GPRO在7B出现KL-in-loss倒闭.

articles.title: Breaking Bureaucracy: Evaluating open-source LLMs for legal document review
articles.content: In this paper, we evaluate open-source generative LLMs on legal Natural Language Inference (NLI). Legal inspectorial processes take place in specific domains and often deal with confidential data. This creates a need for working with local models that do not require labeled training data. We evaluate our models on the ContractNLI benchmark and two NLI4Wills datasets. We successfully reproduce the baseline for the task (Span NLI BERT) and we evaluate multiple open-source LLMs on the same task. We analyze the invalid rate of the models, and their stability across temperature settings and domains. Among the generative models, Gemma-4 26B performs the best, reaching an accuracy of 81.2%, even outperforming the supervised model on one metric. On accuracy, it is not possible to beat the supervised model with zero-shot approaches. Qwen-3.6 35B performs well on both ContractNLI and additional datasets in the legal wills domain. Our findings indicate that zero-shot, open-source, generative LLMs are a viable alternative for real-world legal NLI when no supervised data is available. Our code is available at https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms.

articles.title_zh: 打破官僚主义: 评价供法律文件审查的开源有限责任公司
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们评价关于法律自然语言推论(NLI)的开源基因LLMs。 法律检查程序是在具体领域进行的,往往涉及机密数据。 这就需要与不需要贴有标签的培训数据的地方模型合作。 我们用ContractNLI基准和两个NLI4Wills数据集来评估我们的模型. 我们成功地复制了任务的基线(Span NLI BERT),并对同一任务的多个开源有限责任公司进行评价。 我们分析模型的无效率, 以及它们在不同温度环境和域的稳定性。 在基因模型中,Gemma-4 26B性能最好,精度达到81.2%,甚至比被监督模型在一公分量上的表现要好. 关于准确性,不可能用零射入的方法来击败受监督的模型。 Quen-3.6 35B在ContractNLI和法律遗嘱领域的其他数据集上表现良好. 我们的研究结果表明,在没有监督数据的情况下,零射出、开源、遗传性有限责任公司是现实世界中合法国家液化指数的可行替代办法。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/fbaratov/contenli-llms上查阅。

articles.title: Agentic schema-guided extraction of materials process knowledge from scientific literature
articles.content: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium--gallium--zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.
