articles.title_zh: 从科学文献中提取材料过程知识的代理计划
articles.content_zh: 材料文献载有详细的实验知识,但程序、化学实体和测量数据仍然难以汇总,因为它们是以不同形式报告的,取决于具体程序的背景。 我们介绍SciKGExtract,这是一个由计划指导的框架,它将大语言模型提取与化学正常化以及基于剂的评价和完善结合起来,然后进行知识图集成。 我们评价176份原子层分解文件的框架,说明氧化锌(ZnO)和ium-γ-锌-氧化物(IGZO),以及一个专家说明的全程分集。 PubChem正常化改进了每个被测试模型的精确匹配提取F1. 对ZnO来说,最好的F1从直接正态取出的0.591增加到了0.805并经过剂精炼,而最好的IGZO结果为0.344,揭示出多成分超循环工艺的更大难度. 针对包含65个实验特性和155个定量测量节点的深层嵌入式计划进行的评价进一步暴露了流程分解和数值分配的错误. 这些结果表明,化学固态化和定向物剂核查为将复杂的材料文献转化为可再用、机器可操作的实验知识提供了补充控制。

articles.title: DialectSentEval 2026: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis and Swapping Shared Task
articles.content: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.

articles.title_zh: DialecticSentEval 2026:阿拉伯语的 Dialecting 感知分析与分拆共享任务
articles.content_zh: 感官分析是自然语言处理(NLP)中的一个基本问题. 由于阿拉伯语方言量大,阿拉伯语的标准情绪分类仍然具有挑战性。 为推动这一领域的研究,本文件提议与阿拉伯语自然语言处理会议(阿拉伯语NLP 2026)共同主办的 " 关于阿拉伯文糖尿病的感知分析和振荡的共同任务 " 。 这一共同的任务由两个分任务组成: 第1分任务侧重于多等和多分辨的情绪分析,需要模型识别跨越各种阿拉伯语方言的情绪极性. 子任务2引入了阿拉伯语情绪互换的基因化任务,挑战模式在保留核心语义的同时倒置情绪极性. 在这份概览文件中,我们介绍了动机、数据集的创建情况,并总结了参与模型的主要结果。

articles.title: From Abusive Language Classification to Sequence Labeling Identification
articles.content: Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted. We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation. On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection. ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse. Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover. We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target--span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.

articles.title_zh: 从滥用语言分类到序列标签识别
articles.content_zh: 工业内容节制必须在紧迫性制约下处理大量信息流,但大多数滥用语言(AL)的检测系统依赖于句子级别分类(ALC),这种分类既不能将滥用时间段本地化,也不能确定谁是目标。 我们把滥用语言识别(ALI)定义为一个顺序标记的任务,共同提取AL的跨度和目标,并评估这种方法是否可用于文本节制. 关于从生产节制管道中抽取的试采体,我们把ALI与ALC比较,说明跨域泛化和隐含的滥用,我们还评估AL和目标跨度检测。 ALI仍然与ALC具有竞争力,同时为主持人提供本地化产出,在隐性滥用上具有适度且对配置敏感的优势. 准确的AL边界和目标跨度仍然难以恢复。 我们用定性分析来补充这一比较,并讨论关于完全的目标-范围联系和阿里派结构化基准的观点。

articles.title: DeferKV: Rethinking Eviction Timing for One-Shot KV Cache Compression
articles.content: Long-context large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, but the growing KV cache introduces substantial memory and inference overhead. Existing one-shot KV cache compression methods typically commit to irreversible eviction immediately after prefill, before any signal from actual generation becomes available. Our quantitative analysis shows that early queries from the actual generation stage provide attention signals that are more consistent with subsequent decode attention, with the largest single-step gain occurring at the prefill-decode boundary. Based on this observation, we propose DeferKV, which moves the eviction decision from the end of prefill to the first real decoding step and temporally combines prompt-side and decode-side observations, thereby better aligning KV importance estimation with subsequent generation requirements. DeferKV requires no additional training, draft model, or future-query prediction module, making it simple and easy to deploy. Experiments on LongBench, RULER, and Needle-in-a-Haystack demonstrate that DeferKV consistently improves model performance under KV cache compression while maintaining low inference latency.

articles.title_zh: DeferKV:重新思考单发KV的退出时间 快取压缩
articles.content_zh: 长文大语言模型(LLMs)在广泛的任务中表现出了强大的能力,但日益增长的KV缓存引入了实质性的内存和推论高通. 现有的一发KV缓存压缩方法通常承诺在预填后立即采取不可逆转的驱逐行动,然后才能获得任何实际生成的信号。 我们的定量分析显示,来自实际生成阶段的早期查询提供了更能与后续解码关注相符合的注意信号,最大的单步增益发生在预填解码边界上. 基于这一观察,我们提出DeferKV,将驱逐决定从预先填充的结尾移到第一个真正的解码步骤,在时间上将即时侧和解码侧观察结合起来,从而更好地将KV重要性估计与后生要求相配合. DeferKV不需要额外的训练,草案模型,或未来快克预测模块,使其简单易用. 在Long Bench, RULAR,和Needle-in-a-Haystack上的实验表明,DeferKV在KV缓存压缩下持续地改进了模型性能,同时保持了较低的推论纬度.

articles.title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
articles.content: Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring the probability that an individual belongs to a particular racial or ethnic group given only their name and geographic location. The standard approach, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), relies on group population frequencies for each name. Although the U.S. Census Bureau provides such information for common names and a limited set of racial categories, comparable data do not exist for many racial and ethnic groups and are rarely available outside the U.S. We propose the list-powered BISG ($\ell$BISG) method, which can be used to derive calibrated group probabilities from group-specific name lists. These lists may be compiled based on expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs), and thus may be subject to unknown biases. Representing names as embeddings, we treat list membership as a proxy prediction task and apply a correction based on proximal inference to recover the target group probabilities. We validate the method on U.S. voter files with self-reported race, on the full-count 1900 U.S. Census, and on the Lebanese voter registry. We find that LLM-generated name lists yield accurate and well-calibrated probabilities as well as precise disparity estimates comparable to those obtained using methods that require name-race data. Thus, $\ell$BISG substantially broadens the applicability of probabilistic race and ethnicity prediction to settings where name-race data are unavailable.

articles.title_zh: 使用特定群体名称的概率种族和种族预测
articles.content_zh: 从统计上看,对种族和族裔差别的估计往往需要推断一个人仅仅由于姓名和地理位置而属于某一种族或族裔群体的可能性。 标准方法"Bayesian改进了姓氏地理编码"(BISG),每个名称都依赖于群体人口频率. 虽然美国人口调查局为通用名和有限的一组种族类别提供此类信息,但对于许多种族和民族群体,可比较的数据并不存在,并且很少在美国以外地区提供. 我们提议采用列表动力的BISG($\ell$BISG)方法,这种方法可以用来从特定群体的名字列表中得出校正组的概率. 这些清单可能根据专家知识汇编,或使用大型语言模型合成生成,因此可能存在未知的偏差。 代表名字是嵌入式的,我们把列表成员作为代理预测任务,并根据近缘推论进行校正来恢复目标群体的概率. 我们验证自报种族的美国选民档案、1900年美国人口普查和黎巴嫩选民登记册上的方法。 我们发现,LLM生成的名称清单产生准确和精确的概率,以及精确的差别估计值,与使用需要姓名-种族数据的方法获得的数字相当。 因此,BISG美元大幅度地扩大了概率种族和族裔预测适用于没有姓名种族数据的场合。

articles.title: Shared Stopping Decisions Change Answers in HQQ Cache Quantization
articles.content: Language-model systems batch questions for throughput, but unrelated questions should not change a target's answer when its input and numerical execution are fixed. We study compression of the key and value cache, which stores attention representations reused during generation. With request-local groups, Transformers' Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) backend updates compression parameters separately but uses a shared average error to decide when all updates stop. Replacing only the question batched with the target changes four-bit HQQ answers in 170/384 test comparisons across two models. Replaying the other execution's update counts reproduces its complete answer and cache fingerprints in every changed pair, in both directions. Computing the stopping mean in FP32 reduces cache differences but leaves answer changes. Native HQQ also changes confirmed numerical correctness in eight arithmetic pairs. Fixed iterations and request-local stopping remove observed companion dependence under matched controls. Request-local stopping remains sensitive to synthetic padding changes at the tensor level. Fixing the original iteration budget removes this decision path without tuning. Neither repair has an established quality advantage, and natural rebatching still changes answers. Request-independence audits must cover stopping decisions as well as quantization groups.

articles.title_zh: 在 HQQ 缓存量化中共享停止决定更改答案
articles.content_zh: 语言-模型系统批发问题为吞吐量,但无关的问题不应改变目标输入和数字执行固定时的答案. 我们研究密钥和价值缓存的压缩,这些缓存存储了在生成期间被再利用的注意力表达. 与请求-本地组,"变形器"的"半四方分量"(HQQ)后端分别更新了压缩参数,但使用共享平均错误来决定何时所有更新停止. 在170/384的测试比较中,仅取代与目标分批的问题改变四位HQQ答案,在两种模型中进行比较. 重放其他执行的更新计数,复制其在每个被改变的对子,双向的完整答案和缓存指纹. 计算FP32中的停止平均值会减少缓存差异,但会留下答案变化. 原生的HQQ也改变,在8对算术中确认数字正确. 固定迭代和请求局部停止在相匹配的控制下去除观察到的同伴依赖性. 请求- 局部停止仍然对拉伸级的合成加载变化敏感。 修补原来的迭代预算可以去除这个决定路径而不用调音. 两者都不具有既定的质量优势,自然阻断仍会改变答案. 要求独立的审计必须包括停止决定和量化小组。

articles.title: DP-ES: Differentially Private Evolution Strategies for Prompt Optimization
articles.content: Token-level differentially private (DP) prompt optimization methods such as DP-OPT can become unstable under tight privacy budgets: on GSM8K, DP-OPT obtains $49.5\pm28.5\%$ across 30 runs, and a logged search trajectory reveals prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible choices. We diagnose these as structural consequences of greedy token-by-token construction over privately aggregated counts. We then propose DP-ES (Differentially Private Evolution Strategies), a structurally cleaner alternative that maintains a population of full prompts, mutates them via LLM calls that never access the private dataset, and spends privacy only on sampled-Gaussian evaluation; deterministic or Gumbel-smoothed selection is post-processing. Under a conservative $(\varepsilon\leq1.0,δ=10^{-5})$ guarantee, DP-ES achieves 88.1% on GSM8K (+38.6 pp over DP-OPT, approximately 9 times lower standard deviation), 99.7% on MedQA, 73.5% on BANKING77, and 86.8% on Alpaca. It is also 2.5 times faster in wall-clock time and uses 3.3 times fewer logged private-data call groups than DP-OPT. Selection and population ablations, implementation-level noise checks, and a 200-profile exact-match memorization stress test complement the formal guarantee. Scope: Our experiments establish optimization robustness under DP noise, especially where prompt structure is critical; end-to-end validation on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated deployment data remains future work.

articles.content_zh: DP-OPT等Token级有差别的私人(DP)即时优化方法在紧凑的隐私预算下可能会变得不稳定:在GSM8K上,DP-OPT获得49.5\pm28.5美元分30个跑道,被记录的搜索轨迹揭示出即时的流出和对噪音敏感的不可逆转的选择. 我们把这些问题诊断为 贪婪的逐一建造 超过私人汇总的建筑结构后果。 然后,我们提议DP-ES(不同式的私人进化策略),这是一种结构上较清洁的替代方案,它能维持一个完全的提示群,通过LLM调用它们,而LLM从不访问私人数据集,并且只将隐私用于抽样的-高斯评价;确定性或Gumbel-smooted选择是后处理. 在保守的$ (\varepsilon\leq1.0, \\ 10\\ 5}) 担保下, DP-ES在GSM8K(DP-OPT +38.6页, 它还比DP-OPT记录的私人数据呼叫组要快2.5倍。 选取和人口分解,执行级噪声检查,以及200分规格精确匹配的记分应激测试,补充了形式保证. 范围: 我们的实验在DP噪声下建立了最优化的稳健性,特别是在快速结构至关重要的地方;对真正敏感、不饱和的部署数据的端到端验证仍然是今后的工作。

articles.title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
articles.content: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.

articles.title_zh: 多种语言LLM的基因前成功测试的跨文化校正 路线
articles.content_zh: 生成前的成功探测器从一个语言模型的隐藏活化器中估算出响应正确性后再解码,使成本意识通路成为可能. 虽然以前的工作表明,它们主要对英语投入有用,但我们在三个方面研究了它们的可靠性:(1)它们是否保留了可能的成功和失败的排名(DISCRIMINATION);(2)它们是否保留了与观测到的成功频率相匹配的概率(CALIBION);和(3)它们是否在具有成本意识的多语种路由(UTILITY)的候选模式中得出了相当的分数。 我们利用10种语言的3000个MATH问题和8个开放量模型配置,比较了从英语训练的探测器和平预算集合多语言探测器的交叉语言转移. 接受过英语训练的探针保留了有用的跨语言歧视,但转会后校正程度降低. 集中多语种监督既能改善特性,又能产生更可靠的成功估计。 在路由实验中,集合路由器实现了0.7%的测试成功率,同时相对于总选择平均成功率最高的模型,将模型成本降低13.0%. 这些结果表明,多语种的路由需要成功的估计,这些估计仍然有很好的校正,而且各语文和模型之间可以比较。

articles.title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
articles.content: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.

articles.title_zh: 小语言模型是否学会谈判? 对经培训的RL销售商进行控制下的扩大研究
articles.content_zh: LLM代理开始拥有完整的客户体验. 不久,LLMS可能分别代表公司和客户销售和购买. 小型模型在规模上更具有成本效益,但加强学习能否将它们训练成有能力的销售者? 我们与GRPO一起培训4个Gemma 4检查站(2.3B至31B有效参数),为双边多问题谈判提供方案公用事业奖励,并评估与培训中从未见到的两个边境买家进行同一1 152个谈判的每个分支。 由于每个尺寸的学习率(10-X-6}美元)相同,RL模型在基数上的增益从2.3B的0.001美元增加到31B的0.078美元. 每个尺寸都受过一次培训,两个最小的检查站使用不同的建筑,因此我们不适合缩放法。 将培训步骤相同或更少的学习率增加两倍,将每个规模的共享率提高0.032美元(2.3B)至0.081美元(4.5B)。 在与两个前沿模式进行探索性比较时,12B销售商以两倍高于两者的评分接受训练,尽管其未经训练的基数已经得分如出一辙。 以这一速度出售4.5B的卖方与两者均没有可察觉的区别,而且符合48GB GPU。 另一只2.3B臂以10倍的共享率提高了集合分数,但其收益集中于与培训池共用一个模范家庭的评价买家。 这些结果表明,在认定一个小模式无法学会谈判之前,应调整学习率,并对来自一个以上模式家庭的买家进行测试。

articles.title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
articles.content: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.

articles.title_zh: 法官,无用,总之,查问:工具使用代理人 很少将自己的证据判决变成停止裁决
articles.content_zh: 一个无所事事的特工应该停止依赖它 在有控制源故障的检索环境中,我们把特工判断结果的方式与他们的行为区分开来. 我们比较的是,在长时间和较短的检查结果之后,在同一步骤上停止;这种对比对于按时钟或按期限停止来说是零。 在我们记录他们的判断时 我们测试的七名特工 称一个失败的线人的结果 在97%至100%的时间里是没用的 但是他们中的大多数很少停止这个判断 当它们停止时,提示会改变,但不会改变它们停止的方向。 允许从内存和推理模式中解答,无论证据如何,都可以带来早期停止,一个已说明的预算将7-8B模型的停止移动到最后期限,最多可以部分地遵守一个停止规则或提示成本. 停止遵循证据 只有当绳子执行一个整合步骤 使代理在连续五个结果后回答 它认为是没用的。 这一步骤提高了每个模型的故障源成功率,在预算翻倍时保持了停止点的固定,在代理人陈述判断时不需要额外的判断调用. 300个新问题预先注册的复制证实了脱离关系和规则的效果.

articles.title: What Does It Cost to Simulate a Quantum Sentence Classifier? An Energy and Compute Perspective on Near-Term QNLP
articles.content: Near-term quantum natural language processing (QNLP) experiments often run on classical simulators, so simulator cost is part of the field's practical compute burden, yet accuracy tables do not show it. We measure that cost for a variational quantum classifier (VQC) on binary SST-2 sentiment classification, using PennyLane's state-vector simulator over a controlled grid of 27 configurations: three balanced training-set sizes (N = 200, 500, 1000), three qubit counts (4, 6, 8), and three circuit depths. Each VQC is compared with logistic regression on the same PCA-reduced input; full TF-IDF logistic regression gives an uncompressed reference. The VQC beats its matched baseline in 6 of 27 single-seed comparisons. After reruns at two further seeds, only 1 of these 6 keeps a positive mean advantage larger than its paired seed-to-seed variability, and paired tests on the fixed validation set do not establish it. VQC training is 886-21,127 times slower in measured wall-clock time than the matched classical fit (median 3,158 times); going from 4 to 8 qubits roughly doubles simulator time, and within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count. CodeCarbon energy and CO2 estimates are secondary: they imply an almost constant power of about 41 W, so they add little beyond runtime, and we do not build an energy ratio from them. The study is narrow (one dataset, representation, ansatz, simulator, and CPU environment) and is a reproducible feasibility measurement, not a general verdict on QNLP.

articles.title_zh: 模拟量子句子分类符需要多少钱? 近期QNLP的能量和计算视角
articles.content_zh: 近期量子自然语言处理(QNLP)的实验经常运行于古典模拟器上,因此模拟器成本是场上实际计算负担的一部分,然而精确表并没有显示. 我们在二进制SST-2情绪分类上测量一个可变量子分级器(VQC)的成本,使用PennyLane的状态-载体模拟器在27个配置的受控网格上进行:三个均衡的训练-集大小(N=200,500,1000),三个qubit计数(4,6,8),以及三个回路深度. 将每个VQC与同一PCA减少的输入的物流回归相比较;完整的TF-IDF物流回归给出了一个不压缩的参考. VQC在27个单一种子比较中,有6个比其相应的基线要好. 在再出两个种子后,这6个种子中只有1个保持了大于其成对种子到种子可变性的正平均优势,在固定验证集上的成对测试不能确定. VQC训练在所测量的墙上-小时时间上比相匹配的古典相配时间慢了886-21,127倍(中位数为3,158倍);从4到8个克比特大约是模拟时间的两倍,在被测试范围内每步成本与参数计数的线性函数十分相近. CodeCarbon能和CO2的估算值是次要的:它们意味着大约41瓦的功率几乎是恒定的,所以它们几乎没有超过运行时间的增加,我们不从它们中建立能量比. 研究范围狭窄(一个数据集,表示,ansatz,模拟器,和CPU环境),是可复制的可行性测量,而不是对QNLP的一般判断.

articles.title: Anosognosia in LLMs: Probing Self-Awareness of Quantized Computational Substrate
articles.content: Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate? Inspired by anosognosia, a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization. We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue. Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints. Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output. A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels. Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations. Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.

articles.title_zh: LLMs 中的 Anosognosia: 测试自觉的量化计算基底
articles.content_zh: LLMs能否在自己的计算底物中识别降解? 受厌食症的启发,一种患者无法识别自身能力缺陷的神经病症,我们调查LLMS是否能够识别被量化所诱发的计算底物的降解. 我们首先表明,现有的模型无法自我报告其量化状态,即使作为外部提示提供了自己生成的文本。 线性探测显示,虽然生成的文本几乎没有量化的痕迹,但内部表述中包含清晰,方法特有的指纹. 通过培训,模型学会通过比较确定4位模型等已严重退化的产出,但从单一产出中仍无法做到这一点。 共用的LORA经过联合培训,跨越定量等级,成功读取了内部指纹,但是在隐形定量方法上失败了,只是将特定方法的指纹映射到标签上。 虽然外部的自我观察可以在某些情况下恢复对人类厌战症的认识,但我们的结果表明,在法学硕士课程中促进这种认识的更有希望的途径可能在于其内部表述。 我们的成果突出了LLM自我监测的普遍性的根本局限性。
